title: Claims Rebuttals Specialist
description:
About the Role



Vital Veterans Consultants (VVC) is a U.S.-based, veteran-owned company that helps veterans with their benefits and claims.

We are looking for a Veteran Claims Rebuttals Specialist who enjoys researching, writing, reviewing documents, and helping a team create accurate and well-organized claim responses.

You don't have to be an expert in VA claims to apply. VA claims or other claims experience is a plus, but we are also interested in candidates with strong writing, research, documentation, and customer service skills who are willing to learn.



What You’ll Do

• Research information related to veteran claims and VA requirements.

• Review claim decisions, medical documents, statements, and other records.

• Help identify important information, errors, or missing details.

• Write and organize rebuttals, statements, and supporting documents.

• Proofread documents to make sure they are clear, accurate, and complete.

• Keep case files and documentation organized.

• Work with the team to review cases and improve documents.

• Communicate professionally with team members and veterans when needed.

• Learn and follow VVC's processes, standards, and guidelines.



What We’re Looking For

• Strong English communication skills.

• Good research and writing skills.

• Good attention to detail.

• Able to organize information clearly.

• Comfortable working with documents and detailed information.

• Good communication and customer service skills.

• Team player who is willing to learn and accept feedback.

• Reliable, responsible, and able to meet deadlines.



Experience That’s a Plus



You don't need to have all of these, but experience in any of the following is an advantage:

• VA claims or VA appeals

• Insurance or other types of claims

• Customer service

• Documentation or administrative work

• Legal or medical documentation

• Research or professional writing

• Working with U.S.-based clients



Work Expectations

• Work remotely during your assigned schedule.

• Camera-on Zoom attendance is required during the work shift, except during approved breaks and lunch.

• Camera should show you from the shoulders up.

• Work attire should include red, blue, white, or black.

• You must be fully available and focused during your scheduled work hours.

• No other employment or freelance work is allowed during your assigned shift.

• Must be flexible and willing to work weekends when scheduled.

• Reliable internet connection and a suitable work-from-home setup are required.



Additional Terms



1. Daily Zoom attendance is required with camera turned on.

2. Attire must include red, blue, white, or black.

3. Camera view must be shoulders up.

4. No other employment or freelance work is permitted during assigned work hours.

5. Applicants must be fully available and dedicated during their scheduled shift.



How to Apply



Please submit:

1. Updated Resume

2. 1–2 Minute Video Introduction

3. Writing Sample (advantage but optional) — statement,
, report, or professional document demonstrating your writing skills

title: Social Media & Content Manager
description:
About the Role



We are an emerging beverage brand inspired by Ayurveda — the 5,000-year-old Indian wellness practice centered around daily rituals for a more holistic and balanced life. Currently growing our retail presence in New York City alongside our e-commerce business, we are entering an exciting stage of growth with additional product launches planned and a strong focus on building community and brand awareness across the U.S.



We're looking for a Social Media & Content Manager who can help co-lead our social media strategy while also being highly hands-on with day-to-day execution. This is not simply a scheduling or community management position — we want someone who brings ideas to the table, helps establish a clear content strategy, identifies what is and isn't working, and works closely with the founders to bring that strategy to life.



Work Structure & Requirements



Location: Remote / Virtual

Schedule: Part-time (20 hours per week)

Time Zone: EST business hours

Compensation: $8 USD per hour



Key Responsibilities



1. Social Media Strategy



Develop and help lead the organic social media strategy across Instagram and TikTok

Establish clear content pillars, formats, themes, and posting strategies rather than creating content on an ad-hoc basis

Help grow our presence and reach specifically within the U.S. market, with an initial focus on New York and relevant U.S. consumer communities

Identify opportunities to improve audience targeting and ensure content reaches the brand's intended demographic

Develop platform-specific strategies for Instagram and TikTok while identifying opportunities to repurpose high-performing content across channels

Build content plans around new product launches, retail growth, founder stories, and other key brand moments



2. Content Creation & Video Editing



Work closely with the founders to develop content ideas, scripts, hooks, and creative briefs for founder-led videos

Give the founders clear direction on what content should be filmed and how it should be structured

Edit founder-shot footage into engaging TikToks, Instagram Reels, and Stories

Create strong opening hooks, pacing, captions, and edits designed to maximize retention and engagement

Identify relevant TikTok, Instagram, and broader cultural trends and adapt them creatively for the brand

Help maintain a consistent brand voice, look, and feel across all social content

Develop organic content and creative concepts that can also be tested and repurposed as paid social advertising creatives



3. Publishing & Community Management



Own or support the day-to-day publishing of content across Instagram and TikTok

Manage comments, DMs, and general community engagement

Proactively engage with relevant U.S.-based consumers, creators, communities, and complementary brands

Help build genuine relationships around the brand rather than relying solely on paid audience acquisition

Identify relevant local communities, events, wellness groups, creators, and other opportunities that could strengthen our presence in New York and the wider U.S. market



4. Creator & UGC Support



Identify creators and UGC opportunities that align with our target customer and brand positioning

Coordinate basic creator outreach, product seeding, and UGC collaborations

Maintain creator lists and help manage communication and follow-ups

Identify high-performing creator content that could be repurposed across organic and paid channels



Required Skills & Experience



Experience: 3+ years in social media management, social strategy, content marketing, or a similar role

Platforms: Strong experience managing and growing brands across Instagram and TikTok

Strategy: Demonstrated ability to develop social media strategy as well as execute it

Video: Strong short-form video editing skills, particularly for TikTok and Instagram Reels; excellent understanding of hooks, storytelling, retention, and short-form content best practices

Trends: Ability to identify trends and translate them into content that feels relevant to a specific brand rather than simply copying trends

Communication: Strong written English; ability to write engaging social copy, captions, scripts, and content concepts

Analytics: Comfortable analyzing social media performance and making recommendations based on data

Profile: Highly proactive, creative, and comfortable suggesting ideas rather than waiting for detailed instructions; sits somewhere between a Social Media Strategist, Content Manager, and hands-on Creator



To Apply:

Kindly send your resume, portfolio and introduction video

title: Job Title: Inbound Sales Closer & VA (GoHighLevel & Mapping Experience)
description:
We are seeking high-performing Inbound Sales Closers to handle inbound calls and web inquiries for our fast-paced Christmas light installation business. You will manage full-funnel phone sales: warmly greeting leads, pre-screening project budgets, building live custom design mockups using mapping software, and closing jobs on the first call.



Schedule: Coverage needed 12 hours/day, 7 days/week (multiple shifts available).



Pay: $6.00/hour base + uncapped sales performance bonuses.



Key Responsibilities:



-Lead Handling: Answer incoming phone calls and follow up immediately with newly submitted web inquiries.

-Sales & Pitching: Deliver a natural, engaging introduction to explain our full-service offering without reading off a rigid script.

-Budget Screening: Pre-screen potential clients by establishing our $700 minimum project starting price early in the call.

-Live Custom Mockups: Locate property photos via Google Maps and Zillow to generate live design mockups while on the line with the customer.

-Closing Deals: Walk clients through their customized proposals, address objections, and secure deposits on the spot.

-Pipeline Management: Maintain and update contact records and deal stages inside GoHighLevel (GHL).



Requirements & Qualifications:



-Flawless Spoken English: Native or near-native English fluency with zero to minimal accent to ensure effortless, high-trust communication with US homeowners.

-Sales Competency: Confident handling price objections, guiding conversations, and directly asking for the sale.

-US Home Familiarity: Ability to visually identify standard American home architectural features (e.g., rooflines, dormers, peaks, gutters) from photos.

-Software Proficiency: Familiarity with GoHighLevel (GHL) and navigation of Google Maps/Zillow (design/mapping tool experience is a major plus; training provided).

-Home Office Setup: High-speed internet connection, quiet dedicated environment, and a noise-canceling headset.



How to Apply (Mandatory Instructions)

To be considered for this position, please submit:



1. Your Resume

2. Weekly Availability: State your preferred working hours and available days per week (e.g., 5 days/week, weekends, M-F).

3. 1-2 Minute Audio Audition: Submit a recording (via Vocaroo or Google Drive link) performing the roleplay script below.



Note: Applications submitted without a voice recording will be automatically disqualified.



[Roleplay Audition Script]

Read the script below as the VA. We are evaluating tone, clarity, pacing, and conversational flow—do NOT read like a robot!



VA: "Thanks for calling Fresh Christmas Lights, how can we brighten up your day?"   

(Pause 2 seconds | imagine customer says: "Hi, I saw your yard sign down the street and wanted to get a quote for Christmas lights on my house.")   



VA: "Great! We’d love to help light up your house. We put lights on thousands of homes every year, so you’re in great hands! Do you mind if I share a quick outline of how our service works so we can see if we're a good fit?"   



(Pause 2 seconds | imagine customer says: "Sure, go ahead.")   



VA: "Awesome! We’re a full service Christmas light company. That means we custom fit the lights directly to your house by cutting wires and attaching custom plugs and bulbs. You won't have any messy cords hanging down—it looks extremely clean and professional.   



We also provide automated timers set to your schedule, and all high quality materials are included under our light leasing program, so you never have to buy or store the lights yourself. That means full maintenance is included free of charge—if a bulb or plug ever goes out, you just call us and we come fix it at zero extra charge.   



Then in January, we reach out, take all the lights down, and store them safely in our warehouse for next season. Plus, while we're out there, we offer discounts on our other business services like gutter cleaning! How does all that sound?"   



(Pause 2 seconds | imagine customer says: "That sounds really great.")   



VA: "Wonderful! Our custom projects start at $700 and go up from there depending on the home size and design complexity. If that's within your starting budget, I’d love to take down your address right now and pull up a live picture of your house with lights on it in just a couple of minutes!"

title: Remote Sales Closer
description:
About Nelaur Space



Nelaur Space helps businesses grow and operate more efficiently through websites, AI solutions, CRM systems, and business automation.



We are looking for a confident and results-driven Sales Closer who can speak with qualified prospects, understand their business needs, present the right Nelaur Space solution, handle objections, and turn opportunities into paying clients.



Responsibilities



* Conduct sales calls with qualified prospects.

* Understand each prospect’s business, challenges, needs, and goals.

* Present Nelaur Space services clearly and confidently.

* Explain the value of our website, AI, CRM, and automation solutions.

* Recommend the appropriate service or package based on the client’s needs.

* Handle objections regarding price, timing, trust, and services.

* Negotiate professionally when necessary.

* Follow up with prospects who are not ready to purchase immediately.

* Close deals and guide clients through the next steps.

* Maintain accurate notes and update leads and opportunities in the CRM.

* Work closely with appointment setters and the Nelaur Space team.

* Meet agreed sales and closing targets.

* Provide regular updates on calls, objections, follow-ups, and closed deals.



Requirements



We are looking for someone who:



* Has previous experience in sales, closing, appointment setting, or high-ticket sales.

* Has excellent English communication skills.

* Is confident speaking with business owners and decision-makers.

* Is comfortable conducting sales calls through Zoom, Google Meet, phone, or similar platforms.

* Understands consultative selling rather than using aggressive sales tactics.

* Can confidently handle objections and negotiate.

* Is organized and consistent with follow-ups.

* Is comfortable working with a CRM.

* Can work independently in a remote environment.

* Is motivated by targets and performance.

* Is reliable, professional, and accountable.



Experience selling websites, digital marketing, SaaS, AI, automation, CRM systems, or other digital services is a strong advantage.



Key Performance Indicators



Performance may be evaluated based on:



* Number of qualified sales calls completed

* Closing rate

* Revenue generated

* Follow-up conversion rate

* CRM accuracy

* Client communication quality



Ideal Candidate



The ideal closer is persuasive without being pushy. You know how to listen, identify the real problem a prospect is trying to solve, build trust, communicate value, and confidently ask for the sale.



You should be comfortable selling services to business owners and representing Nelaur Space professionally.



How to Apply



Please send:



1. Your CV or résumé.

2. A short introduction about your sales experience.

3. Your experience closing digital services or high-ticket offers.

4. Your previous closing rate, if available.

5. Your expected compensation.

title: Executive Assistant to Founder (Remote, PH-Based, PST Hours)
description:
Umbrella Property Services is a building services company based in Vancouver. We’re on a mission to attract, develop, and empower people from around the world to become better leaders.



I’m Ryan, the Founder, and I move fast. I think in ideas and loose ends. Your job is to turn those into clear plans, tight calendars, and closed loops. You report directly to me and act as the primary leverage point for my time and attention.



This is not a basic VA role. I’m looking for a true Executive Assistant who creates structure around me. Someone who wants to become exceptional at executive support, systems, prioritization, and follow-through over the foreseeable future. This role is not intended to be a short-term stepping stone while you immediately pursue a different career or business.



About Ryan & How We Work

- I’m not a micromanager. I’m not looking over your shoulder or nitpicking details. My style is “good enough, ship it, keep moving.”

- I’m chaotic by nature: lots of ideas, lots of moving pieces, and I’d rather be doing deals, strategy, and sales than admin.



Your job is to:

- Put just enough structure around me so my days are sane,

- Protect my calendar so I have real focus time,

- Own the admin and follow-through so I don’t have to chase you or the work.



If you like bringing order to a fast-moving founder and being trusted to run with things, you’ll fit here.



Your Core Outcome

- Give me back time, focus, and mental space.

- When I hand you something, you own it until it’s done. I should not have to chase updates, remember details, or manage follow-through. If you need clarity, you ask. If you don’t, you just get it done.



What Success Looks Like in the First 60 Days

- You fully own my calendar: no double bookings, protected focus time, realistic days.

- My inbox is consistently triaged; I only see what actually needs my brain, with drafts ready where appropriate.

- Recurring admin and follow‑ups are handled without me chasing you, and I’m spending noticeably more time on sales, strategy, and deals.



What You’ll Own

1. Calendar & Communication

- Protect and manage my calendar; no double bookings, clear buffers, realistic days.

- Triage inbox and messages; draft replies and summarize what needs my decision.

- Ensure follow-ups and responses don’t fall through the cracks.

2. Follow-Up & Accountability

- Capture commitments from meetings and conversations.

- Turn discussions into clear next actions with owners and deadlines.

- Follow up with internal and external stakeholders and push (respectfully) when things stall.

3. Problem Solving

- Bring solutions, not just problems.

- When something blocks you, come back with: “Here’s what happened, here are options, here’s what I recommend.”

- Ask smart clarifying questions instead of waiting passively.

4. Projects & Operations

- Coordinate small projects and initiatives. This is light operational coordination, not a general operations manager role.

- Prepare agendas, documents, and materials for meetings.

- Maintain simple systems for tasks, SOPs, and follow-ups.

- Improve or automate repetitive admin where possible, including with AI tools.

- Handle personal admin (bookings, reservations, personal tasks) so I can stay focused on high‑value work.



You’ll Succeed Here If You Are

- Highly proactive and self-directed; you don’t wait to be told what to do next.

- Strong at follow-through and holding others accountable.

- Comfortable “managing up” to a busy, idea-driven founder.

- Clear, concise written communicator.

- Calm when priorities change and things are a bit chaotic.

- Detail-oriented and reliable; you take pride in clean work.

- Comfortable working with ambiguity and turning it into structure.

- AI-literate and hungry to keep learning.



This Role Is Not For You If

- You need step-by-step instructions for every task.

- You get stressed by someone who moves fast and changes priorities.

- You wait to be chased for updates instead of closing the loop yourself.



Non-Negotiables (Read Carefully)

- Based in the Philippines and able to work 7:30 a.m. – 4:00 p.m. PST, Monday–Friday (40 hrs/week).

- Minimum 2 years supporting a founder / CEO / executive as an EA, PA, or similar role.

- Excellent written and spoken English.

- Comfortable using Google Workspace (Gmail, Calendar, Drive, Docs, Sheets) and Slack for daily communication.

- Quiet, distraction-free workspace (no cafés).

- Reliable computer setup with two monitors (or laptop + external screen), headset, mouse, and keyboard.

- High-speed internet (100 Mbps or faster) for video and calls.



If you do not meet the above, your application will not be considered.



Compensation & Setup

- Fixed retainer of $1,250 USD per month, paid bi-weekly.

- 30 days paid time off per year, aligned with the Canadian calendar (not PH public holidays).

- Bonus opportunities after 3 months, based on reliability, quality, and ownership.

- $500 USD annual tech allowance to support your equipment and connectivity.



How to Apply

- Complete this application: 
/recruit-ph-ea

- If shortlisted, complete a short video response and a series of
-based tasks

- Finalists will be invited to complete a paid trial day in a simulated work environment

- Before any written offer is finalized, the selected candidate must provide two verifiable professional references from people who directly supervised their work or worked closely with them.

title: Project Manager/Operations Manager
description:
What Winning Looks Like



Every active project has one owner, a WBS, a schedule, and a status in ClickUp that matches reality.

No critical component is ever coin-flipped: crew confirmed with a backup day, gear planned, vendors tracked with proof of progress weeks out.

The team runs on the system — Connect Team, EOD reports, ClickUp, SOP-first — and the SOPs move from "In review" to "Validated."

Deliverables ship on time at the counts sold, and every one has cleared the QC tracker before the client sees it.

The founder gets one weekly view: what shipped, what is at risk, and your recommendation — never a pile of problems.

Nothing operational routes to the founder by default.



Your First 30 Days



Days 1–7 — Extraction & Baseline. Interview the founder and every team lead. Audit every active project: WBS against ClickUp, crew and gear status, open client items, critical components at risk. Read the playbook and every SOP, noting which are validated and which are not.



Days 8–14 — The Pipeline. Install the weekly pipeline review. Fix WBS-to-ClickUp drift. Put one owner and one date on every open item. Deliver a prioritized list of what is leaking time, money, or momentum.



Days 15–30 — The Operating Rhythm. Set the internal pre-production meeting cadence, the crew confirmation standard, and the vendor tracking standard. Validate the ten SOPs the team touches most. Present the founder the first weekly ops view and your 90-day plan.

Key Responsibilities





Pipeline: Own the production pipeline end to end. Confirmed events in within 24 hours. Every project staged, scoped, and scheduled before planning begins.



Pre-production: Run internal pre-production meetings. Shooting schedules from the client run of show. Equipment planning. Crew confirmed with a backup day. Call sheets out early.



Crew & vendors: Confirm, brief, and hold crew to the Production Policy. Track every vendor to the deadline with proof of progress. Invoiced hours match Connect Team.



Communication: Enforce the communication lines: up and then over, one owner per thing, client communication through the project lead. Model the three-channel, daily-until-received standard.



Quality & delivery: Own the video review tracker. Nothing ships without the QC pass. Revision rounds and scope creep handled as the changes they are.



Systems & SOPs: Own the operations manual. Turn recorded processes into SOPs, move SOPs to Validated, and retire the ones the team has outgrown.



People: Run training assignments and onboarding. Screen and coordinate hires. Process contractor payments on payday.



Reporting: One weekly operations view for the founder with insight and a recommendation.



What You Bring



5+ years running operations, production management, or project management in a production company, agency, events business, or other deadline-driven services company.

Proven ownership of a multi-project pipeline with remote crew and contractors.

Fluency in ClickUp or an equivalent PM system, and the discipline to keep it matching reality.

Vendor and crew management with a track record of catching problems weeks out, not days.

Clear, direct written and verbal communication; comfortable holding people to the standard.

Familiarity with video production is a strong advantage. You do not need to shoot or edit, but you need to understand what the editor needs from the shooter and what the client was promised.



Who You Are



You are an owner of outcomes, not a scheduler of tasks. You look people in the eye and tell them they are your bottleneck. You check in daily and it does not feel like nagging to you, because the alternative is a project quietly dying. You dig when something sounds too good, and you never take a vendor’s word for it. You can take a company that runs on the founder’s memory and make it run on a system.



How To Apply



Reply with your resume, a one-paragraph cover letter, and a Loom video (max 5 minutes) explaining why you are the right Operations Manager for RDM.

title: Video Editor
description:
The One-Sentence Test



If the Lead Editor still has to open every timeline to know whether it is on time, on brand, and QC-clean, this role is not working. The right Video Editor owns the cut from selects to delivery so the Lead Editor can lead and the founder can direct.



The Mission



Turn raw event footage into finished deliverables that make the client look world-class and that their audience actually watches. You own recaps, full sessions, testimonials, and short-form reels from prep through 
 delivery, working inside RDM’s post-production SOPs in DaVinci Resolve. There are two scoreboards on every project: the client’s — delivered as promised, on time, at the counts agreed — and the audience’s — who stopped scrolling, how long they watched, how many finished. You are accountable to both.



What Winning Looks Like



Every deliverable ships inside its turnaround window, at the count that was sold.

Cuts clear internal QC on first submission, and the share of client approvals without a second revision round rises every quarter.

Every piece has a hook, a middle, and an ending you can defend, and at least one moment the client asks how we got.

Names, titles, and specs are right every time — verified against a source, never from memory.

Revisions come back with every note handled, and version history in 
 stays clean.

You know how each piece performed out of ten for that client, and why.



Your First 30 Days



Days 1–7 — Absorb. Read the playbook and the editor SOPs. Watch the last year of RDM output — recaps, reels, sessions, testimonials — until you can say how we open, how we pace, and what we consider finished. Set up Resolve to our conventions.



Days 8–14 — Selects and Short-Form. Paper edits, impact statements, B-roll selects, and your first reels through 
 with the Lead Editor reviewing.



Days 15–30 — Long-Form. Your first recap and full session end to end, through QC, to client delivery. Present the Lead Editor a short list of what in our SOPs you would tighten, and why.



Key Responsibilities



Prep: Paper edits from transcripts, impact statements pulled from A-roll, clean B-roll selects timelines.



Long-form: Recaps, full multi-cam sessions, testimonials, and documentary-style pieces — synced, leveled, color-matched, branded.



Short-form: Vertical reels from approved impact statements: hook, B-roll, branding, captions, export.



Technical: Color correction, multi-speaker dialogue matching, brand design language, media management, and timeline sharing.



QC & delivery: Count against scope, watch every second, verify every name, check specs. Revisions upload over the original in 
. Handle every note.



Performance: Review the numbers after posting. Know how each piece did out of ten for that client.



System: ClickUp status against the WBS, Connect Team hours, a daily end-of-day report, and SOP improvements when you find a better way.

title: Lead Generation & Generation Specialist
description:
# Lead Research & Generation Specialist — iMarketU



## About the Role



iMarketU is a digital marketing and automation agency looking for a detail-oriented specialist to research potential clients and organize actionable prospect information in Google Sheets.



We help businesses with websites, lead capture, marketing, and follow-up systems. Your role is to find businesses that could benefit from these services and document why they are a good fit.



## Responsibilities



- Research prospects using targeted keywords, industry terms, and locations.

- Find recent public posts or requests showing buying interest, such as “looking for a web designer,” “need a business website,” or “recommend a marketing agency.”

- Identify other suitable businesses with observable website or marketing gaps, clearly labeling them as cold prospects.

- Find relevant decision-makers and check business contact details against public sources.

- Maintain a clean Google Sheet with consistent formatting, filters, clear statuses, and no duplicates.

- Include the source link, date found, and evidence supporting each prospect’s potential need.

- Provide regular updates on the strongest opportunities.



## Required Google Sheets Information



Business name, industry, location, website, contact name and role, public business
 or phone, relevant social profile, source link, date found, identified need, evidence of interest, lead status, and notes.



Clearly distinguish:

- **Expressed interest:** A business has publicly requested relevant help.

- **Cold prospect:** The business appears suitable, but interest is unconfirmed.

- **Qualified opportunity:** Interest and fit have been confirmed through a conversation.



Do not guess budgets, invent contact information, or label a business interested solely because its website needs improvement.



## Requirements



- Strong online research and keyword-search skills.

- Confidence using Google Sheets.

- Attention to detail and clear written communication.

- Understanding of websites and digital marketing services.

- Ability to prioritize relevant, current opportunities over large contact lists.



This role initially focuses on research and list building. Outreach and appointment setting are separate unless specifically assigned.



## How to Apply



Send a short introduction, relevant experience, availability, and a sample of a lead sheet you have created, with private client information removed.

title: Video Editor — High-End Real Estate Reels
description:
What you'll be editing

Property reels — vertical, under 60 seconds. Cinematic, dynamic, cut to the music. Drone aerials are a core part of every edit, not a filler shot.

Agent brand reels — talking-head format, under 50 seconds. The agent's voice carries the piece, cut around a day-to-night arc with b-roll of the property and the neighborhood.

Listing videos — longer-form walkthroughs for YouTube and listing pages.

Typical raw delivery is 60–70 clips per house, ground and aerial, plus audio where the agent speaks.

What we expect from the edit

Clean rhythm. Cuts land on the track, not near it.

Music-first pacing. A different royalty-free track each video, chosen to fit the property. Music is burned into the export so it clears both Instagram and YouTube.

Modern bold subtitles with a per-video accent color. We specify the color in the brief.

Effects that bookend the piece — one at the open, one at the close, plus motion through the middle. Open-door transitions, speed ramps, subject tracking, tasteful zoom-ins on the agent.

Color that matches the brief. Some edits are soft and filmic, some are sharp and punchy. You adjust.

You pick the strongest takes yourself. We will not timestamp every shot for you.

Requirements

2+ years editing short-form video, ideally real estate, hospitality, luxury, or automotive.

Premiere Pro or DaVinci Resolve, plus After Effects for motion and transitions.

Strong color grading — you can match mixed ground and drone footage into one consistent look.

Comfortable with 
 for delivery and revision notes, and Slack for day-to-day communication.

Reliable written English. You need to read a brief and ask the right question when something is unclear.

Turnaround: first cut within 48 hours of receiving footage. This is our client promise and it does not move. If you cannot commit to that in a given week, you tell us before we send the project, not after.

Nice to have: drone footage experience, sound design instinct (whooshes, risers, ambience), basic photo retouching.

How we work

Footage goes to you through

 timeline. Everything else happens in Slack.

Project-based to start, paid per video. Volume is steady and growing — editors who consistently deliver on time move to first priority on incoming work and a higher rate.

Rate: [$___ per reel / $___ per listing video] — tell us your rate per finished 60-second vertical reel.

Trial edit

Everyone who makes the shortlist gets the same trial. We send you one real property — ground and aerial footage — with the same written brief our editors get. You deliver one vertical reel under 60 seconds.

Free, one round, no revisions. We are not asking you to work for us for free, we are looking at how you cut.

The trial footage never goes to a client. It is an old project we already delivered.

48 hours, same as a real job, so we both see how the deadline actually feels.

Answer within two days of your delivery. If it lands, you are on the roster and your first paid project goes out that week.

How to apply

2–3 vertical reels you personally cut. Real estate preferred. Links only. Tell us exactly what you did on each if you worked on a team.

Your rate per finished reel and realistic weekly capacity.

Where you source royalty-free music, and one track you would use for a $3M modern home in the Hollywood Hills.

Software you cut on.

dia clip (e.g., right-wing manosphere rhetoric, business grifts, or corporate gentrification narratives) and dig up the deep historical context, hidden financial data, and archival counter-arguments that completely expose the absurdity of the clip. Media buying, performance marketing, or digital ad arbitrage experience is a major asset.

title: Marketing Technology & Automation Specialist
description:
# Marketing Technology & Automation Specialist



### GoHighLevel | AI | Automation | Websites | SEO | Content



**Location:** Philippines — Remote

**Position:** Full-Time

**Schedule:** Must have meaningful overlap with U.S. Central Time



We are looking for a highly resourceful Marketing Technology & Automation Specialist to support multiple growing U.S.-based service businesses.



This is **not just a GoHighLevel position.**



We need someone who can become the technical person behind the scenes who makes things work.



You may be building a GHL workflow in the morning, troubleshooting an integration later that day, updating a website, fixing an indexing problem, helping launch a Meta campaign, setting up an AI automation, or turning a long-form podcast into short-form content.



You don't have to be the world's best expert in every one of these areas.



You **do** need to be technically strong, extremely resourceful, willing to learn, and able to take ownership of projects without needing someone to constantly follow up with you.



## Your Core Responsibilities



You will help manage and improve:



**GoHighLevel**



* CRM setup and maintenance

* Workflows and automations

* Pipelines

* Funnels and landing pages

* Forms and surveys

* Calendars

*
 and SMS campaigns

* Lead nurture systems

* Database reactivation

* Reputation management

* GHL AI tools

* Subaccounts and snapshots

* Reporting and troubleshooting



**Automation & Integrations**



* Zapier

* Make

* Webhooks and APIs

* Meta/Facebook lead 

* Google integrations

* Calendar integrations

* Forms and lead routing

* Troubleshooting failed automations and integrations



**Websites & Funnels**



* GHL and/or WordPress

* Landing pages

* Website updates

* Forms

* Domain/DNS management

* Mobile optimization

* Tracking pixels

* Google Analytics

* Google Tag Manager

* Google Search Console



**SEO**



* On-page SEO

* Technical SEO

* Local SEO

* Keyword research

* Google Business Profile

* Search Console

* Indexing

* Service and location pages

* Basic SEO reporting



**AI & Technology**



* ChatGPT, Claude, or similar AI platforms

* AI-assisted workflows

* AI agents and automations

* Content generation and repurposing

* Researching and implementing new technology when it can actually improve the business



**Content & Video**



* Turn long-form videos and podcasts into short clips

* YouTube Shorts

*
/Instagram Reels

* Captions and subtitles

* Basic thumbnails and graphics

* Canva, CapCut, Descript, or similar tools

* Uploading, formatting and scheduling content



**Paid Marketing Support**



* Meta/Facebook Ads

* YouTube/Google Ads

* Lead forms

* Pixels and conversion tracking

* Retargeting

* Audiences

* Basic campaign setup and reporting



## What Matters Most



Technical ability matters.



**Execution matters more.**



We are specifically looking for someone who:



* Finishes projects.

* Meets deadlines.

* Communicates without being chased.

* Gives clear beginning-of-day and end-of-day updates.

* Works priorities one at a time through completion.

* Tests their work before saying it is finished.

* Identifies problems proactively.

* Researches solutions independently.

* Asks questions when necessary instead of sitting stuck.

* Documents systems so someone else can understand them.

* Can manage their own workload and commitments.

* Tells us BEFORE a deadline when there is a problem — not after the deadline passes.



If you need someone constantly asking:



**“Is this done yet?”**



this position is probably not for you.



We don't expect perfection.



We **do** expect ownership.



## Who We Are



You will initially support two businesses:



**Uptown Window cleaning** a window cleaning and pressure washing company



**BBV — Building Better Business Ventures** — a growing business platform helping service-business owners with staffing, marketing, automation, systems and business growth.



This means the systems you build won't simply be internal projects. As BBV grows, many of these systems may ultimately be deployed across client businesses.



We therefore care about building things **cleanly, repeatably and correctly.**



## What We Want to See When You Apply



Please send:



1. A short introduction about yourself.

2. Your years of GoHighLevel experience.

3. Examples/screenshots or Loom videos of GHL systems you personally built.

4. Websites or funnels you personally built.

5. Examples of automations or integrations you created.

6. SEO work you've performed and the results.

7. Examples of video/content work you've produced.

8. Your experience with Meta, Google or YouTube advertising.

9. The AI tools you currently use and how you use them.

10. Your expected monthly compensation in PHP/USD.



### And answer these three questions:



**1. Tell us about a technical problem you didn't know how to solve when it was assigned to you. How did you figure it out?**



**2. Tell us about a project where you were going to miss a deadline. When did you tell your manager, and what did you do about it?**



**3. You are given five projects Monday morning, but realistically you can only finish three by Friday. What do you do?**



Please do not use AI to give us the answer you think we want.



We would rather hear an imperfect answer from you than a perfect answer from ChatGPT.



## Hiring Process



Qualified applicants will complete:



**Step 1:** Application review

**Step 2:** Technical interview

**Step 3:** Practical skills test

**Step 4:** Final interview



The practical test will involve completing real-world GHL/automation tasks so we can evaluate how you think, build, troubleshoot, communicate and finish work.



We're looking for someone who can become a long-term technical member of our team — not simply someone waiting for their next freelance project.

title: Personal Assistant, Social Media Management
description:
Hey 👋

I run an AI content agency and I'm looking for a personal assistant to work closely with me and keep things running smoothly.



What the role actually is



You'll be posting videos to social media accounts using virtual phones, for both our own brands and our clients' brands. Alongside that you'll help me with general assistant work and coordinate with my editors so nothing falls through the cracks.



What the role is not



To be completely clear, this is not a content creation role. You won't be making videos or writing scripts. This is a personal assistant position focused on posting and keeping the agency organised.

Pay



$2 per hour, and I want to be upfront that this is fixed. The work itself is straightforward, which is why the rate is what it is. Please only apply if that genuinely works for you.

Someone seriously dedicated. Someone who takes pride in being reliable and doesn't need chasing.



I care far more about attitude than experience here. If you're hardworking, communicative and genuinely want to help the agency grow, you'll do well. The tasks are simple but they need doing properly and consistently, every single day.



Room to grow



I'm building this agency and I want people who grow with it. If you're brilliant at this, there's real scope to take on more over time.



How to apply



Tell me in a few sentences why you'd be good at this and what your daily schedule looks like.



Looking forward to hearing from you 🙏

description:
We're The Exponential Oaks, a growing marketing technology agency based in the US (Atlanta, GA area). We help local businesses — mainly in health & wellness, beauty, and home services — get found and get booked through websites, SEO, paid advertising, and social media. We're a small, fast-moving team looking for a dedicated part-time designer to join us long-term.



What you'll do:



Work directly with our Paid Ads Manager to design creative for Meta 
/Instagram) ad campaigns, data-driven graphics, before/after visuals, stat/results cards, and client portfolio carousels.

Turn campaign briefs and performance feedback into finished creative quickly. You're producing what live campaigns actually need, not designing in isolation.

Iterate on creative based on real performance data (e.g., refreshing an ad once it's been running a few weeks or a hook stops converting).

Work primarily in Canva, with room to use Adobe Creative Suite if you have it.

Scope may grow to include broader social media content and scheduling as our needs expand.



What we're looking for:



A strong portfolio with real ad or social media creative, not just general design work.

Comfortable taking direction from a performance-marketing angle, creative changes because the data says so, not just because it "feels stale".

Fast turnaround, comfortable with iterative feedback.

Able to work independently across the time zone gap. You'll get detailed briefs and feedback, but real-time back-and-forth with the team will be limited.

Reliable internet connection and your own equipment for design work.



Nice to have:



Familiarity with Meta Ads Manager or what makes an ad creative perform (CTR, hook strength, frequency)

Video editing skills.

Prior experience working with a US-based agency or client.



How to apply: Please send:



-Your portfolio link with real ad/social creative samples

-Your available hours per week and typical working hours (please note your time zone (We're based in Atlanta, GA, roughly 12-13 hours behind the Philippines, so most collaboration will be async rather than real-time)

Educated to Degree Level in Accounting

3yrs Post Degree Level Experience

Self Starter who needs little instruction to carry out duties

title: Creator Partnerships & Production Coordinator Remote
description:
6FT CLUB® is a men’s confidence and footwear brand based in Los Angeles. We are hiring a highly organized, proactive Production Coordinator to help us consistently find creators, coordinate product-content shoots, and manage creator partnerships from outreach through final delivery. This is not a general administrative assistant position. Your primary responsibility will be helping us produce a reliable stream of high-quality video content featuring our height-increasing insoles and shoes. 



MAIN RESPONSIBILITIES:



1) Coordinate Los Angeles Studio Shoots



Our height-increase shoes are stored at our creative studio in Downtown Los Angeles and cannot be mailed to creators. 



You will: 

Find male models, actors, UGC creators, and lifestyle creators located in the Los Angeles area. 

Identify talent who can travel to our DTLA studio. 

Contact candidates and confirm their interest, rates, availability, clothing sizes, and shoe sizes. 

Coordinate shoot dates between the brand owner, studio availability, creators, photographers, and videographers. 

Send confirmations, call sheets, reference images, shot lists, and reminders. 

Maintain backup talent in case someone cancels. 

Help make sure each shoot is properly prepared before anyone arrives. 

Track payments, content deliverables, releases, and usage rights. 



You will coordinate these shoots remotely from the Philippines. You will not be expected to attend them in person. 



2) Recruit U.S.-Based UGC Creators



Our height-increase insoles can be mailed to creators throughout the United States. 



You will: 

Find TikTok, Instagram, YouTube Shorts, and UGC creators who match the brand. 

Conduct personalized outreach through
 and direct messages. 

Explain the collaboration and negotiate reasonable creator rates. 

Collect shipping information and product-size requirements. 

Coordinate product shipment with our team. 

Provide creators with clear briefs, references, deadlines, and talking points. 

Follow up until the content is delivered. 

Organize finished content, creator information, agreements, and usage rights. 

Build ongoing relationships with reliable creators. 



3) Evaluate Brand Fit



Our ideal audience includes men interested in confidence, dating, style, fitness, grooming, self-improvement, and personal presentation. 



Strong creator candidates will generally be: 

Male, approximately 21–35 years old. 

Based in the United States. 

Comfortable creating authentic, natural short-form video. 

Visually aligned with a modern men’s lifestyle brand. 

Able to communicate the product benefit without making the content feel embarrassing, deceptive, or overly promotional. 

Followed by an audience that includes young professionals and men interested in improving their appearance and confidence. 

Many of our customers are Latino and Asian men, but creators from all backgrounds should be considered when they naturally fit the brand.

Follower count is less important than content quality, audience fit, communication, and reliability. We are generally interested in creators with approximately 10,000–150,000 followers, as well as talented UGC creators who may have smaller audiences. 

Creators with an Amazon Storefront or experience producing Amazon video content are especially valuable. 



REQUIRED SKILLS

--------------------------------------

Strong written English. 

Excellent organization and follow-up. 

Experience with influencer outreach, UGC coordination, talent sourcing, social-media research, casting, or production coordination. 

Comfortable communicating with creators through
, TikTok, Instagram, and other platforms. 

Able to evaluate whether a creator genuinely fits a brand. 

Able to manage several creator conversations and deadlines simultaneously. 

Comfortable using Google Sheets, Google Drive, Notion, and project-management tools. 

Proactive and capable of moving projects forward without waiting for instructions every day. 

Detail-oriented when recording rates, deliverables, product sizes, deadlines, and contact information. 



WORKING HOURS

--------------------------------------

This is a part-time remote position of approximately 20 hours per week. 

Most work can be completed during normal daytime hours, but you must have some availability overlapping with Los Angeles business hours for creator communication, scheduling, and occasional meetings. We can establish predictable overlap hours rather than requiring you to remain online throughout the U.S. workday. 



WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

--------------------------------------

Within your first 60–90 days, you should be able to: 

Build an organized database of qualified creators. 

Maintain a steady outreach pipeline. 

Present a shortlist of genuinely brand-appropriate candidates each week. 

Consistently move creators from initial contact to confirmed collaboration. 

Coordinate Los Angeles studio shoots with minimal scheduling confusion. 

Reduce cancellations through confirmations and backup talent.

Track every creator, negotiation, shipment, deadline, deliverable, and usage agreement. 

Identify dependable creators we can hire repeatedly. 



COMPENSATION

--------------------------------------

Starting compensation will depend on experience and availability. We anticipate approximately 400 to 500 USD per month for 20 hours per week, with the opportunity to increase compensation based on performance and expanded responsibilities. 

This role may begin with a paid trial period. 



HOW TO APPLY

--------------------------------------

Please include the following: 

A brief introduction explaining your relevant experience. 

Examples of creator outreach, influencer marketing, casting, talent coordination, or production work you have completed. 

The tools you have used to find and manage creators. 

Your expected monthly salary for 20 hours per week. 

Your availability for overlap with Los Angeles business hours. 

A sample link to one TikTok or Instagram creator you believe would be a strong fit for 6FT CLUB®, along with two or three sentences explaining why. 

The word “ELEVATE” at the beginning of your application so we know you read the complete listing. 



*Generic or AI-generated applications that do not include a specific creator recommendation will not be considered.

title: Marketing Associate
description:
ABOUT US

 

We're a US-based financial planning firm. We publish a lot of educational content (YouTube videos, webinars,
 newsletters, and social media) for Americans who are approaching retirement. Our audience is older, thoughtful, and asks a lot of good questions.

 

Our marketing team is small and growing. We're looking for someone dependable to handle the day-to-day work that keeps everything running, so the team can focus on creating.

 

 

WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING

 

- Responding to social media comments. We'll give you a library of approved replies for the questions people ask most often. Your job is to respond promptly, politely, and consistently, and to flag anything unusual for us rather than guessing.

 

- Moderating our social accounts. Hiding spam, reporting fake accounts impersonating our company, and keeping our comment sections clean.

 

- Scheduling posts. Publishing content across our social platforms from a calendar we'll give you.

 

- Helping with webinars and
. Setting up registration pages, loading
 copy into templates, checking that links work, and scheduling sends. We'll train you on our tools.

 

- Keeping things organized. Uploading and labeling video files and images, following our file-naming conventions, maintaining simple trackers.

 

- Light reporting. Pulling a few numbers each week into a standing report.

 

 

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 

Required:

 

- Excellent written English. This is the most important requirement. You'll be writing replies that American readers see publicly, so your writing needs to be clear, warm, and error-free.

 

- Comfortable on social media platforms,
, Instagram, and YouTube at minimum. You should know your way around comments, posts, and basic account settings.

 

- Comfortable learning new software. We use HubSpot, WebinarGeek, and a few other tools. You do not need to know any of them already. You do need to be the kind of person who can watch a tutorial, read a help doc, and figure things out.

 

- Detail-oriented and reliable. Much of this job is doing small things correctly and consistently. If you're the person who notices the broken link or the typo, we want to talk to you.

 

- Good judgment about when to ask. We'd much rather you ask a question than guess.

 

- Reliable internet and a backup option, plus availability during our morning hours.



HOW TO APPLY

 

We read every application that follows these instructions.

 

Please start your message with the word ORANGE so we know you read the whole post.

 

Then answer these three questions briefly:

 

1. Tell us about a time you had to learn a new software tool on your own. How did you go about it?

 

2. Someone leaves this comment on one of our YouTube videos:

 

"Really enjoyed this one. Is there any way to get a copy of the chart you showed around the 12 minute mark? I'd like to go over it with my wife."

 

Write the reply you'd send.

 

3. What are your available hours in US Mountain Time, and how many hours a week are you currently committed to other clients?

 

Please include a link to your OnlineJobs.ph profile or a short resume.

 

Our process: Application review, then a short paid exercise (about an hour), then a 30-minute video call, then a paid trial period, then a permanent offer.

 

We reply to everyone we move forward with. Thanks for reading this far.

title: UGC TikTok Content Creator
description:
We’re looking for someone who can research successful TikTok content and create UGC-style videos based on what is already performing well.



This is not just a video editing position. You’ll be responsible for finding good content ideas, understanding why they work, and then creating your own TikTok videos inspired by those formats, hooks, topics, and trends.



The videos can cover different topics depending on what we’re working on, so you should be comfortable researching unfamiliar subjects and turning them into engaging short-form content.



What you'll do



* Research TikTok, Reels, Shorts, and other platforms to find high-performing content, hooks, formats, and trends

* Identify ideas that could work well for our accounts

* Come up with scripts or talking points based on your research

* Record yourself on camera creating natural UGC-style videos

* Edit videos into engaging TikToks with good pacing, captions, hooks, etc.

* Test different ideas and learn from which videos perform best



What we're looking for

* Comfortable speaking and appearing on camera

* Good spoken English with a natural/native-sounding delivery

* Your accent does not need to be perfect, but it should be easy to understand and not extremely strong

* Able to speak naturally rather than sounding like you're reading from a script

* Good understanding of TikTok / short-form content

* Able to research independently and recognize why certain videos perform well

* Reliable and able to produce content consistently



Previous UGC, social media, TikTok, content creation, marketing, or video editing experience** is a big plus, but not necessarily required if you're good on camera and willing to learn.



### Minecraft experience is a plus



Some of our content may be related to **Minecraft**, so experience with the game is useful.



If you currently play Minecraft or **used to play Minecraft in the past, please mention this in your application** and tell us roughly how familiar you are with the game.



This is **not a dealbreaker** if you have never played Minecraft.



## How to apply



Please send:



1. A short introduction about yourself.

2. Any UGC, TikTok, social media, marketing, or content creation experience you have.

3. Whether you have played Minecraft before and how familiar you are with it.

4. Links to any previous videos/content you have made, if available.

5. A short application video.



For the application video, record yourself on camera talking about whatever you want. It does not need to be professionally produced.



Please spend part of the video introducing yourself and talking about:



* Who you are

* Any marketing, UGC, TikTok, social media, or content creation experience you have

* Why you think you'd be good at researching and creating TikTok content



The main thing we want to see is how comfortable and natural you are speaking English on camera.



We're looking for someone we can potentially work with long term if it's a good fit. Also include your expected full-time salary.

title: Sales Floor Accountability Manager (Remote VA) — Lead Response Enforcement
description:
ABOUT US 🏠



We install whole-home water filtration and softening systems for homeowners across South Florida. About 30 installs a month at an average of $3,400 per job. Every lead costs us real money.



When a lead comes in and nobody calls it for two hours, that money is gone. That's the problem you're hired to kill.



THE JOB IN ONE SENTENCE ⏱️



Every lead gets contacted within 60 seconds. You are the person who makes sure that happens — every time, every rep, every day.



WHAT YOU'LL DO



Watch the lead queue live during your entire shift. New lead hits, your clock starts.

Track the 60-second window on every single lead assigned to a rep

Miss at 60 seconds → you immediately message the rep: "Lead #X is unworked. What's happening?"

No reply within 2 minutes → you pull the lead and reassign it to the next available rep online

Log every miss: which rep, which lead, how late, what the excuse was

Send the owner a daily scoreboard — response times by rep, misses, reassignments

Send a weekly report showing who's improving and who isn't

Flag repeat offenders to the owner. Same rep, same excuse, three times? Owner hears about it that day.

Confirm reps are actually logged in and available at the start of every shift



WHAT THIS ROLE IS NOT 🚫



You are not a salesperson. You don't close.

You are not a coach. You don't train reps.

You are not their friend. You're the referee.



You are the person who makes a grown adult uncomfortable about being late. If that sounds bad to you, don't apply.



WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR ✅



Required:



Thick skin. Reps will push back, make excuses, get annoyed at you. You hold the line anyway.

Obsessive about time. Seconds matter here, not minutes.

Comfortable holding adults accountable over chat and phone

Excellent written and spoken English

2+ years in operations, dispatch, team lead, QA, or a similar tracking role

You can sit on a live dashboard for hours without drifting

Reliable internet, quiet workspace, good headset

Available Sunday-Saturday 8 AM – 11 PM US Eastern Time (that's when leads come in, you won't be working every single hour of the day, the calls are scattered, we get around 10-15 leads daily and have 5 sales reps)



Nice to have:



Spanish

GoHighLevel, HubSpot, or similar CRM

Call center floor manager or dispatcher background

Home services, HVAC, plumbing, or roofing experience



WHAT WE OFFER 💰



Stable full-time position with a growing US company

Performance bonus tied to team average speed-to-lead. You push the number down, you get paid more.

Full authority to reassign leads. Nobody overrules you but me.





HOW TO APPLY — READ CAREFULLY ⚠️



Applications that skip any step will not be reviewed. This is on purpose. Attention to detail is the whole job.



Step 1 — Write "60 SECONDS" as the first two words of your application.



Step 2 — Tell us in a few sentences:



A time you had to hold someone accountable who didn't want to be held accountable. What happened?

Your internet speed (run a speed test, give us the number)

Your setup: headset, workspace, background noise

Your available hours in US Eastern Time

What CRMs or dashboards you've worked in



Step 3 — Record a voice sample (MOST IMPORTANT PART) 🎙️



Record yourself handling the scenario below like you're actually on the call. One continuous recording, 2–3 minutes.



Upload to Google Drive, Dropbox, or Vocaroo and paste the link. Make sure anyone can listen.



Do not write out the answer. Do not read a script in a flat voice. We want to hear how you actually sound.

title: Insurance Administration & Compliance Support | Australian Brokerage
description:
We are an Australian general insurance brokerage looking for a detail-oriented support professional to help our brokers keep client files organised, reconcile payments and manage policy administration.



This is an administrative, non-advice role. You will work under broker supervision and follow documented processes. Brokers retain responsibility for advice, recommendations, approvals and placement decisions.



WORK ARRANGEMENT AND PAY

Remote, Philippines-based. Full-time, 40 hours per week during Australian business hours (AEST/AEDT).

Salary: PHP 45,000-67,500 per month, depending on relevant experience and skills.



WHAT YOU WILL DO

- Reconcile insurer and network remittance reports against policy invoices and CRM records. Check policy numbers, client names, transaction types and commission amounts, identify discrepancies and maintain a clear exception list.

- Organise compliance files for new business, renewals and endorsements. Collect and correctly file quote
s, client acceptance, policy schedules, invoices, certificates and other required evidence.

- Check documents and records against checklists, identify missing or inconsistent information and follow up with the relevant team member. Escalate anything unclear rather than guessing.

- Keep CRM and broking-system records accurate, including policy details, file notes, products, activities and renewal reminders.

- Prepare files for broker review and track outstanding compliance actions. Only progress policy stages when the required checks and broker approvals are complete.

- Assist brokers with endorsements, policy changes, renewals, document requests, follow-ups and other day-to-day administrative tasks.

- Maintain organised electronic client folders and clear handover notes so another team member can readily understand the status of each file.



WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR

- Experience in insurance administration, broker support, financial-services administration or a closely related detail-heavy support role.

- Strong accuracy with spreadsheets, numbers, document comparison and data entry.

- Excellent written English and clear professional communication.

- An organised approach to competing priorities, follow-ups and deadlines.

- Good judgement about when to follow a process and when to escalate an exception.

- Respect for confidentiality and secure handling of client information.

- Reliable computer, internet connection and a suitable remote working environment.



HIGHLY REGARDED

- Experience supporting an Australian general insurance brokerage.

- Experience with SCTP, Sunrise and similar insurance quoting and policy administration platforms.

- Experience with payment or commission reconciliation, compliance file preparation, endorsements and renewals.

- Knowledge of general insurance products such as business insurance, public liability, professional indemnity, property, landlord and commercial motor insurance. General insurance experience is particularly relevant; this is not a life insurance sales role.



HOW TO APPLY

Please apply through OnlineJobs.ph and include:

1. Your CV and a short summary of relevant insurance or administration experience.

2. The systems you have used and your level of experience with spreadsheets.

3. An example of a payment discrepancy or incomplete file you identified, how you checked it and when you escalated it. Use an anonymised example without client information.

4. Your availability, earliest start date and expected monthly salary in PHP.

5. A short answer to this scenario: a remittance shows a payment, but the CRM amount differs and the compliance file is incomplete. What would you check, and what would you avoid changing until clarified?



We value careful, reliable work and clear communication. Please do not include confidential client records or documents in your application.

title: Appointment Setter / Lead Nurturer (UK Hours) — GoHighLevel | Base + Uncapped Commission
description:
Bright Future Digital is a UK digital marketing and lead-generation agency. We're hiring an appointment setter who can;

- Work our leads properly — nurture them, 

- Follow up relentlessly, 

- Book qualified sales calls. Our founder closes; you fill his calendar.



There are three sides to the role: 

1. Book qualified sales calls for our new-client pipeline. You set the appointment, our founder closes it.

2. Make outbound and cold calls to prospect lists we provide or that you source yourself — open the conversation and book the appointment.

3. Call and qualify leads coming into our lead-generation websites, then hand the hot ones over to our clients as premium, ready-to-buy leads.



Day to day, that means:

• Respond to every new lead FAST — within 15 minutes during working hours.

• Make consistent outbound/cold calls to provided and self-sourced prospect lists.

• Follow up persistently across call, SMS,
 and WhatsApp until you get a yes or a clear no.

• Qualify every lead: right decision-maker, genuine need, budget capacity, timeline.

• Book appointments into our calendar, then confirm and remind so people actually show up.

• Keep our GoHighLevel CRM spotless — every lead dispositioned with clear notes.

• Report your numbers to us every week.

What good looks like (the standard your base pays for)

This is a proactive, high-activity seat, not a wait-for-the-phone one. To hold the role you’ll consistently:

• Hit the 15-minute response time on inbound leads during UK hours.

• Make a steady daily volume of outbound dials and structured follow-ups (we’ll agree the number in week one based on the lists — but this is a phone-first role, every day).

• Keep every lead moving through the pipeline with clean, current CRM notes — no lead left untouched.



We track this because our last arrangement failed when leads were left to go cold. Working the leads is the job. Quality beats volume: we cap booked closing calls at a manageable number per week, so your focus is on booking the right meetings that convert, not filling a calendar.



You’re a great fit if you

• Have 2+ years in appointment setting, sales, or outbound.

• Know GoHighLevel well (or a very similar CRM and can learn GHL fast).

• Speak and write excellent English.

• Can work UK business hours (9am–5pm UK time).

• Are organised, genuinely persistent, and understand how lead gen and digital marketing work.

• Have a reliable computer, a good headset, and fast, stable internet.



Compensation (USD) — base plus uncapped commission

We reward closed business, not just a full calendar. The money is weighted toward deals that actually land:

• Base: $500/month, paid bi-weekly, for meeting the daily activity and response standard above.

• + $15 for every appointment that is genuinely qualified and attends. “Qualified” is objective and agreed up front: confirmed decision-maker, stated budget, genuine need, booked and attended — all logged in the CRM.

• + 10% of the first invoice (setup + first month) on every deal that closes, or a flat $150 per close, whichever is higher.

• Uncapped. The more deals you help close, the more you earn — there is no ceiling.



What to realistically expect: 

in a normal month a productive setter earns $300–$800 in commission on top of base — around $800–$1,300 total. The real upside is on closes, so a setter who books well-qualified meetings that convert earns considerably more, and the strongest push toward $1,500+. We won’t quote you an inflated “guaranteed” number — your work rate and the quality of your bookings d
 it, and we’ll be straight with you about volumes from day one.



How this starts — a paid trial with a real gate

The first 30 days is a paid trial on live leads. We’ll agree clear activity and booked-appointment targets in week one. Hit them and you move into the ongoing role with a clear path toward a closing seat and higher commission. It’s a genuine working trial for both of us — we’re building a long-term seat, not filling a gap.



How to apply (read carefully)

1. Send a 2–3 minute audio or Loom recording introducing yourself and telling us about a time you turned a cold or difficult lead into a booked meeting.

2. Tell us which CRMs you’ve used and your experience with GoHighLevel.

3. Start your application with the word “TRADES” so we know you read this properly. Applications without it are deleted.

We reply to every serious applicant.

Required

Tech savvy

 marketing and lead conversion experience

Competitive compensation based on experience

Remote work environment

We run a busy residential & commercial cleaning company in Calgary, Canada. We get new leads everyday from Google and our website. Your single focus: answer calls fast, contact every lead, follow our script, and book as many jobs as possible.



This is a full-time, long-term role for someone who likes structure, talking to people, and doing important, repetitive work at a high level.



What you will do:



Answer inbound calls from homeowners & renters looking for cleaning.

Call and text new leads within 5 minutes of inquiry (Google LSA + website forms).

Follow our script to ask questions, give prices, and book jobs in our booking system.

Work all unbooked leads through our follow-up cadence (multiple calls & texts over several days).

Confirm details with customers and keep notes accurate in our CRM.

Invite one-time customers to become recurring clients and record those correctly.

Outbound Sales.

Handle simple
 changes and basic reschedules.



SCHEDULE (Mountain Standard Time)

We are hiring 2 Sales VAs and will assign you to one of these fixed schedules:



Role A (Mon–Fri, off Sat–Sun):



Mon: 8 a.m.–8 p.m.

Tue: 8 a.m.–8 p.m.

Wed: 8 a.m.–2 p.m.

Thu: 8 a.m.–2 p.m.

Fri: 8 a.m.–2 p.m.



Role B (Wed–Sun, off Mon–Tue):



Wed: 2 p.m.–8 p.m.

Thu: 2 p.m.–8 p.m.

Fri: 2 p.m.–8 p.m.

Sat: 8 a.m.–8 p.m.

Sun: 8 a.m.–8 p.m.



REQUIREMENTS

Excellent spoken & written English.

Stable internet, good headset, quiet workspace.

Experience in phone-based customer service or sales is a big plus.

Comfortable making many calls and following a script.

Reliable, detail-oriented, okay with repetitive work (this is how you earn more).

Experience with GHL preferred (Not required) 



COMPENSATION

Fixed base hourly rate (paid in USD, full-time).

$ Bonus per completed job you book.

$ Bonus per new recurring client who completes their second clean.

+ more incentives to be put in place



HOW TO APPLY:

First line must start with:

"I actually read everything – [Your First Name] – 7 + 5 = ?"

Then answer the math



In the second line, write which schedule you prefer: Role A or Role B and why.

Paste a link to a 1–2 minute voice recording introducing yourself.

Paste your internet speed test link..

Any application that does not follow these exact steps will be ignored.

title: Female Care Liaison - Long Term Work
description:
ABOUT THE ROLE



We are looking for a professional, compassionate, and highly organized Client Care Coordinator / Care Liaison to join our growing U.S.-based care services team.

This is a full-time, long-term work-from-home position for someone with excellent English communication skills who enjoys helping people, following up, resolving concerns, and making sure clients receive consistent support.



WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Handle inbound and primarily outbound calls with clients, families, Care Providers, and other contacts.

- Assist with client concerns, updates, follow-ups, and ongoing care needs.

- Coordinate information and follow-ups with internal departments.

- Monitor active cases and help ensure continuity of service.

- Maintain accurate and timely documentation of calls, updates, and follow-ups.

- Build positive and professional relationships with clients, families, Care Providers, and other contacts.

- Proactively identify concerns or pending matters and make sure they are properly followed through.



WE'RE LOOKING FOR SOMEONE WHO

- Has excellent spoken and written English.

- Is confident and comfortable handling both inbound and primarily outbound phone calls.

- Has previous experience in BPO, customer service, client support, healthcare support, or a similar role.

- Communicates naturally and professionally and is comfortable speaking with U.S.-based clients.

- Is compassionate, patient, organized, and attentive to detail.

- Has strong follow-up skills and does not need constant reminders to complete responsibilities.

- Is proactive, dependable, and takes ownership of assigned tasks.

- Can handle difficult conversations and concerns professionally.

- Is comfortable working independently while coordinating with a team.





WORK REQUIREMENTS

- Must be available to work full-time on a U.S. PST/PDT schedule.

- Must not currently be employed part-time or full-time.

- Must be able to start immediately.

- Must have a reliable laptop or desktop computer.

- Must have a reliable high-speed internet connection.

- Must have a quiet and distraction-free workspace.

- Must be comfortable being on camera throughout the work shift via Google Meet for attendance and collaboration purposes.

- Must have a reliable backup internet and power source, or be willing to acquire one.

- Noise-cancelling headset is preferred.





HOW TO APPLY



Please
 your application to 
 with the following:



- Updated Resume – Submit your most recent resume reflecting your current and previous work experience.

- Introduction Video – Submit a short video introducing yourself. Tell us about your background, why you believe you would be a good fit for this position, and what you can contribute to the company. Please speak naturally and do not read from a prepared script.

- Internet Speed Test – Submit a recent screenshot of your internet speed test showing both download and upload speeds.

- Computer Specifications – Submit a screenshot showing your computer's RAM and basic system specifications.

- Workstation Photo – Submit a clear photo of your current work-from-home setup, including your computer and workspace.



Please ensure that all requested information and links are complete and accessible when submitting your application.



Only applicants who meet the minimum qualifications will be contacted for the next step of the hiring process.

title: Help Desk Engineer
description:
Tier I Help Desk Engineer 



About AlphaRidge 

AlphaRidge is the technology provider of choice for highly regulated industries with strict compliance and up-time requirements. From healthcare systems and hedge funds to government agencies and international sports clubs, our subject matter experts are recognized for their security-first approach and unparalleled customer service.



We are seeking a highly motivated, detail-oriented self-starter to join our team and help elevate our services to the next level.



Role

As a Tier One Help Desk Engineer, you will be the first point of contact for client IT support requests. You will be responsible for triaging all incoming tickets, providing initial troubleshooting and resolution, and ensuring timely escalation of unresolved issues to the appropriate engineering team, in accordance with established SLAs. Your technical expertise and strong communication skills will ensure clients receive prompt and effective support.



Responsibilities

• Triage and prioritize all incoming support tickets:

o Assess each request, gather relevant information, and determine the appropriate course of action.

o Attempt first-call resolution for all tickets within your scope and document all actions taken.

o Monitor ticket queues to ensure all tickets are addressed within defined SLAs.

o For tickets not resolved within the SLA or requiring higher-level expertise, assign and escalate to the appropriate engineer or team, providing thorough documentation of troubleshooting steps taken and relevant context.

• Provide Level I support for:

o Windows and Mac desktops and laptops

o Windows Servers (2016, 2019, 2022)

o Remote Access (VPN)

o
 (Office 365)

o Printers

o Network (LAN/WAN/WLAN)

o Common business applications

• Document all client issues and time spent in the Autotask ticketing system.

• Perform supervised maintenance on server and network systems, including but not limited to:

o Windows Servers

o Firewalls

o Switches

o Access Points

o Assist with hardware and software recommendations, acquisition, installation, and maintenance.

o Create, maintain, and update documentation for client environments and procedures.

o Train end-users on hardware and software systems as needed.

o Deliver excellent customer service and maintain a professional demeanor in all client interactions.

Qualifications

• 2+ years of experience in desktop support

• CompTIA A+ and Network+ certifications preferred

Skills/Experience

• Experience as a single point of contact for all types of support requests

• Strong understanding of PC hardware and current supported Microsoft operating systems (Windows 10/11)

• Experience with managing user accounts via Active Directory

• Experience with administration and support of Office 365

• Experience with Microsoft Windows Server versions 2016, 2019, and 2022

• Network infrastructure support: routers, switches, and firewalls

• Prior experience in a Managed Service Provider (MSP) environment is required

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills

• Strong organizational skills and attention to detail

• Ability to work independently and as part of a team in a fast-paced environment

• MSP experience is a must
