ABOUT US



We are a fast-growing company in the renewable energy industry expanding into nationwide eCommerce.



We are building an online store that will sell solar materials, solar equipment, complete solar kits, accessories, and training programs to customers across the United States.



We are looking for an experienced eCommerce Systems Architect / Implementation Specialist who can help us build the systems and infrastructure behind the business.



This is not primarily a product-upload or website-design position.



We need someone who understands how eCommerce systems connect together and can help us build a reliable, scalable operation from the ground up.

You will focus on the systems, integrations, automation, and infrastructure that support our eCommerce operation.



Our business will use a combination of:



Drop shipping from suppliers

Our own warehouse inventory

3PL fulfillment

Shipping and tracking systems

CRM and customer communication tools

Marketing platforms

Automation tools

Reporting and analytics



Your job will be to help design and connect these systems so information flows correctly between them.



You will work closely with our leadership and future eCommerce operations team.

Help evaluate and recommend the best eCommerce platform

Set up and configure the online store

Build product categories, collections, filters, variants, and product structures

Establish scalable product catalog standards

Recommend apps and tools where appropriate

Help establish inventory synchronization processes

Create rules for supplier-stocked vs. warehouse-stocked products

Help prevent overselling and inventory discrepancies

Develop processes for supplier inventory updates

Fulfillment & Shipping Systems

Help design drop-shipping workflows

Help establish warehouse fulfillment workflows

Connect the store with 3PL and fulfillment platforms

Configure shipping rules, rates, tracking, and fulfillment processes

Help establish order-routing logic

Troubleshoot fulfillment and integration issues

Integrations & Automation

Connect eCommerce with CRM systems

Connect
 marketing platforms

Connect analytics and reporting tools

Connect marketing platforms

Build automation workflows

Work with APIs or developers when custom integrations are required

Use tools such as Zapier, Make, Airtable, or similar platforms where appropriate

Identify opportunities to automate repetitive processes

Reporting & Data

Help establish reliable eCommerce reporting

Create dashboards or reporting workflows

Monitor inventory and order data

Help ensure data flows correctly between systems

Identify system/data issues before they become larger operational problems

Documentation & SOPs

Create clear SOPs for eCommerce systems

Document integrations and workflows

Document troubleshooting procedures

Create processes that can be followed by the operations team

Maintain system documentation as the business grows

EXPERIENCE WE ARE LOOKING FOR



The ideal candidate has hands-on experience with several of the following:



Shopify

title: Social Media Manager & Content Strategist
description:
About Postal People:

Postal People is a family-owned neighborhood shipping, mailbox, printing, business services, and gift shop located in San Francisco's Outer Sunset District.

We offer a wide variety of services including shipping, mailbox rentals, printing, notary services, passport photos, package receiving, business services, custom printing, gifts, and more.

We're a growing small business with a strong focus on customer service, community, and becoming the neighborhood's go-to resource for both residents and local businesses.



About the Role:

We are looking for an experienced Social Media Manager & Content Strategist to take ownership of our social media strategy, planning, content creation, publishing, and performance tracking. This is not simply a posting or general virtual assistant role.

We are looking for someone who understands the strategy behind social media and can help determine what we should post, why we should post it, who we're trying to reach, and how our content can support our business goals.

The right person will be proactive and able to research our business, audience, competitors, community, and current social media presence and turn those insights into an intentional and organized content strategy. We would like this person to start right away. If this job post is still up, the job is still available. We are open to a part-time or full-time role, please indicate when you apply what you are looking for.



Responsibilities:

-Strategy & Research

-Audit our existing social media presence

-Research our business, services, target audiences, local community, and competitors

-Conduct competitor and market analysis

-Identify opportunities to strengthen our online presence

-Develop and maintain an overall social media and content strategy

-Establish and refine content pillars

-Stay aware of relevant social media trends and opportunities

-Recommend new ideas based on performance, trends, and business goals



Content Planning:

-Develop monthly content calendars

-Build and maintain an organized content idea/library bank

-Proactively develop content ideas around our services, products, promotions, customers, community, educational topics, and behind-the-scenes activity

-Plan a balanced mix of promotional, educational, community, engaging, and brand-building content

-Identify opportunities to repurpose existing content across platforms



Content Creation:

-Create branded graphics using Canva

-Edit short-form videos and Reels

-Write captions, calls to action, and other social copy in our brand voice

-Create Stories and other appropriate social content

-Repurpose existing photos and videos into new content

-Maintain consistent branding, messaging, and visual identity



Because this is a remote position, our team will capture most in-store photos and videos. You will help lead this process by providing clear content requests, shot lists, filming instructions, talking points, examples, or other guidance so we know exactly what assets you need. We would like to develop an efficient batch-filming process whenever possible rather than constantly scrambling for content throughout the month.



Publishing & Community Management:

-Schedule and publish approved content

-Maintain a consistent posting schedule

-Monitor comments, messages, and audience engagement

-Create opportunities for conversation and community engagement

-Identify comments or messages that require our team's direct attention

-Help maintain an active and responsive online presence



Platforms:

Our primary platforms are:

-Instagram





We would also like lighter support or growth in:

-TikTok

-LinkedIn

-Google Business Profile

-Nextdoor



We do not expect completely unique content for every platform. We want someone who understands when content can efficiently be cross-posted or repurposed and when the caption, format, message, audience, or call to action should be adapted for a particular platform. *Experience with TikTok, LinkedIn, Google Business Profile, and/or Nextdoor is preferred but not required if you are willing and able to learn and manage them.



Analytics & Optimization:

-Monitor social media performance and audience growth

-Track engagement, reach, impressions, clicks, and other meaningful metrics

-Identify top- and low-performing content

-Provide a clear monthly analytics report

-Explain what the data means rather than simply reporting numbers

-Recommend changes based on performance

-Use insights to improve the following month's strategy and content plan



We are interested in more than follower counts and vanity metrics. Our goal is to build awareness, trust, engagement, and ultimately help more local customers discover and use Postal People's services in store.



Qualifications:

We're looking for someone who:

-Has professional experience managing social media for businesses or brands

-Has experience developing social media strategy, not just creating posts

-Understands audience, competitor, and market research

-Understands content pillars and strategic content planning

-Has strong written English and copywriting skills

-Has strong visual judgment and attention to detail

-Is experienced with Canva

-Bonus experience with GoHighLevel platform

-Can edit short-form video and Reels

-Is familiar with Meta Business Suite and/or social scheduling tools

-Understands social media analytics and performance reporting

-Is highly organized and able to manage a content calendar and asset library

-Can work independently and proactively

-Communicates clearly and consistently

-Can learn our business and brand rather than producing generic content

-Is comfortable recommending ideas and telling us what you need from us

-Not afraid to ask questions and confirms understanding

-Is interested in a long-term working relationship

-Experience with local businesses, service businesses, retail, hospitality, or community-focused brands is a plus.



What Success Looks Like:

We want our social media presence to become:

-More consistent

-More intentional and strategic

-More recognizable

-More locally relevant

-More engaging and useful

-Better organized

-Less dependent on the owners to constantly come up with content ideas

-More effective at keeping Postal People top-of-mind when someone needs one of our services



How to Apply:

Please include the following with your application:

-A short introduction and why you're interested in working with Postal People.

-Your resume/CV.

-Your portfolio and/or links to social media accounts you've professionally managed.

-For the accounts you share, tell us what you personally handled: strategy, research, content planning, graphics, video editing, captions, scheduling, engagement, analytics, etc.

-Briefly describe how you would approach your first 30 days managing social media for a local business like Postal People.

-After taking a quick look at Postal People online, tell us one content or social media opportunity you immediately see for our business.

-Which platforms have you professionally managed? Please specify Instagram,
, LinkedIn, Google Business Profile, Nextdoor, TikTok, or others.

-What tools do you use for planning, graphic design, video editing, scheduling, and analytics?

-What is your current availability for an interview and preferred working schedule?

-What is your expected hourly or monthly rate?



Please include SUNSET SOCIAL in your application subject line so we know you read the full posting.

title: Meta Ads & GoHighLevel Performance Marketer — Long-Term

title: Remote Medical Practice Manager
description:
We are a thriving acupuncture practice with clinics in California, with a culture that's positive, compassionate, and committed to patient satisfaction. Our founders built this business from the ground up and have worked every position in the company themselves. We're hiring a fully remote Medical Practice Manager, based in the Philippines, to lead our reception team and run our day-to-day practice operations, while also overseeing our insurance biller and keeping billing, reception, and patient coordination running smoothly.

Schedule

20–30 hours per week.

Required availability that overlaps with our Pacific Time (California) business hours, so you can coordinate in real time with reception, the insurance biller, and patients.

Cover a remote Saturday reception shift: phones, scheduling, and patient support.

Support resolution of non-clinical patient concerns.

Handle day-to-day communication 
, Slack) and other administrative tasks as needed.

title: News Writer (Freelance/Contract) — Technology & Electronics
description:
About the Role

We're hiring an English-language News Writer to cover consumer technology, electronics, new product announcements, and industry trends. You'll write short, high-impact news pieces in the Smart Brevity format — fast, clear, and built to be read on a phone. If you love tech and can turn a press release into a clean 300-word story in 20 minutes, we want to hear from you.



Responsibilities

• Write engaging, concise articles (~300 words) on technology and electronics news, product launches, and industry trends using the Smart Brevity format

• Produce a minimum of 3 articles per hour to meet tight deadlines

• Apply SEO best practices (keyword placement, headline structure, meta descriptions, internal linking) to maximize visibility

• Publish and manage content directly in WordPress

• Fact-check sources and confirm product names, specs, and dates before publishing



Requirements

• Proven expertise in consumer technology and electronics topics, with a strong grasp of industry trends and product announcements

• Exceptional command of written English — clear, polished, error-free, US English spelling and conventions (near-native fluency required)

• Familiarity with the Smart Brevity writing style (short lead, "why it matters," bulleted detail)

• Strong working knowledge of SEO practices

• A portfolio of published work with live links — at minimum 3 articles we can read online (personal site, Contently, Muck Rack, Google Doc of links, or direct URLs)

• Experience with WordPress or a similar CMS

• Reliable high-speed internet and a backup connection/power source

• Ability to work independently, hit deadlines, and hold quality under volume pressure



Preferred Qualifications

• Previous experience as a news writer, journalist, or content writer covering tech or electronics

• Portfolio weighted toward consumer electronics, gadgets, or general technology coverage

• Bylined work on an established tech publication or brand blog

• Comfortable using AI tools for research and drafting — but able to produce original, human-edited copy



How to Apply

Please reply with the following:

1. Your resume or CV

2. A brief cover letter (under 150 words — treat it as a writing test)

3. A link to your portfolio, plus 3 sample articles as live URLs (PDFs or pasted text will not be considered). If a piece was ghostwritten or behind a paywall, include a screenshot alongside the link.

4. Your rate expectations (per article or per hour) and weekly availability



Applicants who make it past the first round will complete a short paid writing test (2 articles). Applications are reviewed on a rolling basis.  Join us and help shape the conversation around cutting-edge technology.

title: Veteran Coach Assistant (VCA)
description:
Position Summary



The Veteran Coach Assistant (VCA) is the operational partner of the Veteran Coach, ensuring every veteran receives a seamless, organized, and timely experience throughout the claims process. This role is responsible for managing workflows, maintaining accurate documentation, coordinating appointments, tracking follow-ups, and ensuring no veteran or task falls through the cracks.



The Veteran Coach Assistant primarily focuses on operational support and account management. However, when business needs require, the VCA is fully cross-trained and may assume the responsibilities of a Veteran Call Coach, conducting veteran outreach and onboarding while maintaining service quality and continuity.

 

Key Responsibilities



Veteran Account Management

• Manage veteran accounts before, during, and after Veteran Call Coach outreach. 

• Review account history, lead source, ownership, previous notes, and current workflow before veteran engagement. 

• Ensure every veteran account progresses through the correct workflow and status. 

• Maintain clean, accurate, and up-to-date CRM records. 



Documentation & Workflow Administration

• Document all veteran interactions accurately and promptly. 

• Track: 

o Contact attempts 

o Call outcomes 

o Lead source 

o Warm/cold status 

o Callback schedules 

o Consultation status 

o Next action items 

• Ensure documentation meets company quality standards. 

• Maintain consistent workflow terminology and account organization. 



Scheduling & Follow-Up Coordination

• Schedule consultations, follow-up calls, and appointments. 

• Send reminders and written next steps to veterans when appropriate. 

• Coordinate follow-up activities between departments. 

• Ensure veterans never miss important appointments or deadlines. 



Call Coach Support

• Prepare accounts for Veteran Call Coach outreach. 

• Review post-call summaries and complete required administrative actions. 

• Update CRM records, schedule follow-ups, and move accounts through the appropriate workflow. 

• Identify missing information or incomplete next steps before they become service issues. 

• Escalate sensitive or complex matters requiring leadership attention. 



Cross-Functional Veteran Support

• Serve as the operational extension of the Veteran Call Coach to ensure continuity of care. 

• Collaborate with other departments to keep veteran cases progressing efficiently. 

• Help maintain one consistent veteran experience from initial contact through onboarding. 



Veteran Coach (As Needed)

• Conduct veteran outreach, onboarding, and follow-up calls when operational needs require. 

• Perform Veteran Call Coach responsibilities during staffing shortages, overflow periods, schedule coverage, or other business demands. 

• Deliver the same level of professionalism, empathy, and communication expected of a Veteran Call Coach. 

• Transition veterans back to the assigned Call Coach while ensuring complete documentation and continuity of care. 

 

Core Responsibilities

• CRM and account management 

• Lead workflow administration 

• Documentation and quality control 

• Scheduling and appointment coordination 

• Veteran follow-up management 

• Administrative support 

• Cross-functional communication 

• Veteran outreach when required 

• Process compliance 

• Operational support for Veteran Call Coaches

title: Driver Recruiter & Fleet Complaince Coordinator
description:
Hours: Full-time, 40 hours per week

Schedule: Monday through Friday with availability during U.S. Central Time

Compensation: $4.50 USD per hour 



ABOUT US



We are a family-owned U.S. trucking company operating approximately 15 trucks. We are looking for a motivated, dependable, and highly organized remote employee to assist with driver recruiting and eventually take on additional fleet operations, productivity, ELD, and safety-related responsibilities.



This position will begin with a strong focus on CDL driver recruiting. Your first priority will be helping us fill our available trucks with qualified drivers. As those positions are filled and you are trained in our systems, your responsibilities will expand into fleet productivity and compliance support.



PHASE ONE: CDL DRIVER RECRUITING



Your initial priority will be recruiting qualified CDL drivers.



Responsibilities will include:



* Post and maintain driver advertisements.

* Actively find qualified CDL drivers through job boards, social media,
 groups, referrals, and other recruiting sources.

* Respond promptly to calls, messages, and applications.

* Call and screen potential drivers.

* Explain our available positions, pay, equipment, routes, home time, and requirements.

* Review applicants’ experience, driving history, qualifications, and expectations.

* Identify serious candidates and move them through the hiring process.

* Follow up consistently with interested drivers.

* Schedule interviews, testing, orientation, and onboarding steps.

* Maintain an organized recruiting spreadsheet or applicant-tracking system.

* Keep candidates informed until they are hired or are no longer interested.



We are not looking for someone who only posts advertisements and waits. We need someone who actively searches for drivers, follows up consistently, and produces results.



EXPANDED RESPONSIBILITIES



After you are trained and our immediate recruiting needs are under control, the position will expand to include the following:



Driver Productivity



* Review the Motive dashboard once daily to monitor driver and truck activity.

* Identify drivers or trucks that are inactive, underutilized, or not generating expected revenue.

* Determine why equipment is not moving and follow up with the appropriate person.

* Report recurring downtime, productivity problems, or unusual driver activity to management.



ELD Monitoring



* Review the Motive ELD dashboard once daily.

* Check for possible log issues, missing certifications, or Hours-of-Service concerns.

* Identify ELD disconnections or drivers operating without being properly connected.

* Review and help resolve unidentified driving trips.

* Monitor Personal Conveyance usage and flag possible misuse.

* Contact drivers regarding corrections or missing information when instructed.

* Immediately report serious or recurring compliance concerns to management.



Safety and Compliance Support



* Review Motive safety data and driver behavior trends.

* Monitor company safety scores and identify areas that may need improvement.

* Track recurring concerns such as speeding, harsh braking, unsafe driving, Hours-of-Service violations, or maintenance issues.

* Review roadside inspection and violation records for possible errors.

* Identify records that may qualify for an FMCSA DataQs challenge.

* Gather supporting documents and prepare potential DataQs requests for management’s review and approval.

* Track the status and outcome of submitted DataQs requests.



DAILY CHECK-IN



You will have a brief check-in with the company owner each workday. The check-in will cover:



* What you completed that day

* Any qualified driver candidates

* Important issues requiring attention

* Your next steps

* Anything you need from the owner



The check-in is intended to be brief and maintain communication and accountability.



QUALIFICATIONS



* Strong spoken and written English

* Confident and professional phone communication

* Reliable internet connection and a quiet work environment

* Comfortable speaking with U.S. truck drivers

* Organized and comfortable using spreadsheets and online dashboards such as Tenstreet

* Able to work independently without constant reminders

* Strong attention to detail

* Able to handle a fast-paced environment and stressful situations professionally

* Persistent with follow-up without being unprofessional

* Willing and able to learn ELD, productivity, and safety procedures

* Previous experience with U.S. trucking or CDL driver recruiting is strongly preferred

* Experience with Motive or another ELD platform is a plus

* Familiarity with Hours-of-Service, Personal Conveyance, CSA/SMS scores, or DataQs is a plus



WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR



We need someone who takes ownership of their responsibilities, communicates when there is a problem, and follows through. You should be comfortable learning new systems and growing into a larger role as you demonstrate reliability and good judgment.

We are a growing YouTube media company running a portfolio of channels, and we are looking for a YouTube Analyst who genuinely enjoys digging into the numbers — CTR, average view duration, retention curves, traffic sources, RPM — and turning them into clear recommendations our creative team can act on this week.



This is not a data-entry job. You will be the person the team asks "why did this video pop and that one flatline?" — and your answer will d
 what we film, package, and publish next. If you have ever reverse-engineered a competitor's viral video just because you were curious, you will like it here.



The essentials up front, no guessing:



💰 Salary: starts at $400 USD/month, up to $700 USD/month depending on proven YouTube analytics experience. Paid twice monthly, on time, every time.

📈 Reviews: performance and pay review at 3 months and 6 months — this role is designed to grow.

🌏 100% remote / work from home — anywhere in the Philippines.

🕐 Full-time, 40 hours/week, flexible hours. Build your own workday. We only ask for a few overlapping hours with the team so reviews and handoffs are same-day, not next-day.

📅 Paid time off and paid Philippine holidays.

🎓 We pay for your tools and your learning — analytics platforms, courses, certifications.



What You'll Do



Channel performance analytics



Build and send a weekly YouTube performance report across our channels — views, watch time, CTR, average view duration (AVD), average percentage viewed, subscriber gain, traffic sources

Read retention curves and pinpoint where viewers drop off, then tell the editors exactly which timestamp to fix

Track every published video against its channel benchmark and flag winners and underperformers within 48 hours of upload

Maintain clean dashboards in Google Sheets (or Looker Studio) so anyone can see channel health at a glance



Niche & competitor research



Monitor competitor channels and surface outlier videos — the ones massively outperforming their channel average

Research new niches, formats, and content angles worth testing, with the data to back the recommendation

Do keyword and search-demand research (YouTube search, VidIQ/TubeBuddy/Google Trends) to find topics with real demand and beatable competition

Keep a living swipe file of high-performing titles, thumbnails, hooks, and formats



Title & thumbnail (packaging) testing



Run and log A/B tests on titles and thumbnails; report the CTR lift clearly

Score packaging before publish using our checklist, and recommend concrete iterations

Spot patterns: which thumbnail styles, faces, colors, and title structures actually earn clicks in our niches



Revenue & forecasting



Track RPM, CPM, estimated AdSense revenue, and revenue by geography and traffic source

Forecast monthly revenue and flag variances early, with a plausible explanation

Help identify which content types earn the most per 1,000 views, not just the most views



What You Need (be honest with yourself — this list is real)



1+ year of hands-on experience with YouTube analytics — as a channel manager, analyst, video SEO specialist, content strategist, VA for a YouTube channel, or on your own channel. Your own channel absolutely counts.

Confident in YouTube Studio Analytics: you know the difference between impressions CTR and AVD, and why both matter

Strong Google Sheets / Excel skills — pivot tables, lookups, charts. Formulas should not scare you.

Comfortable with at least one research tool (VidIQ, TubeBuddy, Social Blade, Google Trends, or similar) — or ready to learn one fast

Good written English: your reports need to be understood at a glance

Curious and self-directed. You notice things nobody asked you to look for.

Reliable internet, a working computer, and a quiet place to focus



Nice to have, not required



Experience with faceless / niche content channels, or multi-channel portfolios

Looker Studio, Google Analytics, or YouTube Data API experience

Any basic SQL or Python for data work

Copywriting instinct for titles and hooks



We would rather hire someone sharp with 1 year and real curiosity than someone with 5 years who has stopped asking questions. If you meet most of this list, apply.



How to Apply — Please Apply through this application form link: 





No cover letter template, please. We read every application that answers through the application form.



We are an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applicants of all backgrounds and hire on skill, curiosity, and reliability alone.



Ready? Apply now — we are reviewing applications as they come in and want this person onboard within the next few weeks.

title: Phone Sales & Dispatch Virtual Assistant - US Carpet Cleaning Company
description:
We’re a 40-year-old family-owned carpet cleaning company in Tulsa, Oklahoma, and our long-time virtual assistant is moving on. We’re looking for the next voice for our business - the person who answers our phones, books our jobs, and keeps our crew moving every single day. This is not a task-based gig. It’s a long-term seat on a small team, with scripts, training, monthly bonuses, and scheduled raises built in from day one.



WHAT YOU’LL DO

1. Phones and sales (most of your day)

• Answer inbound calls professionally using our call script and convert callers into booked jobs

• Respond to Google, text, and web leads within minutes and move them to a phone call

• Make outbound sales calls: follow up on open quotes, reactivate past customers, and introduce our services to acquired customer lists

• Handle common objections (“how much?”, “let me think about it”, “the other guy is cheaper”) the way our playbook teaches - never lead with price, always secure a next step

2. Dispatch and crew coordination

• Build and adjust the daily job schedule and routes in Housecall Pro

• Coordinate with our lead technician over WhatsApp: running late, reschedules, add-ons, job changes

• Confirm upcoming appointments and communicate arrival windows to customers

3. CRM and customer care

• Keep Housecall Pro clean: accurate customer records, job details (rooms, square footages, stains, pets), notes, lead-source tags, and follow-up tasks

• Prepare quotes in ResponsiBid

• Handle customer texts,
s, and property manager work orders

• Send review requests after jobs, respond to Google reviews, and post updates to our Google Business Profile

• Be the first response to customer issues, and escalate to the lead technician or owner when needed

• Light admin: database cleanup, verifying business listings, helping with
 campaigns



WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR

Required

*Excellent spoken English - clear, warm, and confident on the phone with American customers

*2+ years of phone-based customer service, sales, or appointment setting (US clients preferred)

*Comfortable being on the phone most of the day, including outbound calls

*Type accurate notes while talking - one wrong address or square footage number sends a crew to the wrong place

*Reliable setup: wired internet (25+ Mbps), backup internet and power, quiet dedicated workspace, noise-cancelling headset

*Available full-time on US Central hours (night shift in the Philippines), Monday-Friday

*Organized, coachable, and honest - you tell us when something goes wrong

Nice to have

• Experience with Housecall Pro, ResponsiBid, Jobber, ServiceTitan, or similar

• Dispatching or scheduling experience for a service business (cleaning, HVAC, plumbing, pest control)

• A previous long-term role with a US home services company



PAY AND GROWTH

Base pay: $7.00/hr, paid twice a month - on time, every time.

Monthly performance bonuses ( start after your first 30 days):

• Booking-rate bonus - hit the inbound booking target: +$0.50/hr

• Outbound bonus - hit the outbound booking target: +$1.00/hr

• Review bonus - hit the 5-star review target: +$0.50/hr

Hit all three and you earn $9.00/hr for the month. A strong VA in this sear should expect $8-9/hr most months. We’ll walk you through the exact scorecard in the interview  so you know precisely how to earn it.



Long-term growth timeline (base raises, on top of bonuses):

• 90 days: complete probation, full bonus eligibility confirmed

• 6 months: +$0.25/hr

• 1 year: +$0.50/hr plus a 13th-month anniversary bonus

• 2 years: +$0.50/hr plus eligibility for our Lead VA / Office Manager track (customer reactivation campaigns, commercial accounts, training future hires)



Hours: Monday-Friday, 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM US Central (roughly 9PM to 6 AM Philippine time; shifts one hour with US daylight saving). Occasional Saturday coverage may be offered as paid extra hours.



HOW TO APPLY

Attention to detail is critical in this job. Read carefully - applications that skip a step will not be reviewed.

1. Put the word SPOTLESS at the very top of your application so we know you read this whole post.

2. Record a 2-3 minute video (Loom, Google Drive, or unlisted YouTube link), on camera, in English:

• Introduce yourself and your phone experience ( about 1 minute)

• Then answer the phone as if you were us. Read this out loud like a real call:

- You: “Thank you for calling Carpet Renovations of Tulsa, this is [your name]! How can I help you today?”

- Caller: “Hi, how much do you charge to clean three rooms?”

- You: (respond however you would - we want to hear how you handle it)

3. Attach a photo of your workspace - your desk, computer, and headset, taken today.

4. Attach a screenshot of a recent internet speed test (speedtest.net).

5. Answer these three questions in your application:

• What hours can you commit to, in US Central time?

• Which CRM, scheduling, or phone tools have you used?

• Describe your Internet connection, backup power, and backup internet.

6. Attach your resume.



Hiring Process:

We review your video, photo, and answers, then invite the strongest candidates to a live video interview with the owner that includes a short phone role-play. Your first 90 days include full training on our call script, sales playbook, and systems.

If you love being on the phone, like winning the booking, and want to stable long-term role with a company that’s been around 40 years, we want to hear from you!

title: Limousine / Black-Car Dispatcher (Live Trip Dispatch, WhatsApp + Google Sheets) - Tri-State NYC Experience Preferred
description:
Empire Black Truck is a fast-paced limousine and black-car transportation company serving the New York Tri-State area. Trips are posted in WhatsApp groups throughout the day and can be claimed by another company within seconds, so our dispatchers have to stay focused, react quickly, and make fast but accurate decisions.



This is a live-operations role. If you enjoy fast decisions, constant coordination and keeping every trip and every dollar accounted for, you will do well here.



WHAT YOU WILL DO



1) Claim jobs fast, and only the right ones

- Monitor multiple WhatsApp groups where transportation jobs are posted all day.

- Before accepting a job, immediately check our drivers' live locations, current assignments and upcoming schedules to confirm we can cover it.

- Accept and claim jobs within seconds when we can cover them.



2) Assign and confirm

- Assign or pre-book the appropriate driver for each accepted job.

- Send the complete trip information to the driver and confirm the driver received and acknowledged it.

- Check for scheduling conflicts and prevent double bookings.



3) Monitor every active trip

- Track each trip in real time: driver on location, passenger on board, trip completed.

- If a driver is late, unresponsive or has an issue, act immediately: contact the driver, update the appropriate person, and arrange backup coverage when needed.

- Handle airport pickups, flight delays and last-minute schedule changes calmly.



4) Keep the tracking sheet perfect

Every job must be entered into our Google Sheets tracker with:

- Trip date and time

- Pickup and drop-off locations

- Passenger information

- Assigned driver

- Company that provided the job, and the specific dispatcher who sent it

- Total job amount, driver pay, expected profit

- Payment terms, due date, and payment status (paid, pending or late)

This is how we know exactly who gave us each job and who we need to follow up with for payment, so accuracy is not optional.



WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR



Required

- Previous dispatch or live-operations experience in a fast-paced, last-mile environment.

- Excellent spoken and written English; you will be communicating with drivers, affiliates and clients constantly.

- Strong internet connection (minimum 25 Mbps download / 10 Mbps upload) with a backup connection, plus a backup power source. You must be reachable at all times during your shift.

- Comfortable working U.S. Eastern Time hours, including early mornings, evenings or weekends depending on the shift assigned.

- Confident with WhatsApp (groups, voice notes, quick replies) and Google Sheets (data entry, filters, formulas at a basic level).

- Calm under pressure, extremely organized, and able to make quick decisions without waiting to be told.



Strongly preferred

- Experience in limousine, black-car, taxi/rideshare, NEMT, airport transportation, courier, or food-delivery dispatch.

- Working knowledge of the New York Tri-State area: JFK, LGA, EWR, Manhattan, Brooklyn, Queens, the Bronx, Westchester, Long Island, New Jersey and Connecticut - including typical drive times and traffic patterns.

- Experience dispatching from affiliate networks or job-posting groups where trips are claimed first-come, first-served.

- Familiarity with limo/black-car software or booking platforms.



Please note: 3PL trucking, truckload scheduling and HVAC dispatch experience can be helpful, but those industries operate very differently from limousine and taxi dispatch. If your background is only in those areas, please explain clearly in your application how you would handle live passenger transportation, airport pickups and jobs that must be claimed within seconds.



HOW TO APPLY



Apply with the subject line: BLACK CAR DISPATCHER - [YOUR NAME]



In your application, answer all of the following. Applications that do not answer every question will not be reviewed.

1. Describe your dispatch experience. What industry, how many drivers/trips per day, and what tools did you use?

2. Have you dispatched passenger transportation (limo, black car, taxi, NEMT, airport)? Give one specific example of a problem trip and how you solved it.

3. A trip is posted in a WhatsApp group: JFK pickup at 6:00 PM today, drop-off in Midtown Manhattan. Walk us through, step by step, exactly what you check and do in the first 60 seconds.

4. Attach a screenshot of a speed test (speedtest.net) taken on the connection you would use for work, and tell us your backup internet and backup power setup.

5. What hours are you available in U.S. Eastern Time?

6. How familiar are you with the NYC Tri-State area? Roughly how long is JFK to Midtown at 5:00 PM on a weekday?



Shortlisted candidates will complete a short paid live-dispatch trial (WhatsApp + Google Sheets) before hiring.

title: FINANCE & OPERATIONS COORDINATOR
description:
About the Role

 

We're looking for a highly organized and detail-oriented Finance & Operations Coordinator to support the financial and operational side of the business — maintaining accurate financial records, tracking invoices and payments, supporting purchase order management, preparing invoices, monitoring receivables and reimbursements, and providing cost and profitability analysis for wholesale orders and upcoming projects.

 

You're comfortable working with numbers, spreadsheets, invoices, purchase orders, and financial data, while also being proactive about following up with internal teams, suppliers, and partners to keep payments and financial tasks on track. This person plays an important role in helping the team maintain accurate financial visibility and make informed pricing and project decisions.

 

Key Responsibilities

 

Purchase Orders & Financial Records

- Add and maintain purchase orders in Katana accurately and in a timely manner

- Record and organize invoices, receipts, and payment documentation from partners, suppliers, and team members

- Maintain accurate records of business expenses and project-related costs

- Ensure financial documentation is properly organized and easily accessible

- Cross-reference POs, invoices, receipts, and project costs to identify discrepancies

 

Accounts Payable & Payment Tracking

- Track invoice due dates and maintain an organized payment calendar

- Send timely reminders to ensure supplier and partner invoices are paid on schedule

- Follow up internally on outstanding payments and approvals

- Track employee/team reimbursements and follow up on outstanding reimbursement requests

- Follow up on unpaid invoices and outstanding balances as needed

- Maintain visibility on upcoming financial obligations and communicate potential issues before payments become overdue

 

Accounts Receivable & Invoicing

- Prepare and issue invoices on behalf of UPRISERS

- Ensure invoices contain accurate project, product, pricing, and payment information

- Track outstanding customer/client invoices and payment status

- Follow up on overdue invoices and coordinate with the appropriate team members to resolve payment issues

- Maintain an organized record of invoices issued and payments received

 

Project Profitability & Financial Analysis

- Create profit projections for wholesale orders and upcoming projects

- Calculate estimated costs, revenue, gross profit, and margins for projects

- Review project costs and identify potential profitability concerns

- Assist the team in evaluating pricing before quotes or orders are finalized

- Compare projected costs against actual costs to help improve future pricing decisions

- Create financial summaries and reports for management review

 

Product Costing & Pricing Support

- Gather and maintain current costs for materials, blanks, manufacturing, printing, embroidery, packaging, shipping, and other product-related expenses

- Maintain an updated cost database to support accurate website pricing

- Ensure product pricing is based on the most current available cost information

- Work with suppliers and internal teams to obtain updated pricing when costs change

- Flag significant cost changes that may affect product margins

 

Cost & Merchandise Comparison

- Create comparison sheets and cost analyses for different merchandise options

- Compare suppliers, products, quantities, production methods, and associated costs

- Analyze different product options based on cost, margin, quality, and project requirements

- Present findings in an organized format to help the team make purchasing and merchandising decisions

- Maintain historical cost comparisons for future reference

 

Travel & Reimbursement Tracking

- Prepare monthly mileage/travel logs for reimbursement

- Maintain accurate records of eligible business travel and mileage

- Coordinate with team members to collect missing mileage or reimbursement information

- Submit completed reimbursement information according to company procedures

- Follow up on outstanding reimbursements

 

What We're Looking For

- 2–4+ years in finance operations, accounting support, business operations, purchasing, or a similar role

- Strong attention to detail and accuracy when working with numbers and financial information

- Comfortable working with invoices, POs, receipts, expenses, and payment records

- Strong Excel/Google Sheets skills

- Experience with Katana, Shopify, or other inventory/ERP systems is a plus

- Strong organizational and time-management skills

- Ability to manage multiple deadlines and consistently follow up on outstanding items

- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills

- Comfortable communicating with suppliers, partners, clients, and internal team members

- Ability to identify discrepancies and proactively investigate and resolve them

- Experience with product costing, wholesale, manufacturing, or apparel is a plus

title: Are you an experienced CSR looking for a change?!
description:
Own the customer experience. Turn inquiries into booked work. Close every loop. Become the person our customers trust and our team can depend on.



Full-time remote position | 7:30 a.m. to 4:00 p.m. PST, Monday to Friday



Umbrella Property Services is a Vancouver-based building services company providing window cleaning, pressure washing, gutter cleaning, roof treatments, moss control, and Christmas lighting.



We are building a team that delivers exceptional service, gets better every month, and takes pride in doing what we say we will do.



I’m Ryan, the Founder. Our CSR is one of the most important people in the company because you are often the first person customers interact with.



Your responsibilities are clear. The standard is high.

- Answer quickly.

- Communicate clearly.

- Convert inquiries into bookings.

- Follow up without being chased.

- Solve problems before they become complaints.

- Close every loop.



This is not a passive inbox-monitoring role. It is not a job where you hide behind
 and text. It is not a fit for someone who needs constant reminders or avoids measurable goals.



Your work directly affects our revenue, reputation, and customer experience.



Your Core Outcome

- Make it easy for customers to buy from us and trust us to do what we promised.

- When a customer contacts us, they should feel heard, helped, and confident about the next step. When an issue appears, you should own it until it is resolved.



What Success Looks Like

- Inbound inquiries are converted into booked work at a minimum 50% rate.

- Outbound follow-ups are converted at a minimum 70% rate.

- Answer inbound calls within two rings during scheduled coverage hours.

- Customer inquiries receive a response within 60 minutes.

- Escalations are resolved or clearly updated within 24 hours.

- Every open request has an owner, next action, and follow-up date.

- CRM information is entered accurately within 24 hours.

- Monthly goals are consistently achieved.

- Customers receive proactive updates instead of needing to chase us.



What You’ll Own



Sales and Quote Management

- Answer inbound calls through RingCentral.

- Make outbound follow-up calls.

- Qualify customers, provide estimates, and collect deposits.

- Use company scripts and processes to guide customers toward booking.

- Follow up until the customer books, declines, or is clearly closed out.



Customer Communication

- Manage phone,
, and text communication.

- Resolve customer questions and concerns.

- Coordinate with suppliers, subcontractors, and internal team members.

- Keep customers informed when timelines or details change.

- Protect the company’s reputation through clear, positive communication.



Follow-Through and Administration

- Enter and update customer information in Jobber.

- Maintain accurate notes, tasks, and follow-up records.

- Monitor the company and billing inboxes daily.

- Update training, certification, health, and safety documentation.

- Make sure commitments do not disappear after the conversation ends.



Proactive Problem Solving

- We do not expect you to know everything. We do expect you to think before escalating. When you bring us a problem, use our 131 framework:

1 problem: What is the actual issue?

3 recommendations: What are three ways to solve it?

1 recommendation: Which option do you recommend, and why?



If you are stuck, ask for help early. Silence, avoidance, and incomplete follow-through create expensive problems.



You’ll Succeed Here If You Are

- Energized by talking to people on the phone.

- Proactive, organized, and reliable.

- Comfortable being measured against clear targets.

- Strong at follow-up and closing loops.

- Willing to receive coaching and improve.

- Able to bring solutions, not just problems.

- Calm when priorities change.

- Detail-oriented with CRM and administrative work.

- Professional, positive, and direct.



This Role Is Not For You If

- You prefer
 or text because phone calls feel uncomfortable.

- You wait to be chased for updates.

- You regularly miss goals without changing your approach.

- You bring problems without recommendations.

- You resist feedback or dislike accountability.

- You need someone else to manage your priorities every day.



Non-Negotiables

- Monday to Friday, 7:30 a.m. to 4:00 p.m. PST

- Full-time, permanent position

- Fluent English

- Quiet, distraction-free workspace

- Reliable computer with two monitors, or laptop plus external monitor

- Professional headset, mouse, keyboard, and internet speed of 100 Mbps or faster



If you do not meet these requirements, your application will not be considered.



How to Apply

- Complete the application: 
/recruit-csr

- If shortlisted, you’ll send a short video message to our team and then complete a series of written communication exercises.

- Final candidates will be invited to a paid trial day to test their skills in a simulated work environment using realistic customer scenarios.

- Provide two verifiable professional references.



We are not looking for someone who simply wants a job answering messages.



We are looking for someone who wants to become exceptional at customer communication, sales, follow-through, and problem solving.



If you want a role where your communication, judgment, and follow-through directly affect the growth of a real company, apply today.



The name of the man who's a "One Man Band" is Jerry

title: API & Integration Developer - Google Analytics, GoHighLevel, Webhooks & Dashboard
description:
Hunt Glass - U.S. Auto Glass Company

Remote | Philippines

Project-Based / Potential Ongoing Work

Pay: Negotiable Based on Experience



We are looking for an experienced API / Integration Developer in the Philippines to help us connect several of our business systems and create a centralized live reporting dashboard.



This is primarily an API, webhook, automation, and data integration project - not a website-design position.



Primary Goal



We want to create a reliable data flow between systems such as:



Google Analytics / GA4 > GoHighLevel (GHL) > Omega EDI > Live Dashboard



The goal is to give our team one place where we can quickly see important business and marketing information without manually pulling reports from multiple platforms.



What You'll Help Build



Depending on what each platform supports, you may:

• Connect systems using REST APIs, webhooks, OAuth, or other integration methods

• Pull data from Google Analytics / GA4

• Integrate with GoHighLevel's API and webhooks

• Determine the best method of retrieving or syncing data from Omega EDI

• Normalize and combine data from multiple sources

• Create automated data workflows

• Build or connect a live management dashboard

• Set up scheduled synchronization where real-time syncing isn't possible

• Handle API authentication, tokens, errors, retries, and logging

• Document the integration so another developer can maintain it

• Recommend the simplest and most cost-effective architecture



The dashboard may include information such as:

• Leads

• Lead sources

• Calls

• Appointments

• Quotes

• Jobs

• Sales/revenue

• Marketing performance

• Conversion rates

• Customer status

• Other operational KPIs



We are open to using tools such as Looker Studio, Google Cloud, databases, Make, Zapier, n8n, or a custom dashboard depending on what makes the most sense.



Important



We are not looking for someone who simply knows Zapier.



Low-code tools are welcome when appropriate, but you should understand how APIs actually work and be able to troubleshoot integrations when a prebuilt connector does not exist.



Ideal Experience



You do not need experience with every platform listed below, but you should be strong in API integrations.



Experience with several of the following is preferred:

• REST APIs

• Webhooks

• JSON

• OAuth 2.0 / API authentication

• JavaScript / Node.js

• Python

• GoHighLevel / HighLevel API

• Google Analytics 4 / GA4 API

• Google APIs

• SQL / databases

• ETL / data transformation

• Looker Studio

• 

• Zapier

• n8n

• Custom dashboards

• CRM integrations



Experience working with U.S. businesses, CRMs, call tracking, lead generation, or automotive businesses is a plus.



About Omega EDI



Omega is one of the primary systems we use for our auto glass operations.



You do not necessarily need prior Omega experience.



Part of this project may involve determining what integration options Omega provides — such as an API, webhook, database connection, reports, exports, or another method — and recommending the best approach.



What We're Looking For



We want someone who:

• Can investigate unfamiliar APIs independently

• Understands data architecture and system integrations

• Can explain technical decisions in simple language

• Thinks about reliability, not just getting a demo to work

• Can identify limitations before development begins

• Documents their work

• Does not overengineer solutions

• Is comfortable recommending a different approach if our proposed architecture can be improved



To Apply



Please answer the following questions in your application.



1. Tell us about an API integration you personally built.

Please explain:

• What systems were connected?

• What APIs or webhooks were used?

• What programming language or tools did you use?

• What problems did you have to solve?



2. Have you worked with GoHighLevel / HighLevel's API before?

If yes, briefly describe what you built.



3. Have you worked with Google Analytics 4 APIs or Google APIs?

Please describe your experience.



4. Imagine one of our systems does not provide a webhook and only allows us to retrieve data through an API. How would you keep our dashboard reasonably up to date?



5. Have you built a dashboard combining data from multiple systems?

If possible, send a screenshot, portfolio link, GitHub link, Loom video, or brief explanation.



6. Which would you recommend for this project and why:

• Looker Studio

• Custom dashboard

• Make / n8n

• Combination of these

• Something else



7. What programming languages are you strongest in?



8. What is your expected hourly or project rate?



Application Requirement



At the very top of your application, write:



“API CONNECTED”



Applications that do not include this phrase may not be reviewed.



We care more about your ability to solve integration problems and build reliable systems than formal education or certifications.

title: Full Stack Direct Response Marketer
description:
About Us

We run a high-ticket Done-For-You Airbnb Arbitrage Program that helps entrepreneurs launch and scale profitable Airbnb businesses without the trial and error. We're growing fast and need someone sharp, creative, and hungry to join our team full-time.



The Role

We're looking for a full stack direct response marketer who will own the execution of our entire marketing engine — paid ads, creative production, copywriting, and funnels.



This isn't a "post on social media" VA job. You'll be inside Meta Ads Manager and our funnel builder every single day, producing 15–20 new ad creatives a week, writing the copy that goes with them, and building the pages that convert the traffic.



I own the strategy — the angles, the offers, the budgets, and the decision on what runs. You own everything it takes to bring that to life and keep it running clean. You build it, you flag what you're seeing, I make the call.



This is a long-term seat. The person who does this well ends up running channels of their own and managing people under them.



Responsibilities:

Produce 15–20 ad creatives per week from our templates — hook swaps, banner changes, resizing for placements.

Write ad copy from our angles — primary text, headlines, and hook variations that we test against each other.

Write and refine landing page,
, and SMS copy in our funnels.

Build campaigns, ad sets, and ads in Meta Ads Manager to our naming convention, staged and ready for approval.

Build landing pages and funnels (ClickFunnels, Typeform, OnceHub) from wireframes and Looms.

Own funnel tech — forms, redirects, mobile layout, pixel and CAPI tracking. When it breaks, you fix it.

QA every live funnel weekly, end to end, on mobile and desktop.

Keep the creative library organized and maintain a swipe file of competitor ads from the Meta Ad Library.

Proactively flag what's working and what's dying — treat the ad account like it's your own money.



Requirements:

2+ years hands-on in Meta Ads Manager. You've built and launched campaigns yourself, not just pulled reports on someone else's.

Real copywriting ability. You can write a hook that stops the scroll and a landing page that doesn't read like a template. Direct response, not brand fluff.

Strong knowledge of a funnel builder — ClickFunnels, GoHighLevel, or similar.

Comfortable editing video and static ads from templates (Canva, CapCut, Premiere, or equivalent).

Understand pixel and CAPI well enough to notice when tracking silently breaks.

Extremely self-sufficient with a "figure it out" attitude. I don't have time to unblock you daily.

Obsessive attention to detail — broken links and typos in live ads are unacceptable.

Strong written English (you'll write copy that runs in front of paying customers).

Experience in online coaching, agency, or high-ticket consulting businesses is a big plus.

Full-time availability, 40 hours per week, 10 AM – 6 PM ET (10 PM – 6 AM Manila). This is a night shift — please only apply if that works for you long-term.



Compensation:

$3,000/month to start.

Performance bonus up to $1,000/month to be discussed after 90 days in the role.

Long-term role with real growth as we scale.

title: Clinical Support RN | Remote | Full-Time | US EST Hours
description:
Clinical Operations Manager – Registered Nurse



Home Health Experience Required



Full-Time Remote Position | Philippines-Based | U.S. Eastern Time Hours



Zeabe is a growing non-medical home care agency based in Delaware, USA. We provide dependable in-home care services and are building the clinical and operational systems needed to support continued growth while maintaining quality, compliance, and excellent client care.



We are looking for an experienced Registered Nurse with genuine Home Health/Home Care clinical operations experience to join us as our Clinical Operations Manager.



Please Read Before Applying



This is not a Virtual Assistant, Healthcare VA, Medical VA, Medical Receptionist, or general administrative position.



To be considered for this role, you must:



Be a licensed Registered Nurse.

Have worked professionally as an RN.

Have direct experience in a Home Health, Home Care, Private Duty, or comparable in-home care environment.

Have meaningful experience managing, coordinating, supervising, or overseeing clinical operations.

Have been responsible for ensuring other people complete required clinical work, documentation, visits, or deadlines.



If your experience is primarily administrative or Virtual Assistant work, even within healthcare, this position is unlikely to be the right fit.



Likewise, holding an RN license alone is not enough. We are specifically looking for someone who has used their nursing background within Home Health/Home Care and understands the operational side of delivering care in the home.



About the Role



The Clinical Operations Manager is responsible for the day-to-day operational execution of Zeabe's clinical services.



The role ensures clients move smoothly from referral through admission, ongoing supervision, recertification, required clinical visits, documentation, and ongoing service delivery while maintaining accurate records, timely follow-up, and regulatory compliance.



You will work closely with our Clinical Director and serve as the operational leader behind the clinical function.



While the Clinical Director owns overall clinical standards, quality, and clinical leadership, the Clinical Operations Manager owns much of the coordination, execution, monitoring, accountability, and follow-through required to make sure clinical work actually gets completed correctly and on time.



You will work across:



Clinical Support Team

Staffing Coordinator

PRN Registered Nurses

Client admissions

Recertifications

Supervisory visits

Clinical documentation

Clinical scheduling and assignments

Compliance-related follow-up

Operational tracking and reporting



This is primarily a Clinical Operations Management position, not a bedside nursing role.



However, your RN background is essential because you must understand the clinical work you are coordinating, recognize when something does not look right, communicate effectively with nurses, identify potential clinical risks, and understand what needs to be escalated.



Primary Objective



Build and operate a reliable clinical operating system that consistently delivers timely, compliant, accurate, and well-coordinated care.



What You Will Be Responsible For

Coordinate clinical operations from referral and admission through ongoing supervision and service delivery.

Ensure admissions, recertifications, supervisory visits, documentation, and follow-up activities are completed accurately and on time.

Maintain accurate, complete, and compliant clinical records across required systems.

Lead the Clinical Support Team and Staffing Coordinator to deliver consistent operational outcomes.

Coordinate PRN Registered Nurse assignments and monitor completion of required clinical activities.

Identify operational risks, resolve process gaps, and appropriately escalate clinical concerns.

Maintain clear visibility over outstanding clinical work so we know what needs to be completed, who owns it, when it is due, and what requires escalation.

The Experience We Are Looking For



We are looking for someone who has actually worked inside Home Health or Home Care clinical operations.



Your experience may include areas such as:



Home Health or Home Care clinical operations

Managing or coordinating field nurses

Admissions or Start of Care processes

Recertifications

Supervisory or reassessment visits

Plans of Care

Clinical documentation review

Chart audits

Clinical compliance

Quality assurance

Tracking required clinical visits

Managing overdue documentation

Coordinating nurses and clinical support staff

Correcting incomplete clinical records

Following up on missed clinical requirements

Clinical scheduling

Home Health EMR/EHR systems

Medicaid, Medicare, VA, Private Duty, or other regulated home-based care environments



You do not need to have performed every item on this list.



What matters is that you have genuine clinical operations experience, rather than simply providing administrative support to people who managed clinical operations.



What This Role Really Requires



This position requires much more than maintaining a task list.



You will be expected to know:



What needs to be completed.

Who is responsible for completing it.

What is currently outstanding.

What is overdue.

What does not appear accurate.

What needs follow-up.

What needs escalation.

What recurring problems need a better system.



If a required nursing visit has not happened, we expect you to notice.



If documentation is incomplete, we expect you to identify it.



If someone tells you something is being handled but it remains unresolved, we expect you to follow it through.



If the same problem keeps occurring, we expect you to help determine why and improve the underlying process.



Leadership and Accountability



We are not looking for someone who simply waits to receive assignments.



The successful person will be comfortable:



Taking ownership of operational outcomes.

Directing and coordinating other team members.

Checking whether work has actually been completed.

Following up when deadlines are missed.

Addressing incomplete or inaccurate clinical documentation.

Asking questions when information does not appear correct.

Holding nurses and support team members accountable for agreed requirements.

Maintaining urgency around important clinical work.

Escalating concerns rather than allowing them to remain unresolved.

Following an issue through until it is fully closed.

Improving processes when the same problem repeatedly occurs.



You should be comfortable having a conversation such as:



"This was due yesterday and has not been completed. What is preventing completion, and when will it be finished?"



You can be professional and respectful while still being clear and firm about expectations.



This Role Is Likely a Good Fit for You If...

You are an RN who has genuinely worked in Home Health/Home Care.

You understand clinical operations beyond simply providing nursing care.

You have coordinated, supervised, or managed nurses or clinical support staff.

You naturally take ownership rather than waiting to be told what to do next.

You notice when a required visit, signature, document, date, or clinical item is missing.

You do not assume something has been completed just because someone says they are working on it.

You continue following up until an issue is completely resolved.

You are comfortable checking other people's work.

You address missed deadlines rather than avoiding uncomfortable conversations.

You work with a sense of urgency while maintaining accuracy.

You enjoy bringing structure and order to complicated clinical workflows.

You prefer clear standards, documented processes, and measurable outcomes.

You can quickly explain the current status of important outstanding items.

You question information when it appears incomplete or inconsistent.

You enjoy improving systems so the same operational problems do not continue happening.





This Role Is Probably Not for You If...

Your healthcare experience is primarily as a Virtual Assistant or Healthcare VA.

You have never worked professionally as a Registered Nurse.

You hold an RN license but have never used it professionally in Home Health/Home Care.

Your nursing background is exclusively bedside hospital nursing with no meaningful Home Health/Home Care operational experience.

You have supported a Clinical Manager but have never personally been accountable for clinical operational outcomes.

You prefer receiving clearly defined individual tasks rather than owning a process.

You avoid following up with people when deadlines are missed.

You are uncomfortable checking another nurse's documentation or work.

You tend to accept that something is being handled without verifying completion.

You regularly need your manager to tell you what to do next.

You dislike detailed documentation, compliance requirements, or structured processes.

You prioritize avoiding uncomfortable conversations over addressing an important missed requirement.

You tend to start many things but struggle to consistently close them.



Required Qualifications



You must have:



An active Registered Nurse license.

Professional experience working as an RN.

Direct Home Health, Home Care, Private Duty, or comparable in-home care experience.

Clinical operations experience.

Experience coordinating, supervising, or managing nurses and/or clinical support personnel.

Experience managing documentation, clinical visits, deadlines, follow-up, or compliance requirements.

Strong written and spoken English.

Excellent attention to detail and documentation accuracy.

Confidence following up on late, incomplete, or inaccurate work.

The ability to distinguish routine operational issues from matters requiring clinical escalation.

Experience using healthcare technology, EHR/EMR software, Home Health software, or comparable clinical systems.

Strong working knowledge of spreadsheets and cloud-based business applications.

The ability to work independently and take ownership.

Availability to work the required U.S. Eastern Time schedule.



Preferred Experience



The following experience would be particularly valuable:



U.S. Home Health experience

U.S. healthcare experience

Medicaid

VA Community Care

Medicare-certified Home Health

Private Duty/Home Care

Quality Assurance

Clinical compliance

Chart auditing

Managing remote or offshore clinical teams

AlayaCare or comparable Home Health software



These are preferred rather than mandatory unless otherwise stated above.



Systems and Technology



You may work with systems including:



AlayaCare

Microsoft Teams

SharePoint

Microsoft Excel

Microsoft Word



Front

Aircall

Trainual

Zoom

Claude



You are not expected to have prior experience with every system.



We are much more interested in whether you are comfortable learning technology, using structured systems consistently, and maintaining accurate information.



Working Hours



This is a full-time remote position working:



8:00 AM to 4:30 PM U.S. Eastern Time, Monday through Friday



Please consider the corresponding Philippine overnight working hours before applying.



Compensation



USD $1,800 to $2,400 per month



Compensation will depend on directly relevant experience, including:
