title: Clinical Operations Manager – Registered Nurse
description:
Clinical Operations Manager – Registered Nurse



Home Health Experience Required



Full-Time Remote Position | Philippines-Based | U.S. Eastern Time Hours



Zeabe is a growing non-medical home care agency based in Delaware, USA. We provide dependable in-home care services and are building the clinical and operational systems needed to support continued growth while maintaining quality, compliance, and excellent client care.



We are looking for an experienced Registered Nurse with genuine Home Health/Home Care clinical operations experience to join us as our Clinical Operations Manager.



Please Read Before Applying



This is not a Virtual Assistant, Healthcare VA, Medical VA, Medical Receptionist, or general administrative position.



To be considered for this role, you must:



Be a licensed Registered Nurse.

Have worked professionally as an RN.

Have direct experience in a Home Health, Home Care, Private Duty, or comparable in-home care environment.

Have meaningful experience managing, coordinating, supervising, or overseeing clinical operations.

Have been responsible for ensuring other people complete required clinical work, documentation, visits, or deadlines.



If your experience is primarily administrative or Virtual Assistant work, even within healthcare, this position is unlikely to be the right fit.



Likewise, holding an RN license alone is not enough. We are specifically looking for someone who has used their nursing background within Home Health/Home Care and understands the operational side of delivering care in the home.



About the Role



The Clinical Operations Manager is responsible for the day-to-day operational execution of Zeabe's clinical services.



The role ensures clients move smoothly from referral through admission, ongoing supervision, recertification, required clinical visits, documentation, and ongoing service delivery while maintaining accurate records, timely follow-up, and regulatory compliance.



You will work closely with our Clinical Director and serve as the operational leader behind the clinical function.



While the Clinical Director owns overall clinical standards, quality, and clinical leadership, the Clinical Operations Manager owns much of the coordination, execution, monitoring, accountability, and follow-through required to make sure clinical work actually gets completed correctly and on time.



You will work across:



Clinical Support Team

Staffing Coordinator

PRN Registered Nurses

Client admissions

Recertifications

Supervisory visits

Clinical documentation

Clinical scheduling and assignments

Compliance-related follow-up

Operational tracking and reporting



This is primarily a Clinical Operations Management position, not a bedside nursing role.



However, your RN background is essential because you must understand the clinical work you are coordinating, recognize when something does not look right, communicate effectively with nurses, identify potential clinical risks, and understand what needs to be escalated.



Primary Objective



Build and operate a reliable clinical operating system that consistently delivers timely, compliant, accurate, and well-coordinated care.



What You Will Be Responsible For

Coordinate clinical operations from referral and admission through ongoing supervision and service delivery.

Ensure admissions, recertifications, supervisory visits, documentation, and follow-up activities are completed accurately and on time.

Maintain accurate, complete, and compliant clinical records across required systems.

Lead the Clinical Support Team and Staffing Coordinator to deliver consistent operational outcomes.

Coordinate PRN Registered Nurse assignments and monitor completion of required clinical activities.

Identify operational risks, resolve process gaps, and appropriately escalate clinical concerns.

Maintain clear visibility over outstanding clinical work so we know what needs to be completed, who owns it, when it is due, and what requires escalation.

The Experience We Are Looking For



We are looking for someone who has actually worked inside Home Health or Home Care clinical operations.



Your experience may include areas such as:



Home Health or Home Care clinical operations

Managing or coordinating field nurses

Admissions or Start of Care processes

Recertifications

Supervisory or reassessment visits

Plans of Care

Clinical documentation review

Chart audits

Clinical compliance

Quality assurance

Tracking required clinical visits

Managing overdue documentation

Coordinating nurses and clinical support staff

Correcting incomplete clinical records

Following up on missed clinical requirements

Clinical scheduling

Home Health EMR/EHR systems

Medicaid, Medicare, VA, Private Duty, or other regulated home-based care environments



You do not need to have performed every item on this list.



What matters is that you have genuine clinical operations experience, rather than simply providing administrative support to people who managed clinical operations.



What This Role Really Requires



This position requires much more than maintaining a task list.



You will be expected to know:



What needs to be completed.

Who is responsible for completing it.

What is currently outstanding.

What is overdue.

What does not appear accurate.

What needs follow-up.

What needs escalation.

What recurring problems need a better system.



If a required nursing visit has not happened, we expect you to notice.



If documentation is incomplete, we expect you to identify it.



If someone tells you something is being handled but it remains unresolved, we expect you to follow it through.



If the same problem keeps occurring, we expect you to help determine why and improve the underlying process.



Leadership and Accountability



We are not looking for someone who simply waits to receive assignments.



The successful person will be comfortable:



Taking ownership of operational outcomes.

Directing and coordinating other team members.

Checking whether work has actually been completed.

Following up when deadlines are missed.

Addressing incomplete or inaccurate clinical documentation.

Asking questions when information does not appear correct.

Holding nurses and support team members accountable for agreed requirements.

Maintaining urgency around important clinical work.

Escalating concerns rather than allowing them to remain unresolved.

Following an issue through until it is fully closed.

Improving processes when the same problem repeatedly occurs.



You should be comfortable having a conversation such as:



"This was due yesterday and has not been completed. What is preventing completion, and when will it be finished?"



You can be professional and respectful while still being clear and firm about expectations.



This Role Is Likely a Good Fit for You If...

You are an RN who has genuinely worked in Home Health/Home Care.

You understand clinical operations beyond simply providing nursing care.

You have coordinated, supervised, or managed nurses or clinical support staff.

You naturally take ownership rather than waiting to be told what to do next.

You notice when a required visit, signature, document, date, or clinical item is missing.

You do not assume something has been completed just because someone says they are working on it.

You continue following up until an issue is completely resolved.

You are comfortable checking other people's work.

You address missed deadlines rather than avoiding uncomfortable conversations.

You work with a sense of urgency while maintaining accuracy.

You enjoy bringing structure and order to complicated clinical workflows.

You prefer clear standards, documented processes, and measurable outcomes.

You can quickly explain the current status of important outstanding items.

You question information when it appears incomplete or inconsistent.

You enjoy improving systems so the same operational problems do not continue happening.





This Role Is Probably Not for You If...

Your healthcare experience is primarily as a Virtual Assistant or Healthcare VA.

You have never worked professionally as a Registered Nurse.

You hold an RN license but have never used it professionally in Home Health/Home Care.

Your nursing background is exclusively bedside hospital nursing with no meaningful Home Health/Home Care operational experience.

You have supported a Clinical Manager but have never personally been accountable for clinical operational outcomes.

You prefer receiving clearly defined individual tasks rather than owning a process.

You avoid following up with people when deadlines are missed.

You are uncomfortable checking another nurse's documentation or work.

You tend to accept that something is being handled without verifying completion.

You regularly need your manager to tell you what to do next.

You dislike detailed documentation, compliance requirements, or structured processes.

You prioritize avoiding uncomfortable conversations over addressing an important missed requirement.

You tend to start many things but struggle to consistently close them.



Required Qualifications



You must have:



An active Registered Nurse license.

Professional experience working as an RN.

Direct Home Health, Home Care, Private Duty, or comparable in-home care experience.

Clinical operations experience.

Experience coordinating, supervising, or managing nurses and/or clinical support personnel.

Experience managing documentation, clinical visits, deadlines, follow-up, or compliance requirements.

Strong written and spoken English.

Excellent attention to detail and documentation accuracy.

Confidence following up on late, incomplete, or inaccurate work.

The ability to distinguish routine operational issues from matters requiring clinical escalation.

Experience using healthcare technology, EHR/EMR software, Home Health software, or comparable clinical systems.

Strong working knowledge of spreadsheets and cloud-based business applications.

The ability to work independently and take ownership.

Availability to work the required U.S. Eastern Time schedule.



Preferred Experience



The following experience would be particularly valuable:



U.S. Home Health experience

U.S. healthcare experience

Medicaid

VA Community Care

Medicare-certified Home Health

Private Duty/Home Care

Quality Assurance

Clinical compliance

Chart auditing

Managing remote or offshore clinical teams

AlayaCare or comparable Home Health software



These are preferred rather than mandatory unless otherwise stated above.



Systems and Technology



You may work with systems including:



AlayaCare

Microsoft Teams

SharePoint

Microsoft Excel

Microsoft Word



Front

Aircall

Trainual

Zoom

Claude



You are not expected to have prior experience with every system.



We are much more interested in whether you are comfortable learning technology, using structured systems consistently, and maintaining accurate information.



Working Hours



This is a full-time remote position working:



8:00 AM to 4:30 PM U.S. Eastern Time, Monday through Friday



Please consider the corresponding Philippine overnight working hours before applying.



Compensation



USD $1,800 to $2,400 per month



Compensation will depend on directly relevant experience, including:



Home Health/Home Care experience

Clinical Operations Management experience

RN experience

Leadership experience

U.S. or PH healthcare experience

Overall fit for the position





How to Apply (Read Carefully)



We use structured systems and automation heavily, so attention to detail matters — starting with your application.



Step 1: Apply through OnlineJobs.ph



Step 2: In your application message, mention this EXACT role: Clinical Operations



Applications that do not follow these instructions exactly will not be considered.

title: Google Ads Specialist: Weekly Management and Reporting (Long Term, US Agency)
description:
ABOUT US



We are a 9-person US marketing agency based near Seattle. We build websites and run SEO and Google Ads for local service businesses, mostly home services and trades: painters, roofers, HVAC, landscapers, concrete, fencing, electrical, flooring, remodelers. We have been doing this for years and our clients stay with us for years.



Right now one person manages our entire Google Ads book. That is 56 accounts under active weekly management, with 15 more being onboarded this quarter. He is good and he is out of hours. We are hiring someone to work alongside him so the accounts get the weekly attention they are paid for.



This is a long-term role, not a project. If it works, it grows.





WHAT YOU WOULD DO, IN ORDER OF HOW MUCH IT MATTERS TO US



1) WEEKLY ACCOUNT MANAGEMENT

Work a set of live Search accounts on a weekly rhythm. Mine search terms and build negatives. Watch performance against each account's goal and flag what is drifting. Adjust bids and targeting inside an agreed band. Pause losers, test new ad copy, keep ad groups clean. Catch disapprovals, policy notices and payment problems before the client does.



2) REPORTING

Pull and assemble the monthly performance data for each account you work. You build the numbers and the observations. Our manager writes the client narrative and presents it. This needs to be accurate and on time every month without being chased.



3) ACCOUNT AND CAMPAIGN BUILDS

Build new accounts and campaigns from a written spec: campaign and ad group structure, keywords and match types, geo and scheduling, budgets as instructed, ad copy drafted to a template. Built to a draft state for review, never turned on by you.



4) CONVERSION TRACKING

Set up and verify conversion tracking: Google Tag, Google Tag Manager, call tracking, form conversions, and importing offline or CRM conversions where the client has them. Verify with a real submission, not by confirming the tag is present.





WHAT YOU WOULD NOT DO



- No client contact of any kind. No
, no calls, no meetings, no name in a client thread. Our manager is the face on every account, every time. If you want a client-facing account manager seat, this is not that job, and we will not change our mind on it.

- No setting account strategy.

- No changing daily budgets, and no turning campaigns on or off, without sign-off.

- No publishing ads or launching campaigns yourself.



That is not a comment on your skill. It is how we keep one voice in front of the client.





WHAT WE NEED FROM YOU TO WORK INSIDE OUR SYSTEM



- Work is assigned and tracked in ClickUp. You will get a limited seat on the ads lists only. Every task gets a note on what you changed and why, in writing, in the task. We do not run this over chat messages that disappear.

- Your own Google account with 2FA on. We grant Standard access per client account as work is assigned. Never a shared login.

- We work from written playbooks. If the spec says build it a certain way, build it that way and raise the disagreement separately. Improvising on a client account is the one thing that ends this arrangement fast.

- Async first. We are in the US Pacific timezone, which is roughly 15 hours behind Manila. We do not expect you to work our hours. We do expect work to land when you said it would, and one live video check-in each week with our paid media manager at a time that works for both of you.

- Clear written English. You will be writing ad copy, task notes and reporting observations that our manager reads and acts on.

- Reliable internet and a machine that can run a browser with many tabs without falling over.





YOU NEED TO HAVE



- Hands-on Google Ads experience managing live Search accounts on an ongoing weekly basis, not just building them once. Tell us how long and how many.

- Real conversion tracking experience. You should be able to explain how you proved a conversion was recording, not just installed.

- Experience with lead generation accounts. Local service and home services experience is a strong plus. Ecommerce-only experience is not a fit for most of this book.

- Comfort pulling and assembling reporting data accurately, every month, without reminders.

- Google Ads certification is fine to mention but it is not what we are screening on.





NICE TO HAVE, NOT REQUIRED



- Google Tag Manager, GA4, and call tracking platforms (we use WhatConverts)

- Local Service Ads

- Google Shopping and Merchant Center

- Microsoft Ads

- Looker Studio





TERMS



- Part time to start, ongoing and long term, around 20 hours a week. Hours can grow if it works.

- 15 to 20 USD an hour depending on experience. The top of that range is for someone who can own conversion tracking setup as well as weekly management.

- We start with a paid trial on one real account, paid at your full rate whether or not we continue. No unpaid test work. Ever.

- Paid monthly by Wise or Payoneer, whichever you prefer.





HOW TO APPLY



Applications that skip this get deleted, and that is most of them. Put SEARCH TERMS in your subject line so we know you read this far.



Then answer these four, in writing, in your own words. Short and specific beats long and polished.



1) Describe two Google Ads accounts you managed on an ongoing weekly basis. What did you actually do in a typical week, and how did you d
 what to change?



2) Walk us through how you set up and verified conversion tracking on your last build. How did you know it was really recording?



3) An account stops converting overnight. Spend is normal. What do you check, and in what order?



4) You are handed a written build spec you disagree with. What do you do?



Attach one monthly report you have produced, with client names and numbers blacked out. We want to see how you present, not who you worked for.

title: Business Development Representative
description:
# Cold Caller — Industrial B2B Appointment Setting (US Accounts, Night Shift)



**This is a phone job.** You dial US manufacturers and industrial companies, five days a week. No admin work, no
 support, no lead scraping, no "virtual assistant" tasks. If you are looking for a general VA role or something you can run alongside another gig, this is the wrong post.



Synapse Mfg is an outsourced sales agency. US industrial and manufacturing companies hire us to place a dedicated caller inside their business and generate real buying conversations and RFQs. You are that caller. You represent one client at a time on the phone, using their name, selling their product.



Our clients sell things like sensors and automation equipment, metal detection systems, custom packaging, industrial curtains, and fire safety gear. You will be calling plant managers, engineers, purchasing agents, and owners. You do not need to know manufacturing on day one. You do need to be willing to learn a technical product well enough that a plant manager takes you seriously.



## The job



You start **part time on one client account.** Hit quota, stay consistent for a month, and we move you to **full time** and add a second account, then a third, then a fourth. Every account you add raises your pay.



The day is relentless. You will hold dozens of live conversations, most of them ending in no. Some people will be rude. You dial the next number.



## Pay (USD)



- Base: **$7.80 per hour**

- Commission: **$20 per showed meeting**



| Stage | Schedule | Roughly per month |

|---|---|---|

| 1 client | Part time, 20–25 hrs/week | $840 – $1,085 |

| 2 clients | Full time | $1,670 – $1,830 |

| 3 clients | Full time | $1,830 – $2,070 |

| 4 clients | Full time | $1,990 – $2,310 |



Caller to team lead in 3 to 6 months for the right person, with a higher rate and a piece of what your team produces.



## Who we hire



You have made cold calls for a living, on the phone, to strangers, for months. Not warm follow-up. Not inbound. Not chat support.



You know your own numbers without checking: dials per day, connect rate, conversations to meetings.



You can get rejected 40 times before lunch and dial the same way at 3pm as you did at 8am.



You fix your own problems. You listen back to your calls, you find the place the conversation died, and you change it before anyone tells you to.



You want one job you grow inside. Not a portfolio of clients, not a side business, not something you do while building your own agency.



## Requirements



- Excellent spoken English, neutral accent, comfortable on the phone with US owners and plant managers

- Available starting 8am US Eastern (night shift in the Philippines)

- No other job or client work

- Proven B2B cold calling or appointment setting experience, verifiable

- You have used a dialer and a CRM (OptimalDial, Salesforce, HubSpot, Apollo, FrontSpin, or similar)

- Quiet room, wired headset, reliable computer, stable internet

- **Backup power and backup internet.** Brownouts happen. Your shift does not stop because the grid did. If you do not have a UPS or power station and a mobile data backup, get one before you apply. 

How you work with us



Two rules matter more than anything else on this list.



**You are reachable during your shift.** You greet the team in the group chat when you log in, and you answer Slack within 30 minutes while you are on the clock. If we cannot reach you, we assume you are not working and we stop your timer.



**You raise problems the moment they happen.** Power cut, bad lead list, you disagree with a script change, you are unhappy about something. Message us from your phone right then. Going quiet for hours and explaining it later does not work here.

title: Fractional Chief Financial Officer (CFO) – E-Commerce & Inventory
description:
Position Overview



We are seeking an experienced Fractional Chief Financial Officer (CFO) to provide strategic financial leadership for a growing, inventory-intensive e-commerce business.

This is not simply an accounting or bookkeeping oversight role. We are looking for a hands-on financial executive who can ensure the accuracy of our financial reporting while helping ownership make better decisions regarding cash flow, inventory investment, profitability, purchasing, operating expenses, and long-term growth.

The ideal candidate has significant experience with e-commerce, retail, distribution, or another inventory-intensive business and understands the unique relationship between inventory, cash flow, gross margin, marketing spend, fulfillment costs, and profitability.



The Fractional CFO will work closely with ownership and the accounting team and will serve as a key financial advisor to the business.



Key Responsibilities



Financial Leadership & Strategy



-Serve as a strategic financial advisor to ownership and senior leadership.

-Translate financial data into clear, actionable business recommendations.

-Identify opportunities to improve profitability, EBITDA, cash flow, working capital, and return on invested capital.

-Develop financial models to evaluate growth initiatives, major purchases, capital expenditures, hiring, new product categories, and other strategic investments.

-Provide scenario and sensitivity analysis to support major business decisions.

-Establish meaningful financial KPIs and management reporting for leadership

.

Monthly Close & Financial Reporting

-Oversee and improve the monthly financial closing process to ensure accurate and timely reporting.

-Review monthly P&L, balance sheet, cash-flow statements, reconciliations, accruals, prepaid expenses, inventory, COGS, and other material accounts.

-Establish and maintain a disciplined monthly close calendar.

-Review financial results for unusual trends, errors, margin changes, and material variances.

-Ensure financial statements accurately reflect the economic performance of the business.

-Develop monthly management reporting that clearly explains what happened, why it happened, and what management should do next.



Annual Audit

-Lead the company through its annual financial statement audit.

-Serve as the primary financial contact with external auditors.

-Coordinate audit schedules, PBC requests, supporting documentation, inventory testing, reconciliations, and other audit requirements.

-Ensure the accounting team is properly prepared before fieldwork begins.

-Address audit findings and proposed adjustments promptly.

-Improve processes and internal controls based on audit findings and recommendations.



-Inventory & Working Capital Management

-Inventory management will be a major responsibility of this position.

-The CFO must understand how to financially evaluate inventory across a large number of SKUs and translate inventory data into purchasing and cash-flow decisions.



Responsibilities include:

Analyze inventory turnover, aging, days on hand, sell-through rates, and inventory productivity.

Identify fast-moving, slow-moving, excess, obsolete, and dead inventory.

Develop appropriate inventory reserve and write-down methodologies.

Analyze inventory profitability by SKU, product category, and other meaningful segments.

Calculate and monitor GMROI / return on inventory investment.

Determine how much working capital is tied up in inventory.

Recommend strategies for reducing or liquidating underperforming inventory.

Help establish appropriate inventory purchasing and reorder levels.

Balance the financial impact of stockouts against the cost of carrying excess inventory.

Analyze inventory purchasing requirements against projected demand and available cash.

Improve inventory forecasting and purchasing discipline.

Work with operations and purchasing teams to improve inventory efficiency and cash conversion.



The CFO should be able to help answer questions such as:

Which products should we buy more of? Which should we reduce or discontinue? Where is cash trapped in inventory? Which categories generate the highest return on inventory investment? How much inventory should we purchase over the next 3, 6, and 12 months?





Margin & E-Commerce Profitability

-Develop accurate gross margin and contribution margin reporting.

-Understand and analyze all major components of e-commerce profitability, including:

Product cost

Landed cost

Inbound freight and duties

Outbound shipping

Fulfillment costs

Payment processing fees

Discounts and promotions

Returns and refunds

Marketplace/platform fees

Advertising and customer acquisition costs

-Analyze profitability by SKU, category, channel, and customer segment where appropriate.

-Identify margin leakage and opportunities to improve pricing, purchasing, shipping, fulfillment, and product mix.

-Ensure management understands the difference between revenue growth, gross margin, contribution margin, and true bottom-line profitability.



Cash Flow & Forecasting

-Develop and maintain a 13-week cash-flow forecast.

-Build annual budgets and rolling financial forecasts.

-Forecast revenue, gross margin, operating expenses, inventory purchases, payroll, marketing expenditures, capital expenditures, and cash requirements.

-Identify potential cash-flow constraints before they become problems.

-Model different growth and profitability scenarios.

-Establish appropriate cash reserves and working-capital targets.

-Help management determine how aggressively the company can invest while maintaining appropriate liquidity.



Budgeting & FP&A

-Lead the annual budgeting process.

-Provide monthly budget vs. actual and year-over-year analysis.

-Develop departmental budgets and accountability.

-Identify significant financial variances and their underlying causes.

-Build financial dashboards and KPIs for management.

-Develop forward-looking forecasts rather than relying solely on historical financial statements.



Marketing & Customer Economics

-The CFO should understand the economics of performance-driven e-commerce marketing.

-Evaluate marketing spend from a financial and profitability perspective.

-Understand metrics including ROAS, MER, CAC, LTV, AOV, conversion rate, and contribution margin.

-Work with marketing leadership to determine whether incremental advertising spend is producing profitable incremental revenue.

-Help establish marketing budgets based on contribution margin and cash-flow objectives rather than revenue alone.

-Analyze the profitability of promotions, discounts, customer acquisition strategies, and sales channels.





Internal Controls & Risk Management

-Evaluate and strengthen financial and accounting controls.

-Establish appropriate approval limits and financial policies.

-Improve segregation of duties where appropriate.

-Review purchasing, vendor payment, banking, inventory, payroll, and expense controls.

-Identify financial and operational risks and recommend appropriate safeguards.

-Help protect the company against fraud, financial errors, and unnecessary financial exposure.





Tax & Compliance Coordination

-Coordinate with outside CPA and tax professionals.

-Support federal, state, and local tax compliance and planning.

-Understand the financial implications of multi-state e-commerce operations, sales tax, and nexus.

-Ensure appropriate financial information is available for tax filings and planning.

-Coordinate with outside professionals on specialized tax matters as necessary.





Systems & Data

-Evaluate the reliability and integration of financial and operational data.

-Be comfortable working with data from e-commerce platforms, accounting/ERP systems, inventory/WMS systems, payment -processors, banks, and business intelligence tools.

-Strong proficiency with Excel or Google Sheets is required.

-Identify opportunities to automate reporting and improve financial processes.

-Experience with Shopify or a similar high-volume e-commerce platform is strongly preferred.

-Comfortable utilizing modern technology and AI tools to improve financial analysis, forecasting, reporting, and productivity.





Required Qualifications

-10+ years of progressive finance and accounting experience.

-Significant experience serving as a CFO, Fractional CFO, VP of Finance, or comparable senior financial leader.

-Strong understanding of GAAP accounting and financial statements.

-Demonstrated experience successfully managing or leading annual financial statement audits.

-Deep understanding of monthly financial close processes.

-Strong experience with inventory accounting, COGS, inventory valuation, reserves, and working-capital management.

-Experience with e-commerce, retail, consumer products, distribution, or another inventory-intensive business.

-Ability to analyze large SKU portfolios and distinguish between fast-moving, slow-moving, excess, and obsolete inventory.

-Strong financial modeling, budgeting, forecasting, and cash-flow management skills.

-Strong understanding of gross margin and contribution margin.

-Ability to communicate complex financial information clearly to owners and non-financial executives.

-Highly organized, analytical, detail-oriented, and proactive.

-Strong leadership skills with the ability to hold accounting and operational teams accountable.

-Comfortable operating in an entrepreneurial, fast-moving environment.





Preferred Qualifications

-CPA and/or MBA preferred but not required.

-Prior CFO experience with a significant e-commerce company.

-Experience with Shopify or Shopify Plus.

-Experience with high-SKU-count inventory businesses.

-Experience with warehouse and fulfillment operations.

-Experience with multi-state tax and sales-tax environments.

-Experience improving accounting systems, reporting automation, and financial controls.

-Experience working with founder-led or privately held companies.





What We Are Looking For



We are looking for someone who goes beyond reporting financial results.

The right CFO should be able to look at the company's financial and operational data and tell leadership:

What is happening? Why is it happening? What is likely to happen next? What should we do about it?

This individual must be willing to dig into the details when necessary while maintaining the perspective of a senior financial executive.

We want a proactive, hands-on, highly organized financial leader who identifies issues before they become problems and brings solutions and recommendations to management—not someone who waits to be told what to analyze.





Measures of Success

Success in this role will include:

Accurate and timely monthly financial statements.

A consistent and efficient monthly closing process.

Successful and well-organized annual audits.

Reliable cash-flow forecasting.

Improved visibility into SKU and category profitability.

Reduced capital tied up in slow-moving and excess inventory.

Improved inventory turns and return on inventory investment.

Better gross and contribution margin visibility.

More disciplined budgeting and expense management.

Improved financial controls and reporting.

Clear financial guidance that enables ownership to make faster, better-informed decisions.





Engagement

This is a fractional executive position, not a traditional bookkeeping or accounting role.

The CFO will work closely with ownership and key members of the accounting, operations, purchasing, and marketing teams. The expected time commitment will be established based on the needs of the business.

Candidates should have sufficient availability to become deeply familiar with the company's financial and operating model and be actively involved in important financial decisions rather than serving solely in an advisory capacity.

title: Listing & Distribution Associate
description:
About Fieldtrip

Fieldtrip is a luxury hospitality company that’s committed to setting the standard for short term rental (AirBNB) experiences. Our growing portfolio of 100+ luxury homes combine the best aspects of a home with the brand promise of a high-end hotel. We are focused on delivering a seamless guest through strong team collaboration, clear processes, and consistent service standards.





About the Role

The Listing & Distribution Associate is responsible for the technical health, connectivity, accuracy, optimization, and presentation of our property listings across Airbnb, Vrbo, direct booking channels, and other distribution platforms.



This role owns the full lifecycle of a listing, from initial setup and channel integration through ongoing monitoring, troubleshooting, optimization, and deactivation. The Listing & Distribution Associate ensures that rates, fees, availability, policies, content, and property data are syncing and displaying correctly across all channels.



The ideal candidate combines strong technical knowledge of vacation rental systems and OTAs with a problem-solving mindset and an understanding of how listing content and merchandising impact visibility, conversion, and revenue.



Location: Remote - Type: Full-Time - Salary: $900 - $1300 Depending on Experience





Key Responsibilities

Own listing health and connectivity across the PMS (Streamline), channel manager (Rentals United), direct booking website, and OTAs, proactively identifying and resolving sync errors, mapping issues, disconnected listings, API errors, and other integration problems.

Manage the full listing lifecycle, including setup, integration, activation, mapping, maintenance, temporary deactivation, reactivation, and offboarding across all applicable systems and channels.

Verify rates, fees, taxes, availability, restrictions, cancellation policies, occupancy, content, and other settings are pushing and displaying correctly across channels, troubleshooting discrepancies before they impact guests or revenue.

Conduct recurring listing health audits to identify connectivity issues, missing content, suppressed or inactive listings, incorrect configurations, duplicate listings, synchronization failures, OTA warnings, and other issues affecting bookability or performance.

Troubleshoot technical listing issues by identifying the root cause, determining whether the issue originates within the PMS, channel manager, OTA, website, or configuration, and coordinating with platform support or internal teams when escalation is required.

Optimize listing performance and merchandising through photography sequencing, titles, amenities, descriptions, property attributes, search filters, OTA settings, and other factors that influence visibility and conversion.

Maintain accurate portfolio tracking for active and inactive listings, channel status, listing IDs, URLs, integrations, subscriptions, paid programs, recurring fees, and other listing-related services.

Write and maintain accurate, conversion-focused listing content, translating property features into clear guest benefits while ensuring descriptions, amenities, sleeping arrangements, policies, and property details remain consistent across channels.

Partner with Revenue, Marketing, Operations, and Guest Experience to resolve listing issues, launch new properties, implement property changes, improve underperforming listings, and ensure distribution strategy supports broader business goals.





Qualifications

2+ years of experience in vacation rentals, hospitality distribution, OTA management, property management systems, or channel management.

Strong understanding of OTA connectivity, channel mapping, inventory synchronization, fees, restrictions, and listing configurations. Rentals United and Streamline PMS knowledge is a plus.

Excellent English writing, editing, and proofreading skills.

Proven ability to troubleshoot technical issues and identify root causes across multiple connected systems.

Strong analytical skills, attention to detail, and ability to use listing performance data to identify issues and optimization opportunities.

Understanding of digital merchandising, OTA search behavior, and conversion optimization.

Comfortable managing and auditing a large portfolio of properties across multiple channels.





What Success Looks Like

Every property is live on the right channels, accurate, up to date, and consistently represented across the portfolio.

New listings launch quickly, correctly, and with strong merchandising from day one.

Listings clearly communicate what makes each property unique.

Properties are continuously optimized based on performance, guest behavior, reviews, and market trends.

Underperforming listings are proactively identified and improved rather than simply maintained.

Active and inactive listings, subscriptions, fees, and channel connections are organized, accurate, and properly managed.

Marketing, Revenue, and Operations can rely on listing information as a clear and accurate source of truth.

Ultimately, listings generate stronger engagement, higher conversion, and more bookings.

title: Executive Assistant to CEO
description:
Executive Assistant to CEO

Full-Time | Remote – Philippines | $1,500 USD/month | 40 hours/week | U.S. business hours



REQUIRED WRITTEN INTERVIEW — COMPLETE TO MOVE FORWARD







You must complete the written interview to move forward in the hiring process. Submit your resume as instructed below.



THE ONE-SENTENCE TEST



Can you move with urgency, manage a fast-changing executive workload, and use both Kartra and GoHighLevel proficiently without waiting for the CEO to repeatedly tell you what to do?



If the answer is yes, keep reading.



WE AREN’T LOOKING FOR A TRADITIONAL EXECUTIVE ASSISTANT



Speak Your Way To Cash® is looking for a highly responsive, technology-proficient Executive Assistant who operates with speed, urgency, accuracy, judgment, and complete ownership.



Ashley’s schedule and priorities move quickly. Client requests, legal matters, speaking opportunities, sales conversations, sponsorships, travel arrangements, events, and business decisions often require immediate action.



This is not a role for someone who:



• Waits until the end of the day to acknowledge an urgent request

• Takes several days to complete something that could reasonably be handled today

• Needs repeated reminders or constant follow-up

• Waits for detailed instructions instead of determining the next step

• Lists Kartra or GoHighLevel on a résumé but cannot demonstrate hands-on proficiency

• Allows assignments or follow-ups to quietly disappear



The right person quickly determines what needs to happen, gathers missing information, proposes a solution, communicates progress, and drives the assignment to completion.



You must be able to move fast without becoming careless.



ABOUT SPEAK YOUR WAY TO CASH®



Speak Your Way To Cash® is a multiple-time Inc. 5000 company that helps experts, entrepreneurs, speakers, consultants, attorneys, and executives turn their expertise into high-value speaking, training, consulting, and corporate-contract opportunities.



Ashley Kirkwood is an attorney, CEO, international speaker, bestselling author, and entrepreneur managing multiple businesses, client obligations, speaking engagements, events, partnerships, and rapidly changing priorities.



This role exists to protect Ashley’s time, carry the details, anticipate what she will need next, and ensure important work moves forward without her having to repeatedly check on it.



THE MISSION



Your mission is to become the reliable right hand who:



• Responds quickly

• Thinks critically

• Acts independently

• Protects Ashley’s time

• Keeps priorities organized

• Communicates confidently on Ashley’s behalf

• Uses Kartra and GoHighLevel to keep business and client operations moving

• Tracks assignments until every step is complete

• Brings solutions instead of simply reporting problems



WHAT WINNING LOOKS LIKE



You are succeeding in this role when:



• Urgent assignments are acknowledged and acted on immediately during working hours

• Ashley does not have to ask multiple times for an update

• Assignments that can reasonably be completed today are completed today

• Calendar conflicts are caught before they become emergencies

• High-priority opportunities do not sit unanswered

• Client, legal, vendor, and business requests receive timely follow-up

• Kartra and GoHighLevel records, workflows, campaigns, contacts, and tasks remain accurate and current

• Travel plans are complete, accurate, and ready for approval

• Outstanding assignments are tracked until they are fully resolved

• Ashley receives concise updates, recommendations, and clear next steps

• Routine decisions are handled independently within established authority

• Systems continue functioning without constant CEO involvement

• Ashley feels that a significant administrative and operational weight has been removed



YOUR FIRST 14 DAYS



During your first two weeks, you will be expected to:



• Learn Ashley’s communication style, priorities, calendar, and businesses

• Understand what is urgent, what can be delegated, and what must be escalated

• Demonstrate hands-on proficiency in both Kartra and GoHighLevel

• Learn the team’s trackers, communication channels, programs, and workflows

• Begin organizing Ashley’s calendar, inbox, follow-ups, and open assignments

• Establish a reliable system for tracking tasks through completion

• Identify missed deadlines, stalled conversations, and operational gaps

• Demonstrate fast response times and dependable follow-through

• Bring at least one practical recommendation for improving an existing process



CORE RESPONSIBILITIES



EXECUTIVE CALENDAR AND INBOX MANAGEMENT



• Manage a complex calendar involving clients, attorneys, partners, speaking engagements, internal meetings, travel, and personal obligations

• Schedule and reschedule meetings quickly while accounting for priorities, time zones, preparation time, travel, and calendar buffers

• Identify conflicts and propose solutions before involving Ashley

• Monitor and organize Ashley’s inbox

• Prioritize urgent, revenue-generating, client-sensitive, legal, and relationship-sensitive messages

• Draft professional correspondence in Ashley’s voice

• Follow up on unanswered messages until the matter is resolved

• Protect Ashley from unnecessary meetings, interruptions, and overbooking



URGENT EXECUTIVE SUPPORT



• Respond immediately to time-sensitive assignments during scheduled hours

• Begin working without unnecessary delay

• Communicate when an assignment will be completed

• Research missing information independently

• Present recommendations and solutions—not just questions or problems

• Escalate legal, financial, contractual, client, or reputational risks appropriately

• Adjust priorities quickly without losing track of previously assigned work

• Raise concerns before a deadline is missed



KARTRA AND GOHIGHLEVEL ADMINISTRATION



• Work confidently and independently inside both Kartra and GoHighLevel

• Maintain contacts, tags, custom fields, pipelines, calendars, campaigns, automations, and customer records

• Support lead capture, follow-up, scheduling, client communication, and program workflows

• Troubleshoot routine platform issues

• Review records for accuracy and correct errors promptly

• Monitor automations and identify when a workflow is not functioning properly

• Document platform processes so they can be repeated consistently



Candidates must be able to explain exactly what they have personally built, managed, automated, or troubleshot in both platforms. Familiarity without hands-on experience is not sufficient.



TRAVEL AND PERSONAL LOGISTICS



• Research and coordinate domestic and international travel

• Present actual flight and hotel options with prices, schedules, cancellation terms, transportation, and entry requirements

• Prepare complete, easy-to-follow itineraries

• Coordinate speaking engagements, conferences, meals, meetings, and personal or family logistics when assigned

• Build appropriate travel buffers and contingency options

• Contact airlines, hotels, transportation companies, vendors, banks, and service providers on Ashley’s behalf



CLIENT AND EXECUTIVE COMMUNICATION



• Communicate professionally with clients, attorneys, sponsors, prospects, vendors, executives, and partners

• Make and receive telephone calls to and from the United States

• Represent Ashley with warmth, confidence, discretion, and authority

• Resolve routine requests independently

• Protect important relationships through timely and thoughtful communication

• Keep Ashley informed without overwhelming her with unnecessary details

title: Translator / Localization Specialist – Freelance / Remote
description:
JOB OVERVIEW



**Peak Media World** is looking for reliable and detail-oriented **Translator / Localization Specialists** to support us in expanding our digital content into additional international markets.



We are not looking for someone who simply translates word for word. We are looking for someone who understands **localization**: adapting content so that it feels natural, clear, culturally appropriate, and professionally written for the target audience.



About the Role



Our content is currently produced primarily in **German and English**.



We are currently building our localization network for two additional language markets:



* **Spanish**

* **Portuguese**



We are particularly interested in **native speakers** who have a strong command of written language and can ensure that localized content feels genuinely natural to the target audience.



The role will initially focus on translating and localizing existing and newly created content, including digital guides, books, articles, website content, product descriptions, and other digital materials.



Our content portfolio will continue to grow, so this can develop into an ongoing collaboration.



What You Will Do



* Translate and localize German and/or English content into your native language

* Adapt wording, expressions, tone, and examples to the target market where appropriate

* Ensure that translated content sounds natural rather than machine-translated

* Review and correct AI-assisted translations

* Check grammar, spelling, terminology, consistency, and readability

* Maintain consistent terminology across larger projects

* Identify cultural or linguistic issues that should be adapted rather than translated literally

* Follow provided style guides, terminology lists, and formatting requirements

* Perform quality checks before content is published

* Communicate clearly when something in the source content is unclear or requires a decision



AI-Assisted Workflow



We use **AI wherever it can make our processes faster and more efficient**.



This means you may receive AI-assisted translations or drafts as a starting point.



Your role is **not to compete with AI on word-for-word translation**, but to provide the human expertise that AI cannot reliably provide:



**accuracy · natural language · cultural understanding · consistency · quality control**



You should therefore be comfortable working with AI tools and reviewing AI-generated content critically.



What We Are Looking For



You should have:



* Native-level command of **Spanish or Portuguese**

* Very good English and/or German

* Excellent written language skills

* A strong feeling for language, tone, and context

* Excellent attention to detail

* A structured and reliable working style

* Experience with translation, localization, content editing, proofreading, or similar work

* The ability to follow detailed instructions and style guidelines

* Good communication skills

* The ability to work independently and meet agreed deadlines



Experience with **digital products, publishing, e-commerce, websites, SEO content, or online content** is an advantage.



Important



You do **not** need to speak both languages.



We are looking for specialists for one or both of the following language markets:



**Spanish · Portuguese**



Please indicate clearly in your application:



1. Which language you are a native speaker of

2. Your country or regional language background

3. Your level of English and/or German

4. Your experience with translation/localization

5. Which tools you normally use

6. Whether you have experience reviewing or improving AI-generated translations



Working Arrangement



* **Remote**

* **Freelance / part-time collaboration**

* Flexible working hours

* Project-based work with the potential for ongoing collaboration

* Workload will grow according to our content production and localization needs



## About Peak Media World



Peak Media World is building a portfolio of digital content, knowledge products, and international online projects.



We value:



**quality · reliability · clear processes · careful work · continuous improvement**



We are building our workflows with a strong focus on **automation and AI-supported processes**, while keeping human expertise where it creates real value.



If you enjoy language, precision, and making content feel genuinely native to its audience, we would love to hear from you.



How to Apply



Please include **“LOCALIZATION”** in your application.



Tell us briefly:



* Whether you specialize in Spanish or Portuguese

* Your native language and country/regional language background

* Your relevant experience

* Your availability

* Your expected hourly rate

* A short example of previous translation/localization work, if available



**Please make sure that “LOCALIZATION” appears in your application.**

title: Executive Assistant & Operations Coordinator
description:
About EDGE Outdoors



EDGE Outdoors is a growing outdoor living construction company based in Greenville, South Carolina. We design and build screen rooms, sunrooms, power screen systems, pergolas, and related outdoor living projects.



We are looking for an exceptional Executive Assistant and Operations Coordinator to work directly with one of the company owners. This is not a basic data entry or task-only virtual assistant position. We need someone who can become a trusted right hand — helping the owner stay organized, follow through on commitments, communicate professionally, and keep important responsibilities from falling through the cracks.



The right person will be proactive, highly organized, comfortable communicating with American customers, and confident working across
, scheduling, phone calls, customer follow-up, administrative tasks, QuickBooks, and business systems.



Position Summary



This role combines executive assistance, customer communication, appointment scheduling, business administration, and light bookkeeping support. The assistant will help protect the owner's time, maintain a reliable view of priorities and deadlines, and provide the administrative support that keeps the company's systems, customer follow-up, and financial records organized.

As the company grows, this role will evolve toward deeper executive support and strategic operations.



Primary Responsibilities



Executive and Daily Support

•  Participate in a brief daily planning call with the owner.

•  Capture brain dumps, voice notes, and meeting discussions and convert them into organized tasks, priorities, reminders, and follow-up items.

•  Maintain the owner's daily and weekly task lists, schedule, deadlines, commitments, and outstanding decisions. Prepare daily priority lists and weekly planning summaries.

•  Identify scheduling conflicts, overdue items, and potential problems before they become urgent.

•  Follow up respectfully with the owner and team members to help ensure important tasks are completed.

•  Prepare meeting agendas, take organized notes, document decisions, and track resulting action items.



 and Inbox Management

•  Review, organize, and maintain the owner's
 inbox. Identify and flag urgent or important messages and separate actionable
s from informational or low-priority messages.

•  Draft professional responses for review and respond directly to approved types of messages when authorized.

•  Track
s that require a response, decision, or follow-up so important communication is not overlooked.

•  Maintain organized folders, labels, and follow-up systems for customer, vendor, subcontractor, and internal communication.



Phone Answering and Appointment Scheduling

•  Answer incoming business calls professionally during assigned U.S. Eastern Time business hours. Serve as a friendly and professional first point of contact for prospective and existing customers.

•  Follow company-approved call scripts and qualification standards. Gather essential information from new leads, including contact information, property details, desired service, timeline, and lead source.

•  Ask approved qualifying questions to determine whether the customer and project are a potential fit for EDGE Outdoors. Enter complete and accurate call notes into the company CRM.

•  Review the owner's availability and schedule qualified sales appointments directly on the appropriate calendar. Confirm, reschedule, or cancel appointments and keep the calendar accurate.

•  Follow up with missed calls, voi
s, website inquiries, and customers who have not completed scheduling. Route urgent matters to the correct person and filter spam and solicitations.

Customer Communication and Sales Follow-Up

•  Follow up with prospective customers who have outstanding quotes or have not responded. Monitor the sales pipeline, outstanding quotes, and appointments so opportunities are not lost.

•  Help maintain consistent communication with active customers using approved information and templates. Answer basic customer questions and escalate urgent, sensitive, or technical issues.

•  Document customer communications, outcomes, and next steps in the CRM. Maintain a professional, confident, helpful, and friendly tone that represents the company well.



Bookkeeping, Payroll, and Payment Support

•  Assist with preparing and maintaining payroll information, including employee hours, approved pay rates, reimbursements, and other payroll-related records. Help prepare payroll and subcontractor payments for owner review and approval.

•  Track subcontractor work orders, approved amounts, invoices, payments, and outstanding balances. Match vendor invoices and subcontractor bills to the correct customer, project, or expense account.

•  Enter approved bills, expenses, vendor information, and other transactions into QuickBooks Online. Collect and organize invoices, receipts, work orders, W-9s, insurance certificates, and payment records.

•  Monitor accounts payable and maintain a clear list of upcoming, due, and overdue payments. Follow up when invoices, receipts, approvals, or required documentation are missing.

•  Prepare concise weekly summaries of payroll due, subcontractor payments, vendor invoices, cash commitments, and items requiring approval. Coordinate with the company's bookkeeper, accountant, or payroll provider when needed.



Business Operations, Systems, and Reporting

•  Keep JobTread, QuickBooks, company calendars, task lists, and other approved systems accurate and current. Review CRM records for missing notes, incomplete tasks, and inaccurate information.

•  Collect and organize information for KPI scorecards, financial reviews, sales reports, and leadership meetings. Assist with tracking leads, lead sources, appointment outcomes, and other approved performance measurements.

•  Monitor recurring workflows and automations for failures or incomplete records and report issues to the owner. Assist with customer
 templates, reminders, follow-up sequences, and other approved automations.



Documentation, Hiring, and File Management

•  Assist with company forms and maintain organized customer, project, employee, vendor, and subcontractor records. Upload, name, sort, and manage files using company naming and storage standards.

•  Convert recurring instructions and workflows into checklists, templates, and standard operating procedures. Help maintain company policies, training materials, and process documentation.

•  Assist with administrative hiring and onboarding tasks, including scheduling interviews, gathering documents, and completing checklists. Protect confidential financial, employee, customer, and company information at all times.



Authority and Escalation



The assistant is expected to resolve authorized administrative matters independently and bring important issues forward early. Strategic decisions, contractual commitments, hiring decisions, payment authorization, changes to approved financial information, and other consequential business decisions remain subject to owner approval.



Required Qualifications

•  Exceptional spoken and written English. Clear, natural, confident, and easily understandable phone communication.

•  Comfort speaking directly with U.S.-based customers, vendors, and subcontractors.

•  Strong organization, attention to detail, follow-through, and personal accountability.

•  Ability to turn unstructured conversations and ideas into clear tasks and next steps.

•  Ability to manage multiple priorities and distinguish urgent matters from items that can wait.

•  Professional judgment, discretion, and respect for confidential information.

•  Comfort using
, calendars, cloud-based files, and online business software. Willingness to learn new software, procedures, and construction industry terminology.

•  Reliable computer, professional headset, stable internet connection, and quiet workspace with a dependable backup plan for internet or power interruptions.

•  Availability to work full-time during agreed U.S. Eastern Time business hours and participate in voice and video calls.

Preferred Qualifications



These qualifications are helpful but not mandatory:

•  Experience as an executive assistant, administrative assistant, operations coordinator, or customer service representative — especially working directly with a business owner or executive.

•  Experience supporting a construction, home service, or project-based company.

•  Familiarity with QuickBooks Online and basic bookkeeping principles.

•  Experience with a CRM, project management platform, or customer scheduling system.

•  Customer service, inbound phone answering, lead qualification, or appointment scheduling experience.

•  Experience creating
 templates, administrative automations, reports, or standard procedures.

•  Basic understanding of invoices, expenses, vendors, subcontractors, payroll records, and customer payments.

Advanced accounting or complex spreadsheet expertise is not required. Basic accounting knowledge and confidence working with accurate financial records would be a strong advantage.

The Person We Are Looking For

•  Naturally keeps people, information, and projects organized. Creates order from scattered information and incomplete conversations.

•  Takes ownership instead of waiting for every individual instruction.

•  Knows how to respectfully remind a busy owner about commitments. Communicates problems early rather than allowing them to become emergencies.

•  Asks thoughtful questions and verifies unclear information instead of guessing.

•  Is comfortable learning new systems and steadily taking on greater responsibility.

•  Wants to grow into a trusted, long-term role within a developing company.



We do not expect this person to know everything on the first day. We do expect clear communication, fast learning, accurate notes, consistent follow-through, and a genuine willingness to take responsibility.



Working Schedule

•  Full-time remote position based in the Philippines.

•  Must be available during agreed U.S. Eastern Time business hours.

•  Daily voice or video check-in with the owner.

•  Some schedule flexibility may occasionally be required based on customer or business needs.



How to Apply

Begin your application with the words "EDGE EXECUTIVE ASSISTANT" so we know you carefully reviewed the entire posting.

Please submit all of the following:

1.  A brief introduction explaining your relevant experience and why this position interests you.

2.  A resume outlining your applicable work history.

3.  A 60- to 90-second voice or video introduction in English.

4.  A list of business systems you have used, including QuickBooks, CRMs,
, calendars, phone systems, or project management tools.

5.  Your required hourly rate or monthly compensation.

6.  Confirmation that you are available to work U.S. Eastern Time hours.

7.  Your internet speed and backup plan for internet or power interruptions.



Application Exercises



Organization Scenario

The owner gives you a ten-minute voice update containing three customer follow-ups, an unpaid vendor invoice, an appointment that must be moved, and two ideas that are not urgent. Briefly explain how you would organize the information, determine what needs immediate attention, and report it back to the owner.

Customer Phone Scenario



Submit a brief mock response to this incoming call: "Hi, I found your company online. I am interested in screening in my back porch, but I am not sure what options you offer or what it might cost." Demonstrate how you would greet the caller, gather information, ask useful questions, and guide the customer toward the appropriate next step.



Why EDGE Outdoors



EDGE Outdoors is a young company with serious momentum. You would be working directly with an owner who is building something from the ground up and who values the people who help make it happen. This is an opportunity to grow with a company — not just fill a seat.



We are looking for someone who can become a dependable and trusted part of the company, not someone who only completes isolated tasks. If you are proactive, organized, confident in English, comfortable communicating with customers, and capable of helping a busy business owner stay focused and accountable, we would like to hear from you.

title: U.S Senior Mortgage Loan Processor — Remote
description:
Senior Mortgage Loan Processor — Remote | Philippines

About Elite Processing Team



Elite Processing Team is a fast-growing U.S.-based mortgage processing company supporting mortgage brokers and loan officers nationwide.



We specialize in full-cycle U.S. residential mortgage processing, managing loans from submission through Clear to Close and funding. Our focus is speed, accuracy, communication, and accountability.



We are expanding our remote team in the Philippines and looking for an experienced Senior Mortgage Loan Processor who can independently manage a high-volume pipeline.



U.S. MORTGAGE PROCESSING EXPERIENCE IS REQUIRED



This is not an entry-level position. Candidates must have direct, hands-on experience processing U.S. residential mortgage loans.



Applicants without U.S. mortgage processing experience will not be considered.



Position Details

Location: 100% Remote — Philippines

Schedule: Monday–Friday | U.S. Business Hours

Prepare complete files for underwriting

Independently clear PTD, PTC, and PTF underwriting conditions

Communicate directly with underwriters and lenders

Coordinate Clear to Close and closing requirements

Maintain accurate LOS notes and milestones

Provide proactive updates to borrowers and Loan Officers

U.S. Mortgage Experience — REQUIRED

Non-QM

Systems & Technology

Loan Product Advisor (LPA/LP)

Wholesale lender portals

DocuSign and mortgage document platforms

PDF/document management

Microsoft Outlook & Teams — REQUIRED



Candidates must be comfortable using Microsoft Outlook and Microsoft Teams daily, including:



Managing high-volume

Writing professional
s

Managing calendars and meeting invitations

Teams chat and internal communication

Teams video meetings

File sharing and collaboration

Communication Standards



This is a client-facing position.



You must have:



Excellent written and verbal English

Professional phone and
 communication

Ability to explain underwriting conditions clearly

Excellent follow-up skills

:

title: Full Time Short Form Video Editor (Reels) With Film B Roll Sourcing
description:
Full Time Short Form Video Editor (Reels) With Film B Roll Sourcing



Overview



We are hiring a full time editor to produce high performing short form reels built around our talking head recordings, with B roll sourced from well known movies that visually match the story, emotion, and meaning of the script. This is not a basic cutting job. The output must match a specific pacing, caption style, and overall “feel” that we will provide via a reference video.



What You Will Edit



You will receive a raw recording of our founder speaking to camera. Your job is to turn that into a finished reel by layering in movie B roll that reinforces the message, then adding our captions in a very specific, consistent style.



Output Expectations



You will deliver a 60 reels per month if working full time - 30 for part time



Core Responsibilities



You will source B roll clips from famous movies that match the script meaning, tone, and emotion, and you will build a clean, fast paced narrative with strong retention. You will edit and time captions exactly as provided, using our required caption style with zero deviations. You will assemble the final reel in 9:16 format with correct pacing, sound design, and overall polish. You will maintain an organised B roll library so sourcing becomes faster over time and we are not re finding the same types of scenes repeatedly. You will deliver consistently and communicate clearly on progress, questions, and revisions.



Required Skills



You must be a strong short form editor with proven reels or TikTok work. You must be excellent at storytelling through B roll selection, not just transitions. You must be highly detail oriented because caption formatting and timing must match our reference exactly. You must work fast without quality drop and be able to hit volume targets. You must be fluent in English and able to interpret script meaning and emotion accurately. You must have strong organisation habits for file naming, folders, and project management.



Software



Premiere Pro, Final Cut, or CapCut is fine as long as you can match the reference output consistently and export correctly for Instagram Reels.



How To Apply



Send 1 portfolio link that shows short form edits similar to this style. Include 1 to 2 sentences confirming you can source movie style B roll to match a script, and that you can replicate caption style precisely. If you are shortlisted, we will ask you to complete a paid test edit using our raw clip and the reference video.



Compensation



Competitive and based on experience, speed, and quality. This is a full time role with long term potential if you consistently hit the quality bar and monthly output.



Reference Video



We will attach a reference video in the job post. Your work must match that style. Please watch a few times to understand

description:
We are looking for an experienced and detail-oriented Bookkeeper to support a U.S.-based company. The ideal candidate should have 2–3 years of bookkeeping experience with U.S. companies and a strong understanding of the end-to-end bookkeeping process, including account and bank reconciliations. The candidate must be experienced with QuickBooks Online and QuickBooks Desktop, as well as Zoho and Double CRM (formerly Keeper). Strong Microsoft Excel and Microsoft Teams skills are also required.



Beyond technical bookkeeping skills, we are looking for someone who is proactive, computer-savvy, and comfortable working independently. The candidate should be able to recognize when transactions, records, or information do not match or align, investigate the issue, and confidently ask the appropriate questions rather than simply proceeding with an entry.

The candidate must also be confident and comfortable communicating directly with U.S.-based clients and colleagues, both verbally and in writing.





Tasks that will be assigned:

1. Required Technical Skills

* QuickBooks Online (QBO) – experienced user

* QuickBooks Desktop – experienced user

* Zoho

* Double CRM (formerly Keeper)

* Microsoft Excel

* Microsoft Teams

* Strong knowledge of bank and account reconciliations

* Strong understanding of the end-to-end bookkeeping process



2. Required Experience

* 2–3 years of bookkeeping experience with U.S.-based companies

* Experience handling bookkeeping processes and financial records for U.S. businesses

* Experience working independently in a remote environment is preferred



3. Communication Skills

* Confident and comfortable communicating with U.S. clients and colleagues

* Strong spoken and written English communication skills

* Comfortable participating in conversations with U.S.-based stakeholders

* Able to clearly explain bookkeeping issues and discrepancies

* Comfortable asking clarifying questions when information is incomplete or does not align

* Able to communicate professionally through
, Microsoft Teams, and verbal conversations



Behavioral Competencies

* Proactive – identifies and addresses potential issues rather than waiting for instructions

* Detail-oriented – able to spot discrepancies, inconsistencies, and unusual transactions

* Analytical and logical – understands how transactions and financial records should align

* Problem-solving – able to investigate discrepancies and determine the appropriate next step

* Questioning mindset – knows when something does not make sense and is comfortable asking questions

* Computer savvy – able to work efficiently across multiple software platforms

* Organized and dependable – able to manage recurring bookkeeping responsibilities and deadlines

* Independent worker – capable of managing assigned responsibilities with minimal supervision

* Professional – able to work effectively with U.S.-based clients and colleagues



Ideal Candidate Profile:

The ideal candidate is more than a data-entry bookkeeper. We need someone who understands bookkeeping well enough to recognize when something does not make sense or does not align.

title: Amazon Wholesale Virtual Assistant — Product Sourcing Specialist
description:
We are looking for an experienced Amazon Wholesale Virtual Assistant to join our growing team. The primary focus of this position will be finding profitable Amazon wholesale products, reverse sourcing, distributor research, and analyzing products using SellerAmp and Keepa.



We are looking for someone who understands Amazon wholesale at an advanced level and can independently identify profitable products rather than simply following a list of instructions.



Primary Responsibilities



* Conduct Amazon wholesale product sourcing and reverse sourcing

* Use SellerAmp SAS to analyze products and determine profitability

* Use Keepa for advanced product and sales-history analysis

* Research products based on:

    * ROI and profit margin

    * Sales rank and sales-rank history

    * Buy Box history and stability

    * Buy Box ownership

    * Seller count and seller rotation

    * FBA vs. FBM competition

    * Price history

    * Estimated monthly sales

    * Amazon presence on the listing

    * Number of sellers and historical seller behavior

    * IP/brand restrictions and potential sourcing risks

* Find products with consistent sales history and sustainable margins, not just products that are temporarily profitable

* Reverse source successful Amazon listings to find additional products from the same brands, manufacturers, and distributors

* Research and identify profitable wholesale distributors

* Research brands and determine whether they are suitable for Amazon wholesale

* Contact distributors and brands by
 and phone

* Assist with opening wholesale accounts

* Contact brands regarding reseller applications and authorization

* Assist with Amazon ungating and approval processes

* Maintain organized sourcing information in Google Sheets

* Track potential suppliers, products, costs, profitability, and sourcing opportunities

* Communicate findings clearly and provide product sourcing recommendations



SellerAmp Requirements



You should be comfortable using SellerAmp SAS at an advanced level, including:



* Analyzing products directly from Amazon listings

* Evaluating FBA fees and true net profit

* Calculating ROI and profit margins

* Understanding Buy Box dynamics

* Evaluating competition and seller rotation

* Identifying Amazon as a seller

* Identifying potentially unstable pricing

* Comparing current pricing to historical pricing

* Evaluating sales rank and sales-rank history

* Determining whether a product has enough sales velocity to justify purchasing

* Using SellerAmp to find and evaluate profitable sourcing opportunities

* Understanding when SellerAmp numbers look profitable but the product may still be a poor wholesale opportunity



Keepa Requirements



You should have strong experience analyzing Keepa charts, including:



* Sales-rank history

* Buy Box history

* Price history

* Seller-count history

* Amazon’s historical presence

* Identifying seasonal products

* Identifying price tanking

* Recognizing stable vs. unstable listings

* Evaluating historical sales velocity

* Understanding seller rotation and competition

* Determining whether a product has a sustainable wholesale opportunity



Experience Requirements



Preferred:



* At least 1+ year of Amazon Wholesale experience

* Experience sourcing products for Amazon FBA

* Experience working with an Amazon wholesale business generating $30,000+ per month in sales

* Advanced SellerAmp SAS knowledge

* Advanced Keepa knowledge

* Experience with reverse sourcing

* Experience finding and evaluating wholesale distributors

* Experience contacting brands and distributors

* Experience opening wholesale accounts

* Experience with Amazon ungating

* Strong Google Sheets skills



No Experience? You Can Still Apply



If you don’t meet all of the experience requirements but believe you have the skills and ability to become a strong Amazon wholesale product researcher, we are still willing to consider you.



We are more interested in finding someone who is motivated, analytical, reliable, and willing to learn than someone who simply has years of experience on paper.



What We Are Looking For



The ideal candidate:



* Is highly detail-oriented

* Can work independently

* Understands Amazon wholesale economics

* Knows how to distinguish a good product from a bad product

* Doesn’t rely solely on current Buy Box price when determining profitability

* Can explain why a product is a good sourcing opportunity

* Is comfortable researching for hours to find profitable opportunities

* Has strong communication skills

* Is reliable and consistent

* Wants to build a long-term working relationship

* Is willing to continuously improve their sourcing skills



Compensation



Compensation will be based on experience and skill level.



The position will include:



* Hourly pay

* Performance-based business percentage bonus



We are looking for someone who wants to become a long-term member of our team, not someone looking for a short-term job.



If you have strong Amazon wholesale sourcing skills, understand SellerAmp and Keepa, and are confident in your ability to find profitable products, we want to hear from you.



Please apply and tell us about your Amazon wholesale experience, the tools you have used, and the type of products and suppliers you have sourced.
