title: Executive Operations Lead - Founder's Office
description:
U.S. Healthcare & Startup

Remote — Philippines

Full-time | U.S. Eastern Time hours

₱85,000–₱125,000/month, depending on experience and capability





We are looking for an unusually capable, reliable and hands-on operator to work directly with the founder of a growing U.S. mental healthcare business and healthcare technology startup.



This is not a traditional Executive Assistant role.



We need someone who can operate at a high level, take ownership of workflows and projects, and make sure things actually get done — while having absolutely no hesitation about rolling up their sleeves and doing the detailed work required to get there.



High-level responsibility. Low ego. Strong execution.



One day you might coordinate a hiring or employee-onboarding workflow, manage an outreach campaign, work with a designer on a creative project, research a new tool, or organize a startup initiative. The next, you may spend 45 minutes on the phone with an insurance company completing a verification, chase down missing payroll information, clean up a spreadsheet, create a Canva asset, or repeatedly follow up with someone until an open item is finally resolved.

We need someone who is equally comfortable with both.



What the Role Looks Like

Your responsibilities will span several businesses and will evolve over time. They may include:

• Owning and coordinating established hiring, onboarding, payroll and people-operations workflows 

• U.S. healthcare administration, including insurance verification, payer portals and phone calls with insurance companies 

• Marketing and social-media execution, including Canva and coordinating creative work 

• Supporting startup marketing and outreach initiatives, campaigns, contractors and new tools 

• Research, vendor coordination, project management and follow-up 

• Maintaining trackers, SOPs and operational systems 

• Preparing work for the founder’s review and bringing him in when a decision is actually needed 

• Handling the many miscellaneous operational problems that arise in growing businesses 



You will not be expected to know everything when you start.

You will be expected to figure things out, communicate clearly, follow through relentlessly and learn quickly.



Do It. Own It. Improve It.

That is how we think about this position.



Do it: You are willing and able to execute the work yourself.

Own it: Once something is in your hands, you take responsibility for the outcome. You follow up, keep track of open loops and make sure things don't quietly disappear.

Improve it: Once you understand a process, you look for ways to make it simpler, faster or more reliable.

Over time, the goal is for this person to become a trusted right hand to the founder — someone who can take a project, workflow or problem and carry it forward with minimal supervision.



Who We’re Looking For

The right person is exceptionally reliable, organized, resourceful and persistent.



You should have excellent spoken and written English and be comfortable working directly with U.S.-based employees, candidates, vendors and organizations.



You should be comfortable making phone calls, learning new software, using AI intelligently, following established processes and politely but persistently chasing people when something needs to get done.



Previous experience with U.S. healthcare, executive support, operations, healthcare BPO, recruiting coordination, startups or project coordination is highly valuable.



Most importantly, you should be someone who takes pride in being the person others can depend on.



Schedule & Commitment

This is a full-time, long-term position primarily working U.S. Eastern Time hours.



We strongly prefer someone who has successfully worked U.S. night-shift hours before.



This is expected to be your primary professional commitment. Because of the night schedule, we also expect you to organize outside work, school or other recurring commitments so that you can be well-rested and fully engaged during working hours.

We care about results, responsiveness, reliability and ownership — not monitoring every minute of your day.



Compensation & Time Off

₱85,000–₱125,000/month, depending on experience and demonstrated capability.

The role also includes 10 paid vacation/personal days, 5 paid sick/emergency days, and designated paid holidays.

There is significant room for responsibility and compensation to grow for someone who becomes an exceptional long-term contributor.



How to Apply

We expect to receive a high volume of applications.



To be considered, please complete our application form:







Please use specific examples from your actual work. Generic applications are unlikely to be competitive.

Strong candidates will be invited to the next stages of our process, which may include an interview and paid practical exercise.

For our final one or two candidates, we will conduct professional reference checks and verify relevant employment history before finalizing an offer.

We are not looking for someone who simply wants another remote job. We are looking for someone who wants to become an important, highly trusted part of the businesses for the long term.

Please do not send a generic cover letter separately.

________________________________________

Our Selection Process

We expect to receive a high volume of applications, and we appreciate the time candidates invest in applying.

Unfortunately, we may not be able to respond individually to every applicant.

Candidates who appear to be the strongest fit will be contacted for the next stage of the process.

Our process may include:

Application review → interview → paid practical work exercise → final conversation → references

For our final one or two candidates, we will conduct professional reference checks and verify relevant employment history before finalizing an offer. Any offer may be contingent upon satisfactory completion of these checks.

We are intentionally taking our time to find the right person.

We are not looking for someone who simply wants another remote job.

We are looking for someone who wants a serious, long-term role, enjoys getting things done, and wants to become a highly trusted and important part of our team.

What actually matters to us:

 campaign on

 if a campaign is actually working?

title: mazon E-Commerce & PPC Specialist — Virtual Assistant
description:
Experience: 3+ years of Amazon / e-commerce experience

Employment Type - Full-time

Industry:** Amazon FBA / E-commerce / Consumer Electronics



 About the Role



We are looking for an experienced, analytical, and reliable  Amazon E-Commerce & PPC Specialist to join our growing e-commerce business.



This is not a basic virtual assistant position. We are looking for someone who understands how Amazon businesses operate and can take ownership of important areas such as **PPC optimization, product research, keyword research, competitor analysis, and performance reporting**.



The ideal candidate has 3+ years of hands-on Amazon experience, preferably working with an Amazon brand or seller. Experience managing Amazon advertising campaigns and using tools such as **Helium 10 and Keepa** is a major advantage.



We are looking for someone who can analyze data, identify problems and opportunities, make recommendations, and eventually take ownership of day-to-day Amazon e-commerce operations.



 Key Responsibilities



Amazon PPC & Advertising



* Review and analyze Amazon advertising performance on a regular basis.

* Analyze sales, advertising spend, ACOS, ROAS, conversion rates, CPC, CTR, impressions, clicks, orders, keywords, and search terms.

* Identify underperforming and high-performing campaigns, keywords, products, and search terms.

* Optimize PPC campaigns based on performance data.

* Recommend changes to **bids, budgets, keywords, targeting, negative keywords, and campaign structure**.

* Identify opportunities to improve advertising efficiency and profitability.

* Prepare clear PPC reports with actionable recommendations.

* Monitor trends and identify problems before they become significant.

* Assist with developing and testing new PPC strategies.



Amazon Product Research



* Research potential products and evaluate their market potential.

* Analyze competitors, pricing, reviews, ratings, sales estimates, product trends, and market conditions.

* Identify product opportunities and potential risks.

* Use Amazon research tools to evaluate competition and demand.

* Prepare organized product research reports and recommendations.



Keyword Research



* Conduct Amazon keyword research.

* Analyze **search volume, competition, relevance, ranking, conversion potential, and keyword performance**.

* Identify primary, secondary, long-tail, and negative keywords.

* Research competitor keywords and search terms.

* Use keyword data to support both PPC and organic ranking strategies.



Amazon Operations



Depending on experience, responsibilities may also include:



* Amazon Seller Central management.

* Inventory monitoring and forecasting.

* Product listing analysis.

* Competitor monitoring.

* Pricing monitoring.

* Sales and profitability analysis.

* Identifying listing or account issues.

* Preparing spreadsheets and reports.

* Supporting general Amazon e-commerce operations.



Required Qualifications



Amazon Experience



**3+ years of hands-on Amazon / e-commerce experience is required.**



Strong preference will be given to candidates who have:



* Previously worked for an **Amazon brand or established Amazon seller.

* Managed or assisted with Amazon PPC campaigns.

* Worked directly inside **Amazon Seller Central.

* Experience with Amazon FBA.

* Experience with product research and keyword research.

* Experience analyzing Amazon sales and advertising data.



Analytical & Technical Skills



You should have:



* Strong analytical and numerical skills.

* Ability to work with large amounts of data.

* Ability to identify trends and patterns.

* Ability to recognize problems and investigate their causes.

* Strong attention to detail.

* Ability to make decisions based on data rather than assumptions.

* Excellent Excel / Google Sheets skills.

* Comfortable working with formulas, tables, filters, sorting, and data analysis.



Amazon Tools



Experience with the following is highly desirable:



* Helium 10 — required or strongly preferred*

* Keepa**

* Amazon Seller Central

* Amazon Ads / Advertising Console

* Google Sheets / Microsoft Excel

* Other Amazon research and analytics tools



### Communication



Excellent **English communication skills are required**, both written and spoken.



You must be able to:



* Clearly communicate findings and recommendations.

* Write professional reports and messages.

* Explain why a campaign, product, or keyword is performing well or poorly.

* Communicate problems quickly and clearly.

* Work independently while keeping management informed.



## Additional Skills — Strong Assets



The following are not mandatory but will make your application significantly stronger:



Marketing



* Digital marketing experience.

* Amazon marketing experience.

* Understanding of conversion rate optimization.

* Understanding of customer behavior and competitive positioning.

* Experience with e-commerce marketing outside Amazon.



Design & Content



Experience with:



* Basic photo editing

* Product image optimization

* Video editing

* Amazon listing creative/content



AI & Technology



We are looking for someone who is comfortable learning and using modern technology.



Experience using **AI tools to improve productivity, research, data analysis, reporting, writing, or e-commerce operations** is a strong advantage.



You should be comfortable learning new software and finding ways to use technology to work more efficiently.



Educational Background



Candidates with education or professional backgrounds in:



* Engineering

* Computer Science

* Information Technology

* Mathematics

* Statistics

* Data Analytics

* Business / Marketing

* Economics

* Other technical or analytical fields



are particularly encouraged to apply.



## What We Are Looking For



The most important quality we are looking for is **ownership**.



We don't want someone who simply waits for instructions and completes a checklist.



We want someone who can say:



> "I reviewed the data, found this problem, investigated the reason, and here is what I recommend we do."



You should be:



* Reliable and dependable.

* Highly organized.

* Proactive.

* Analytical.

* Detail-oriented.

* Comfortable working independently.

* Willing to learn.

* Comfortable taking responsibility.

* Able to meet deadlines.

* Interested in building a long-term working relationship.



Internet & Work Requirements



* Reliable, high-speed internet connection.

* Reliable computer suitable for working with multiple browser tabs, Amazon Seller Central, spreadsheets, and research tools.

* Ability to work remotely without constant supervision.

* Professional communication and availability during agreed working hours.



Application Instructions — IMPORTANT



**Applications that do not follow the instruction below will be automatically discarded.**



When applying, you **MUST include the following sentence, or a clear paraphrased version of it, either in the subject line or as the FIRST sentence of your application:**



**"I am interested in learning and taking ownership of Amazon e-commerce operations."**



For example, you may write:



**"I am excited to learn, take ownership, and grow with Amazon e-commerce operations."**



Failure to include this sentence or a clear paraphrase **will result in your application being automatically rejected.**



## Please Include the Following in Your Application



Please answer the following questions:



1. **How many years of Amazon / e-commerce experience do you have?**

2. **Have you previously worked for an Amazon brand or Amazon seller? Please describe your role.**

3. **What experience do you have with Amazon Seller Central?**

4. **What experience do you have with Amazon PPC / Amazon Advertising?**

5. **How comfortable are you analyzing ACOS, ROAS, CPC, conversion rate, search terms, keywords, and campaign performance?**

6. **What experience do you have with Helium 10? Please list the specific tools/features you have used.**

7. **What experience do you have with Keepa?**

8. **Describe your experience with product research.**

9. **Describe your experience with Amazon keyword research.**

10. **How would you identify an underperforming PPC campaign and determine what is causing the problem?**

11. **How would you evaluate whether a product is a good opportunity to sell on Amazon?**

12. **How would you rate your Excel / Google Sheets skills from 1–10?**

13. **Do you have experience with Canva, photo editing, or video editing?**

14. **What AI tools do you currently use in your work?**

15. **Do you have management, supervisory, or team leadership experience?**

16. **What is your educational background?**

17. **What is your current internet speed and do you have a backup internet connection?**

18. **Please provide your expected monthly salary.**

19. **Please provide your availability and preferred working hours.**

20. **Please provide examples of Amazon accounts, products, or PPC campaigns you have previously worked on, if available.**



## Compensation



Compensation will be based on **experience, skills, and level of responsibility**.



Candidates with strong Amazon PPC, product research, Helium 10, and analytical experience may be considered for higher compensation.



We are interested in finding the **right long-term person**, not simply the lowest-cost VA.



## Long-Term Opportunity



This position has the potential to grow into a larger role with increasing responsibility.



The right candidate can eventually take ownership of significant portions of our Amazon e-commerce operations, including **PPC, product research, competitor analysis, reporting, and day-to-day account management**.



If you are analytical, proactive, experienced with Amazon, and interested in growing with an e-commerce business, we would like to hear from you.

title: AI YouTube Video Editor – Script to Finished Video
description:
# AI YouTube Video Editor – Script to Finished Video



We are looking for a skilled and creative **AI Video Editor** who can take a completed video script and turn it into a **professional, engaging YouTube video from start to finish**.



This is not simply a video-cutting position.



You will receive the **finished script**, and you will be responsible for transforming that script into a complete, ready-to-upload video using AI tools, stock footage, images, graphics, sound effects, music, captions, and other visual elements.



Our content is primarily **Christian/Bible-based educational and commentary content**, so the editor must be comfortable working with religious subject matter.



## What You Will Be Responsible For



### 1. Script-to-Video Production



You must be able to take a written script and independently create the entire video.



This includes:



* Reviewing and understanding the script

* Creating or selecting an appropriate AI voiceover

* Finding relevant stock footage and B-roll

* Finding or creating appropriate images

* Using AI-generated images/video when appropriate

* Adding motion graphics, text, captions, Bible verses, maps, historical imagery, and other visual elements

* Adding background music and sound effects

* Creating smooth transitions

* Synchronizing visuals with the narration

* Maintaining strong pacing and viewer engagement

* Color correction and audio balancing

* Producing the final video in **4K when required**

* Creating both long-form YouTube videos and YouTube Shorts



The goal is for me to provide you with the **script**, and for you to return a **finished, professional video ready for YouTube**.



### 2. Strong Video Editing Skills



You should be proficient with professional editing software such as:



* Adobe Premiere Pro

* Adobe After Effects

* DaVinci Resolve

* Final Cut Pro

* CapCut Professional



Experience with AI video-production tools is highly preferred.



Examples may include AI voice generation, AI image generation, AI video generation, automatic captioning, image animation, and other AI-assisted production tools.



### 3. Storytelling & Viewer Retention



You must understand that YouTube editing is about more than making a video look good.



You should understand:



* Storytelling

* Pacing

* Pattern interrupts

* Visual changes that maintain viewer attention

* B-roll placement

* Music and sound design

* Emotional emphasis

* Hooks and retention

* When to use text, graphics, images, or video instead of leaving the same visual on screen too long



The finished video should visually support what the narrator is saying rather than simply showing random stock footage.



### 4. AI Video Production



You should be comfortable using AI tools to speed up production and improve quality.



You should be capable of independently determining when to use:



* AI-generated images

* AI-generated video

* AI voiceovers

* Stock footage

* Historical/public-domain imagery

* Motion graphics

* Text animation

* Maps and timelines

* Sound effects and music



AI-generated content should look professional and intentional—not like a basic automated slideshow.



### 5. YouTube Shorts



You must also be able to convert long-form content or scripts into engaging vertical videos.



Shorts should include:



* 9:16 vertical formatting

* Strong opening hook

* Fast but natural pacing

* Dynamic captions

* Visual changes

* B-roll and/or AI-generated visuals

* Sound effects when appropriate

* Background music

* Professional transitions



### 6. Copyright & Licensing



You must understand copyright, licensing, and fair-use principles.



All stock footage, images, music, sound effects, and other assets must be legally usable for a monetized YouTube channel.



You must be able to identify the source or license for assets if requested.



**Do not use copyrighted footage, music, images, or other material simply because it can be found online.**



### 7. Communication



You must:



* Communicate clearly in English

* Follow written instructions

* Respond to feedback professionally

* Make requested revisions

* Ask questions when something in a script is genuinely unclear

* Be able to work independently without needing step-by-step instructions for every video



### 8. Reliability & Time Management



You must be able to meet agreed deadlines consistently.



I am looking for someone interested in a **long-term working relationship**, not someone who will disappear after one or two projects.



## Software, AI Tools & Equipment



The editor is expected to have their **own computer, reliable internet connection, professional video-editing software, and access to the normal tools needed to complete the work.**



You should already have legitimate access to the editing and AI tools you normally use for your production workflow.



This may include:



* Professional video-editing software

* AI voice-generation tools

* AI image/video-generation tools

* Captioning tools

* Stock footage and image resources

* Music and sound-effect libraries

* Other tools you normally use to produce professional YouTube videos



You are responsible for the tools you choose to use as part of your normal editing workflow.



If I require the use of a **specific paid service, premium asset library, AI platform, or other subscription that is not normally part of your workflow**, we will discuss access or reimbursement before the expense is incurred.



**Do not use pirated software, unlicensed assets, or illegally obtained content.**



## Work Requirements



You must have the ability to produce approximately:



**3 high-quality long-form YouTube videos per 5-day work week**



Long-form videos will generally be approximately **7 minutes**.



You must also be capable of producing **YouTube Shorts** as assigned.



Quality is more important than simply producing videos quickly.



## What I Will Provide



I will provide:



* The completed video script

* General channel style/direction

* Examples of the editing quality and style expected

* Feedback when revisions are necessary



**You will be responsible for everything needed to turn the script into the finished video.**



## How to Apply



Please follow these instructions carefully. Applicants who do not follow them may not be considered.



**Step 1:** Watch the sample video linked below from beginning to end.







The sample demonstrates the approximate editing quality, pacing, visual storytelling, and overall style I expect.



**Step 2:** Leave a comment on the sample video so I know you watched it.



Include your OnlineJobs.ph name or another identifier in your application so I can match your comment with your application.



**Step 3:** In your application, send:



* Links to **2–3 videos you personally edited**

* At least **one example of a faceless/AI-assisted YouTube video**, if available

* A list of the editing and AI tools you currently use

* Your expected rate

* How long it normally takes you to turn a 7-minute script into a finished video

* Whether you can create the complete video when **only the script is provided**



**Step 4:** Start your application with the words:



**“SCRIPT TO VIDEO”**



This lets me know you read the entire job posting.



## Important



I am specifically looking for an editor who can work **independently from a finished script**.



If you require me to provide all of the footage, images, voiceovers, music, and other assets before you can begin editing, this position is probably not the right fit.



The ideal candidate can receive a script, understand the story being told, select or create the appropriate visual and audio assets, edit everything together, and deliver a polished video that is ready to upload to YouTube.



There is potential for **consistent, long-term work** for the right editor.

title: Full-Time Bookkeeper
description:
Senior Bookkeeper

Company: Speak Your Way To Cash® (and affiliated entities)

Reports to: [Director of Operations]

Type: Contractor

Compensation: $800

Start date: ASAP



Have you managed books for a company doing $10 Million USD or more? Have you reconciled hundreds or thousands of transactions a month? Are you savvy with financial reports? Do you know how manage a large chart of accounts?



ABOUT US



Speak Your Way To Cash® is a three-time Inc. 5000 sales training company. We teach credentialed experts, licensed professionals, and service-based business owners how to land corporate contracts and sell from the stage. The team is 17 people and fully remote. The business runs on a launch model with one to two launches per month, plus live events, masterminds, and international retreats, so transaction volume is uneven by design — quiet weeks followed by heavy ones.



There are several related entities under the same ownership, including a law firm and a holding company. Books are kept separate and clean across all of them.



THE ROLE



We need a senior bookkeeper who owns the numbers day to day. That means reconciling transactions daily, closing out and reporting weekly, and running a full month-end close that leaves nothing for our CPA to untangle at tax time.



This is a maintenance and accuracy role, not a strategy role. The person who does well here is the one who notices that a deposit doesn't match, chases it down the same day, and tells us before we ask.



WHAT YOU'LL DO



DAILY



• Reconcile all bank, credit card, and payment processor transactions daily

• Code expenses correctly to the right entity, class, and category

• Flag anything that looks off — duplicate charges, missing receipts, unusual vendor activity, deposits that don't tie to a known launch or invoice



WEEKLY



• Follow-up on any unpaid invoices or failed payments across stripe, paypal, and fanbasis

• Deliver a written financial report covering cash position, revenue by offer, outstanding AP and AR, and any open items you need answered

• Reconcile revenue across payment processors and our sales platform so what the platform reports matches what actually hit the bank

• Track contractor payments and outstanding invoices



MONTHLY



• Run a full close: reconciliations complete, accruals recorded, journal entries posted, books locked

• Produce P&L, balance sheet, and cash flow statements with a short written summary of what changed and why

• Reconcile event and travel spend against budget



ONGOING



• Maintain clean, current books across multiple entities without commingling

• Manage 1099 tracking and year-end contractor reporting

• Prepare and hand off documentation for our CPA at tax time

• Keep receipt and documentation systems organized enough that any transaction can be traced in under five minutes



AI PROFICIENCY REQUIRED



AI proficiency is required. Candidates must be able to use AI tools effectively in their day-to-day work, verify outputs for accuracy, protect confidential company and client information, and explain a practical example of using AI to improve work quality or efficiency.



WHAT YOU NEED



• Five or more years of bookkeeping experience, including at least two years at the senior level

• Experience working inside a firm — an accounting or CPA firm, or a law firm. You should know what it looks like when books are held to a professional standard and reviewed by someone else.

• Advanced QuickBooks skills. You should be comfortable with bank rules, class and location tracking, journal entries, undeposited funds, and cleaning up someone else's mess in QuickBooks without starting over.

• Experience managing books for more than one entity at a time

• Experience reconciling high-volume transactions from payment processors, not just a single business checking account

• Full ownership of month-end close in a prior role, start to finish

• Strong written communication. Much of this job is telling us what you found in writing, clearly, without being asked twice.

• Ability to work independently on a remote team and hit recurring deadlines without reminders



NICE TO HAVE



• Law firm trust accounting or IOLTA experience

We’re hiring an experienced Sales Manager to lead sales for our software product and build out a team from the ground up.

We make a shipping app for online stores. Store owners on Shopify and WooCommerce connect their shop, and our app lets them create shipping labels in bulk, print packing slips, and automatically send tracking numbers back to their customers — turning hours of daily shipping busywork into a few clicks. It’s a paid subscription product, and your job is to get it in front of online store owners and convert them into customers.

The unique part: We want you to build the team with people you already know and trust. If you have friends, family, or former colleagues with strong sales or customer-facing skills, you’ll be able to bring them on board as we grow. You’ll be their team lead — so your network is a real asset here, not just your resume.



What you’ll do:



- Find and reach out to online store owners (Shopify and WooCommerce merchants)

- Run product demos and handle the full sales cycle from first contact to closed subscription

- Track leads and results in our CRM and report on performance weekly

- Refine our sales scripts,
 templates, and outreach process

- Recruit and onboard new sales reps from your own network as we scale, then train, coach, and manage their targets



What we’re looking for:



- 3+ years of sales experience — B2B, SaaS, or selling to small business owners strongly preferred

- Familiarity with e-commerce (Shopify, WooCommerce, or online selling in general) is a big plus

- Excellent written and spoken English

- Proven track record of hitting quotas or closing deals

- A network of capable people you could recruit — tell us about them in your application

- Reliable internet, own computer, and a quiet workspace

title: Social Marketing Virtual Assistant Supervisor
description:
Social Marketing Virtual Assistant Supervisor



Full time, long term. Remote (Philippines).

Hours: 9:00 AM to 5:30 PM US Pacific Time, Monday to Friday.

Rate: $5.50 to $7.00 per hour, depending on experience.

Pay: Twice a month. PayPal for now, moving to Wise from October.



We are a US based brand selling automotive covers and accessories. You will lead a small team of two Marketing Agents who handle social media comments and private inquiries every day.



Department: Marketing

Reports to: Social Media Manager

Direct reports: Marketing Agents (social media comments & inquiries)



ROLE SUMMARY

The Social Marketing Virtual Assistant Supervisor owns the day to day performance of the Marketing Agent team responsible for social media comments and private inquiries. This role keeps the review process efficient, the SOPs current, and the Hootsuite environment properly configured, while acting as the first point of escalation for agents and the connective tissue between Marketing and other departments. The supervisor is both a process owner and a hands on operator, stepping into the queue whenever coverage is needed.



KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Process & SOP Ownership

- Optimize review process efficiency and identify bottlenecks in agent workflows.

- Recommend, document, and roll out SOP improvements as processes evolve.

- Develop response and coverage strategies, then cascade them across the full team, including Sydney, to keep processes consistent across locations.



Team Leadership & Coaching

- Run weekly meetings with Marketing Agents when there are updates to communicate or coaching is needed to improve response quality.

- Assist agents with process questions and guideline clarification via Teams, with a standard response time of 20 to 30 minutes.

- Provide feedback on response tone, accuracy, and adherence to brand voice.



Platform Administration & Monitoring

- Manage Hootsuite settings to maintain automation and keep configurations aligned across all agents.

- Monitor Hootsuite activity to confirm agents are performing to expectation and flag gaps early.

- Monitor the waiting message queue on Hootsuite and respond as needed throughout the day, through end of day.



Coverage

- Step in to cover extra hours when a Marketing Agent is unavailable, handling social media comments and private inquiries directly.

- When your core workload is light, pick up standing backlog work assigned by your supervisor. Downtime is expected to be filled with company work, and you note what you worked on in your end of shift report.



Reporting & Cross-Functional Alignment

- Prepare weekly reports on team activities, volume, response times, and progress against goals.

- Send a short end of shift report every working day: messages resolved, the time the queue was cleared, and what you worked on after that.

- Ensure cross departmental alignment so escalations, product questions, and campaign changes flow smoothly between Marketing and other teams.



QUALIFICATIONS

- 2+ years in social media management, community management, or customer support operations, with at least 1 year supervising or coordinating a team.

- Experience administering Hootsuite (or a comparable platform such as Sprout Social or Agorapulse), including inbox routing, automation rules, and permissions. If you have only used it as an agent, say so in your application. We still want to hear from you.

- Demonstrated experience writing or improving SOPs and documentation.

- Comfortable working across time zones and coordinating with distributed teammates.

- Strong written English and sound judgment on brand voice and escalation calls.

- Proficient with Microsoft Teams and standard reporting tools.



ATTRIBUTES FOR SUCCESS

- Responsive without being reactive. Holds a 20 to 30 minute support SLA while protecting focus time for process work.

- Willing to work the queue personally. No task is beneath the role.

- Spots patterns in recurring inquiries and turns them into documented guidance.

- Communicates clearly enough that a strategy set at HQ lands the same way in Sydney.



SUCCESS METRICS (FIRST 90 DAYS)

- Response time and resolution time on social inquiries at or below target.

- SOP library reviewed, with at least two documented process improvements implemented.

- Weekly reporting cadence established and consistently delivered.

- End of shift report sent every working day.

- No waiting item in the Hootsuite queue left unhandled past end of day.



HOW TO APPLY

Apply through OnlineJobs.ph message or 
 only. Applications sent to any other
 address will not be reviewed.



Answer the four questions below, four sentences or fewer each, and attach your resume.



Platform administration



1. Tell us about the last automation rule or routing setup you built in Hootsuite, Sprout Social, or Agorapulse. What problem was it solving, and what exactly did you configure? Name the feature.



2. Which of these have you set up yourself: inbox routing, assignment rules, automation rules, user permissions? Tell us which platform. If you have only worked as an agent replying to messages, just say so.



Supervising a live queue



3. How many agents were you responsible for, and did that queue have a response time target? If it did, what was the target?



4. How did you check whether an agent was actually working the queue, not just logged in? And what did you do the last time one of them was slow or went off brand?



Optional

If you have an SOP you personally wrote or improved, send the file or a 5 to 10 line excerpt. No penalty if you do not have one or cannot share it.



Please write this message yourself. Every output of this role is written, so your application is already the first writing sample we look at. If you have not done something, just say so. "I have never configured that" costs you nothing here.

title: Senior Performance Marketing and Funnel Automation Specialist (Independent Contractor)
description:
Senior Performance Marketing and Funnel Automation Specialist



Independent Contractor



Remote, Philippines



USD $10-15/hour plus performance bonuses!



ABOUT THE ROLE



We are hiring one independent contractor to create and own customer acquisition and the full funnel and automation systems for two separate U.S. businesses.



Law Offices of Eric A. Shore





Shore Legacy Insurance





You will spend approximately half of your time each week on each business.



The two companies have completely separate advertising accounts, tracking systems, CRMs, and customer data. They must remain completely separate at all times.



ABOUT THE TWO BUSINESSES



Law Offices of Eric A. Shore



A personal injury, disability, and employment law firm focused on generating qualified inbound calls and signed clients.



Shore Legacy Insurance



An insurance agency that currently runs high volume telesales for hospital indemnity products and is expanding into final expense, mortgage protection, and other life insurance products. The goal is to build our own inbound lead flow to support and scale this growth.



Both businesses already have sales capacity and are ready to handle increased volume of qualified leads and calls.



This is not a social media job. It is also not a pure media buying role.



We care about qualified inbound calls, qualified leads, signed clients, issued policies, and profitable customer acquisition.



Followers, impressions, and cheap form fills mean nothing if they do not turn into real business.



WHAT YOU WILL OWN



You will personally build and manage paid acquisition campaigns across Google, Meta, YouTube, and other channels.



You will build high converting landing pages, multi step funnels, quiz funnels, and click to call systems.



You will build and manage lead capture, call tracking, attribution, and CRM automation. GoHighLevel experience is a strong plus.



You will set up offline conversion tracking so Google and Meta can optimize toward actual business outcomes such as issued policies and signed clients, rather than just form submissions.



You will manage retargeting, testing, and continuous optimization based on real sales, client, and policy data.



The goal is to build a reliable and scalable customer acquisition engine for both businesses so we can rely less on third party lead vendors.



WHAT YOU MUST KNOW



You must have hands on experience with performance marketing and paid customer acquisition for U.S. consumers.



You must know Google Ads and Meta Ads.



You must know how to build landing pages, lead funnels, and conversion focused customer journeys.



You must understand call tracking and full attribution.



You must know Google Tag Manager, GA4, Enhanced Conversions, and Meta Conversions API.



You must understand how to send CRM, sales, client, and policy data back into advertising platforms.



You must know how to measure performance based on cost per qualified call, cost per issued policy, cost per signed client, and overall profitability.



You must be able to work within advertising and compliance rules, including TCPA requirements, Meta special ad categories, insurance advertising restrictions, and lawyer advertising restrictions.



STRONG PLUSSES



Experience with GoHighLevel or a similar CRM, including funnels and automation.



Experience with server side tracking and value based bidding.



Experience with webhooks, Zapier, Make, or CRM APIs.



Experience with YouTube advertising, Google Local Services Ads, or connected TV advertising.



Experience generating leads for insurance, legal services, Medicare, mortgage, financial services, or another regulated industry.



Strong practical use of AI for creative testing, research, analysis, campaign development, and optimization.



HOW YOU WILL BE MEASURED



Your performance will be measured primarily by cost per qualified lead, cost per qualified inbound call, cost per issued policy, cost per signed legal client, return on advertising spend, and overall profitability.



Cheap leads that do not convert into customers or clients are not good leads.



COMPENSATION AND STRUCTURE



Compensation is USD 10-15/hour depending on demonstrated skill and results, plus performance bonuses tied to profitable customer acquisition.



This is an independent contractor position.



You will work remotely and must be available for at least four hours that overlap with U.S. Eastern business hours.



HOW TO APPLY



Do not send a generic cover letter or simply send us your resume.



Begin your application with the exact words:



"Profit over clicks"



Then answer the following questions. Use real numbers whenever possible.



1. What is the largest monthly advertising budget you have personally managed? How much was spent on Google and how much was spent on Meta?



2. Give us one example where you materially reduced customer acquisition cost. What was the cost before and what was the cost after?



3. Have you generated inbound phone calls from paid advertising? What did a qualified call cost?



4. Have you sent CRM, sales, customer, client, or policy data back to Google or Meta for offline conversion optimization? Explain exactly how you did it.



5. What is your hands on experience with Enhanced Conversions, Meta Conversions API, Google Tag Manager, GA4, or server side tracking?



6. Have you worked in an industry with TCPA requirements, Meta special ad categories, insurance advertising rules, lawyer advertising rules, or other advertising compliance restrictions? Explain briefly.



7. Tell us specifically how you use AI today to improve paid advertising. Which tools do you use and what do you use each one for?



8. Describe the most successful lead generation campaign or funnel you personally built. Walk us through the advertisement, landing page or funnel, tracking, lead handoff, and final business result.



9. Tell us about a campaign that failed. What happened, why did it fail, and what did you change afterward?



Please include screenshots showing advertising, funnel, or campaign results. Remove client names, company names, and any confidential information.



Applications with real numbers and specific examples will receive priority.



We are looking for someone who wants to build a real customer acquisition engine for both businesses, not someone who simply wants to manage advertising accounts.



PLEASE INCLUDE YOUR 
 OR
 AUDIO NUMBER IF YOU HAVE ONE.

title: B2B Cold Caller, Sales / Lead Generation Specialist, Appointment Setter, VA
description:
About the Role





We are looking for a highly motivated B2B Sales & Lead Generation Virtual Assistant to help generate new business opportunities for a U.S.-based telecommunications Account Executive which is T-Mobile



The ideal candidate is comfortable making high-volume outbound calls, researching businesses, speaking with owners and decision-makers, handling objections, qualifying prospects, and booking appointments.



This is a performance-driven sales position. Your success will be measured by the number and quality of qualified appointments you generate.



Key Responsibilities



1. Lead Generation



* Research and identify small and mid-sized businesses.

* Build targeted prospect lists using Google Maps, Google Search, business directories, LinkedIn, and other sources.

* Identify the business owner, manager, office manager, or person responsible for wireless/telecommunications.

* Find business phone numbers and available contact information.

* Prioritize businesses that are likely to have multiple employees, company phones, tablets, hotspots, or fleet vehicles.



2. Cold Calling



* Make outbound B2B calls to business prospects.

* Introduce our telecommunications solutions professionally.

* Quickly identify whether the business is a potential fit.

* Ask discovery questions about their current wireless provider, number of lines, monthly spending, and pain points.

* Handle common objections professionally.

* Generate interest without being overly aggressive.



3. Appointment Setting



* Book qualified appointments directly on the Account Executive’s calendar.

* Confirm the appointment with the prospect.

* Send follow-up messages when appropriate.

* Maintain accurate appointment notes.

* Make sure appointments meet the agreed qualification criteria.



4. Follow-Up



* Follow up with prospects who aren’t ready to speak immediately.

* Re-contact previous leads.

* Maintain a structured follow-up schedule.

* Track conversations and outcomes in the CRM/spreadsheet.



5. Sales Intelligence

The VA should identify opportunities such as:



* Businesses with 5+ employees

* Multiple business phone lines

* Companies with fleet vehicles

* Construction companies

* HVAC companies

* Plumbing companies

* Electrical contractors

* Landscaping companies

* Pest control companies

* Roofing companies

* Delivery/courier companies

* Property management companies

* Medical/dental offices

* Professional-service businesses

* Salons/barbershops

* Other businesses likely to have multiple wireless users



Ideal Candidate



We’re looking for someone who:



* Has B2B cold-calling experience

* Has appointment-setting experience

* Has strong spoken English

* Sounds confident and professional on the phone

* Is comfortable making 50–100+ outbound calls per day

* Can handle rejection without becoming discouraged

* Understands basic sales psychology

* Can identify decision-makers

* Can overcome common objections

* Is organized and detail-oriented

* Can work independently

* Has reliable internet and a quiet workspace

* Is comfortable using Google Sheets/Excel, CRM systems, and communication tools

* Is highly motivated by performance and results



Performance Expectations



Daily targets:



* 50–100+ outbound calls

* 20+ meaningful conversations when possible

* 10–20+ newly researched prospects

* Consistent follow-up on previous prospects

* Accurate CRM/spreadsheet updates



Primary KPI:

Qualified appointments booked



Quality is more important than simply booking appointments. Appointments should ideally be with a business owner or decision-maker who has a legitimate need for business wireless services.



Qualification Questions



The VA should learn to determine:



1. Who is currently providing your business wireless service?

2. Approximately how many business lines do you have?

3. Are those lines company-owned or employee-owned?

4. Roughly how much does the business spend on wireless each month?

5. Are you currently under contract?

6. Are you experiencing any issues with your current provider?

7. Who makes the final decision regarding your wireless service?

8. When would you be open to reviewing another option?



The goal is not to hard-sell on the first call. The goal is to determine whether there is an opportunity and get the qualified prospect onto the Account Executive’s calendar.





If you’ve made it this far and read the role qualifications. Please send a virtual video of introducing yourself and why you are the best fit for this role.

Follow-up completion rate

Client onboarding completion

Comfortable working with CRM,

- Join calls and meetings with partners as needed — this role requires real engagement, not just note-taking

- Help keep projects, deadlines, and deliverables on track across the business

title: Trailer Repair Specialist
description:
GH Logistics and AJG Transport operate a high-performance freight brokerage and asset-based transportation network specializing in dry van and refrigerated freight. We move quickly, but we move with structure. Our operation is built on real-time visibility, disciplined execution, clear communication, and accountability. We take pride in keeping freight organized, assets accounted for, and operations running cleanly from pickup through delivery.



If you have experience coordinating equipment repairs, working with drivers and repair vendors, and keeping trailer operations moving during overnight hours, this role provides an opportunity to take ownership of a critical part of our Trailer Management operation.



Role Overview

You are responsible for maintaining overnight control of trailer repair activity and supporting off-tour Trailer Management operations. Your primary responsibility is to coordinate trailer repairs during the night shift, including high-volume on-road repair activity, while ensuring trailer records, repair statuses, documentation, and operational updates remain accurate in real time. You will work closely with the night repair team, drivers, carriers, repair vendors, facility personnel, and the Trailer Management team to keep equipment issues moving toward resolution. 



The night team is also responsible for verifying and completing work handed off by the day team and delivering a fully reconciled and accurate board for the incoming day shift. This is an operations and repair coordination position. You will not physically repair trailers and you will not have authority to approve company spending.



What You’ll Be Doing



Overnight Trailer Repair Coordination

• Serve as the primary Trailer Management point of coordination for overnight and on-road trailer repairs, working with drivers, carriers, facilities, roadside providers, mobile mechanics, and repair vendors.

• Review reported trailer defects, gather photos, inspection details, diagnoses, estimates, parts information, and other documentation needed to determine the appropriate next step.

• Coordinate roadside service, mobile repairs, terminal repairs, inspections, trailer swaps, or equipment repositioning and follow up on vendor status, parts availability, completion timelines, and return-to-service expectations.

• Continue follow-up on repairs handed off by the day team until they are resolved or properly documented and returned to the day team.

• Escalate repair costs, safety concerns, major equipment issues, and matters requiring financial approval to authorized leadership; this role has no authority to approve spending.



Fleetio and Data Integrity

• Maintain Fleetio records overnight in real time and enter all repair, trailer, and operational updates handled during the shift.

• Ensure trailer repair statuses, locations, assignments, conditions, and related records remain accurate and current.

• Conduct overnight data integrity checks and investigate missing, outdated, conflicting, or incomplete information.

• Update and maintain records involving misused trailers, partner carrier trailers, repair activity, vendors, and supporting documentation.

• Identify and resolve discrepancies between operational information and system records before the morning handoff whenever possible.



Off-Tour Trailer Operations

• Run the required overnight trailer classification sweep and identify trailers requiring correction, investigation, or follow-up.

• Close operational gaps and unfinished trailer-related work handed off by the day team.

• Assist carriers requiring trailers and coordinate trailer availability, loading, seating, assignments, and related movements.

• Monitor and address trailer concerns that may affect drivers, facilities, customers, freight movement, or equipment availability.

• Handle additional overnight trailer-related tasks and maintain communication with facility personnel and designated internal operational contacts.



Documentation and Morning Handoff

• Maintain complete and organized trailer repair paperwork and supporting documentation throughout the shift.

• Clearly document completed work, pending repairs, vendor responses, equipment concerns, unresolved issues, and required follow-ups.

• Verify items handed off by the day team and document what was completed, remains pending, or requires escalation.

• Ensure every unresolved item has clear ownership, an accurate current status, documented next steps, and a proper handoff.

• Deliver the 8 AM handoff complete and on time, including a reconciled board accurately reflecting trailer locations, statuses, repairs, outstanding issues, and required follow-ups.



What Success Looks Like

• Overnight and on-road trailer repairs are acknowledged quickly, coordinated effectively, and consistently followed through toward resolution.

• Fleetio, trailer classifications, repair records, and other operational data remain accurate and updated in real time throughout the shift.

• Drivers, carriers, vendors, facilities, and internal teams receive timely and clear communication regarding repair and trailer needs.

• Repair documentation, escalations, and unresolved issues are complete, organized, and properly handed off without unauthorized spending decisions.

• The day team receives a complete 8:00 AM handoff with a fully reconciled trailer board showing completed, pending, and escalated items.



Who We’re Looking For

• Experience in trailer management, fleet operations, dispatch, transportation, roadside assistance, or maintenance coordination.

• Knowledge of common trailer repairs, components, equipment defects, and maintenance terminology; repair coordination experience preferred.

• Able to review driver reports, photos, inspections, diagnoses, and estimates, ask the right follow-up questions, and determine appropriate next steps.

• Strong communication, attention to detail, problem-solving, prioritization, and follow-through in a fast-paced overnight operation.

• Comfortable working independently and using Fleetio or similar fleet systems; Samsara, LoadStop, Microsoft Office, and Google Workspace experience is a plus.

• Minimum 50 WPM typing speed, strong written and verbal English, and a reliable remote setup with backup internet and power.



Schedule and Work Setup

• Long term and full time remote independent contractor role

• Direct engagement with a US company, not an agency or BPO

• Current shift availability: Tuesday - Saturday 8 PM - 6 AM CDT

• Consistent availability during the assigned US shift is required

• Zoom presence with camera on throughout the shift is required

• Time tracking software, including Hubstaff or another platform, may be implemented as operationally required



What You’ll Get

• Independent contractor setup

• $75 monthly insurance stipend, with eligibility beginning 30 days after hire

• Reliable biweekly payments

• A stable, long-term opportunity that is not seasonal or project-based

• Direct exposure to a live US transportation and fleet operation

• Meaningful responsibility over overnight trailer repair activity

• Opportunities to develop deeper experience in Trailer Management, fleet maintenance, repair coordination, and transportation operations

• Potential growth within Trailer Management, Fleet Operations, Maintenance Coordination, or broader logistics operations



This role is built for someone who can keep control of trailer repairs after hours. You will not simply receive repair requests and pass them along. You will coordinate the response, maintain accurate Fleetio records, follow open repairs, support overnight trailer needs, clean up operational discrepancies, document what happened, and make sure the day team receives a reliable and reconciled picture of the operation every morning.

title: Senior Graphic Designer (AI + Photoshop, E-commerce & Marketing Assets)
description:
[Senior Graphic Designer (AI + Photoshop, E-commerce & Marketing Assets)]



Job Overview

We are looking for a skilled graphic designer to help create polished and realistic product images and marketing assets for e-commerce and digital marketing.



The work will involve using AI image-generation or editing tools together with Adobe Photoshop. You will receive product images, visual examples, and clear instructions for each project.



We are looking for someone with strong visual judgment, attention to detail, and the ability to turn reference images into professional-quality final artwork.



Responsibilities

- Create polished product images, static ads, social media graphics, blog imagery, web assets, and infographics

- Create short AI-generated videos and product animations for digital marketing

- Composite, retouch, and refine AI-generated images to achieve realistic lighting, texture, perspective, shadows, and product details

- Develop creative concepts and visual solutions based on project briefs, references, and marketing objectives, including visual and competitor research to identify creative direction

- Follow provided product references and project instructions accurately while maintaining product consistency

- Correct AI artifacts and review work carefully before submission to ensure quality, consistency, and accuracy

- Prepare organized working files and properly formatted final image and video exports

- Manage multiple assignments and shifting priorities, communicate clearly and provide updates when needed, and complete work within agreed deadlines



Requirements

- 5+ years of professional graphic design experience

- Strong attention to realism, proportions, materials, lighting, and product details

- Experience with realistic photo manipulation or product compositing

- Experience creating e-commerce or product listing images

- Experience creating short marketing videos or product animations (AI-generated or edited)

- Able to follow visual references and written instructions accurately

- Strong text-based communication and instruction comprehension in English (our team coordinates work almost entirely in writing)

- Able to work independently and communicate reliably

- Able to work US Pacific Time hours

- Portfolio required (please include your portfolio link when you apply)



Skill Requirements

- Adobe Photoshop (Expert): Adobe Illustrator and Canva, compositing, masking, retouching, color correction

- AI image generation and editing tools: e.g. Nano Banana, ChatGPT, Midjourney, Adobe Firefly, Generative Fill, Stable Diffusion

- AI video generation tools for short product videos and animations

- Photo manipulation and product compositing

- Realism and detail control (lighting, shadow, perspective, materials, proportions)

- E-commerce and product listing image creation

- Developing creative concepts from briefs and references

- File preparation and export (organized layered files, web-ready outputs)

- English communication for written instructions (Intermediate or higher)



Nice to Have, but Not Required

- Experience working with automotive products

- Experience creating multiple color variations from one master image

- Figma or CapCut



What We Offer

- All AI tool subscriptions are provided and paid for by the company. You will never pay for tools out of pocket.

- A long-term, stable position with a team that is actively expanding its creative work

- We keep an open mind about what this role can become. We review compensation and responsibilities regularly, and we are genuinely willing to grow both for someone whose work consistently raises our standard. If you bring skills beyond what is listed here, please tell us. We would rather build the role around a strong designer than limit a strong designer to a job description.

 what we launch

s

title: Accounts Receivable Specialist / Collections Specialist
description:
We are looking for an experienced, organized, and proactive Accounts Receivable / Collections Specialist to join our accounting team. This is a remote position based in the Philippines.



The primary focus of this role is customer collections and AR follow-up. You will be responsible for monitoring outstanding receivables, communicating directly with U.S.-based customers, following up on payment commitments, maintaining accurate collection records, and helping management identify accounts that require additional attention.



Excellent spoken and written English is required, as this position involves regular communication with customers by phone and
.



Key Responsibilities

• Follow up with customers regarding outstanding and past-due invoices

• Communicate with customers by phone and
 regarding payment status and account issues

• Monitor AR aging and prioritize collection efforts based on aging, balance, and collection risk

• Track payment commitments, expected payment dates, follow-up dates, and collection status

• Prepare and send customer statements

• Review customer accounts for unapplied payments, credits, deductions, and discrepancies

• Perform customer account reconciliations and investigate differences

• Coordinate with Accounting, Sales, invoicing, and operations teams to resolve AR issues

• Maintain accurate and detailed collection notes

• Prepare AR aging and collection reports for management and reports/statements per customers’ requests

• Identify high-risk or problematic accounts and escalate them proactively

• Assist with collection forecasting and cash-flow visibility

• Maintain organized and accurate AR records and supporting documentation



Qualifications

• Previous experience in Accounts Receivable, Collections, or a similar accounting role

• Strong spoken and written English is required

• Comfortable speaking professionally with U.S.-based customers by phone

• Confident discussing outstanding balances, payment commitments, discrepancies, and account issues

• Strong Excel or Google Sheets skills

• Experience with QuickBooks Online (QBO) strongly preferred

• Experience reviewing and managing AR aging reports

• Strong attention to detail and reconciliation skills

• Organized and able to manage multiple customer accounts and follow-ups simultaneously

• Reliable, responsive, and able to work independently

• Able to identify problems and escalate issues rather than waiting for instructions

• HubSpot or other CRM experience is a plus



What We’re Looking For

• This is not simply a data-entry AR position. We are looking for someone who can take ownership of the collection process.

• The ideal candidate can review an aging report, determine which accounts need attention, communicate confidently with customers, follow through on payment commitments, resolve account discrepancies, and clearly communicate collection risks to management.



Compensation

• Monthly Rate: $1,000–$1,500 USD, depending on experience, with opportunities to earn additional performance-based compensation



How to Apply

• To apply, please submit your application through this form 

• ONLY applications submitted through the the form will be considered. Thank you!
